variations: A Taurus's sense of security doesn't come from people — it comes from their familiar things not being moved around.
A Taurus being quiet doesn't mean they have no opinions. They just feel most things don't need to be said out loud.

items.sourceNote: Gemini — sociable, communicative, never met a stranger, lively banter, quick wit, endless curiosity

zh-tw.content:
雙子座腦袋此刻開著的分頁：

昨天沒看完的貓咪影片。
明年想去但機票還沒查的城市。
剛剛突然想起的國中同學綽號。
還有「等一下要跟你講的那件事」，他已經忘記是哪件了。

他會一口氣全講給你聽，然後要你選一個最喜歡的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一句話可以岔題五次、但你完全捨不得打斷的雙子朋友
variations: 雙子座最大的天賦是跟誰都能聊起來，最大的困擾也是——他真的跟誰都能聊起來。
問雙子座一個問題，你會得到三個答案，外加兩個他突然想到的新問題。

en.content:
Tabs currently open in a Gemini's head:

The cat video they never finished.
A city they want to visit next year, flights unchecked.
A middle-school classmate's nickname that just surfaced.
And "that thing I was going to tell you," which they have already forgotten.

They will read you all of it in one breath, then ask which one you liked best.
en.editorNote: Send to the Gemini who can derail a single sentence five times, and somehow you never want them to stop
variations: A Gemini's greatest gift is being able to chat with anyone. Their greatest problem is also that they can, in fact, chat with anyone.
Ask a Gemini one question and you'll get three answers, plus two brand-new questions they just thought of.

items.sourceNote: Cancer — sensitive, nurturing, introverted, values emotional security, prefers cozy home over big events

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座可以為了在乎的人做到全世界——
卻常常一個人躲在房間裡，把所有情緒慢慢消化完，才肯走出來笑著說「我沒事」。

他不是不需要被照顧，他只是太習慣當那個照顧別人的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是在問你「你還好嗎」、卻很少說自己累了的巨蟹朋友
variations: 巨蟹座的硬殼不是用來攻擊的，是用來保護那顆其實很軟的心。
巨蟹座記得你隨口說過喜歡的東西，然後默默放在心上很久很久。

en.content:
A Cancer will move heaven and earth for the people they care about —
yet they'll often hide alone in their room, slowly working through every feeling, before they come out smiling and say 'I'm fine.'

It's not that they don't need to be taken care of. They're just too used to being the one who takes care of everyone else.
en.editorNote: Send to the Cancer who's always asking 'are you okay?' but rarely admits when they're worn out themselves
variations: A Cancer's hard shell isn't for attacking — it's for protecting the very soft heart underneath.
A Cancer remembers the thing you mentioned liking in passing, and quietly holds onto it for a very long time.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius — independent, unconventional, would rather be hated for who they are than loved for who they aren't; the 'social loner' twist

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座是那種——在一群人裡很自在，卻又像隨時可以一個人離開的存在。

他寧願被討厭、但是真實的自己，也不要被喜歡、但其實是別人想要的樣子。對他來說，被誤會沒關係，被同化才可怕。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個明明很合群、卻永遠保有一塊誰都進不去的小宇宙的水瓶朋友
variations: 水瓶座的距離感不是冷漠，是他需要那個空間，才能繼續當那個有趣的自己。
你以為你很懂水瓶座，然後他又用一個你想不到的角度，把你嚇一跳。

en.content:
An Aquarius is the type who's perfectly comfortable in a crowd, yet always seems like they could get up and leave on their own at any moment.

They'd rather be disliked for being their real self than adored for being whoever someone else wanted. To them, being misunderstood is fine. Being absorbed into the crowd is the scary part.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aquarius who blends in just fine but always keeps one little universe inside that nobody else gets to enter
variations: An Aquarius's sense of distance isn't coldness — it's the space they need to keep being the interesting person they are.
Just when you think you've got an Aquarius figured out, they hit you with a take you never saw coming.

items.sourceNote: Gemini as both introvert and extrovert — first to show up, then disappears for a week

zh-tw.content:
雙子座不是善變——
是他同時住著一個超想出門的E人，跟一個只想躺著的I人，而你永遠不知道今天輪到誰當班。

聚會永遠第一個到、嗨到最高點，然後隔天人間蒸發一個禮拜，已讀不回不是生氣，是社交電池真的用完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個昨天還超熱情、今天突然安靜的雙子朋友，他不是討厭你
variations: 問雙子座要不要去玩，他會先說好、再說算了、再說好啦——這三個都是真心的。
雙子座的內心有兩個人在開會，而且常常沒有共識。

en.content:
A Gemini isn't flaky.
They just have an extrovert who desperately wants to go out and an introvert who only wants to lie down living inside them — and you never know which one clocked in today.

First to arrive at the party, peaks the energy, then vanishes for a whole week. Leaving you on read isn't anger — the social battery genuinely hit zero.
en.editorNote: Send to the Gemini who was all fire yesterday and went silent today. They don't hate you.
variations: Ask a Gemini to hang out and they'll say yes, then never mind, then okay fine — all three are genuine.
There are two people holding a meeting inside a Gemini, and they rarely reach an agreement.

items.sourceNote: Scorpio appears introverted to strangers, takes time to open up, seeks depth and authenticity

zh-tw.content:
天蠍座對陌生人是I人，對在乎的人才會切換成另一種模式。

他不是高冷，是還沒決定要不要讓你進來。一旦他開始跟你分享真心話，恭喜你，這是天蠍座等級最高的信任，比說「我愛你」還難得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個外表很安靜、熟了之後話多到嚇你一跳的天蠍朋友
variations: 天蠍座的沉默不是沒話講，是他正在判斷你值不值得聽真話。
對天蠍座來說，把你放進心裡很慢，但放進去之後就不太想拿出來了。

en.content:
A Scorpio is an introvert to strangers and switches to a whole other mode only for the people they care about.

They're not aloof — they just haven't decided whether to let you in yet. The day a Scorpio starts telling you what they actually feel, congrats: that's their highest tier of trust, rarer than hearing them say 'I love you.'
en.editorNote: Send to the Scorpio friend who seems quiet at first, then talks your ear off once they're comfortable
variations: A Scorpio's silence isn't having nothing to say — it's deciding whether you're worth the truth.
It takes a Scorpio forever to let you into their heart, but once you're in, they don't really want to take you back out.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius — friendliest sign, makes small talk with anyone, no filter no regrets, extrovert

zh-tw.content:
射手座可以跟任何人聊起來——便利商店店員、計程車司機、剛認識三分鐘的陌生人，下車前已經交換完人生故事。

他不是沒有界線，是覺得世界這麼大，不認識的人只是還沒聊過的朋友而已。至於說話不經大腦這件事，他自己也很困擾，但也只困擾三秒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個走到哪都能交到朋友、講話卻常常先講再後悔的射手
variations: 射手座的人生規劃只有一條：哪裡好玩去哪裡，其他到時候再說。
射手座答應你的事，是真心的；忘記這件事，也是真心的。

en.content:
A Sagittarius can strike up a conversation with literally anyone — the convenience store cashier, the cab driver, a stranger they met three minutes ago. By the time they get out, they've swapped entire life stories.

It's not that they have no boundaries. They just figure the world's huge, and a stranger is only a friend they haven't talked to yet. As for speaking before thinking — it bothers them too, but only for about three seconds.
en.editorNote: Send to the Sagittarius who makes friends everywhere and speaks first, regrets later
variations: A Sagittarius's only life plan: go wherever's fun, figure out the rest later.
When a Sagittarius promises you something, they mean it. When they forget about it, they also mean it.

items.sourceNote: Cancer — cries then jokes about it, emotionally soft but protective, homebody introvert

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座可以前一秒哭得唏哩嘩啦，下一秒擦乾眼淚開始自嘲剛剛有多醜。

他們把所有人都照顧得好好的，自己卻常常是最後一個被照顧到的。最大的快樂不是出去玩，是回到那個有自己味道的家，關上門，誰都不用見。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是在照顧別人、卻很少喊累的巨蟹朋友，問他一句「那你呢」
variations: 巨蟹座的硬殼是給外人看的，殼裡那塊軟的，只留給很少很少的人。
想約巨蟹座出門很難，但約他在家耍廢——他立刻精神百倍。

en.content:
A Cancer can be sobbing one second and wiping their eyes the next to crack a joke about how ugly they just looked crying.

They take care of everyone around them and somehow end up being the last one anyone takes care of. Their biggest joy isn't a night out — it's coming home to the place that smells like them, closing the door, and not having to see a single soul.
en.editorNote: Send to the Cancer who's always looking after everyone but rarely admits they're tired. Ask them: 'And what about you?'
variations: A Cancer's hard shell is for outsiders. The soft part inside is saved for a precious few.
Getting a Cancer to go out is hard. Inviting them to do absolutely nothing at home — suddenly full of energy.

items.sourceNote: Virgo — overthinks everything, notices every detail, quiet care expressed through actions

zh-tw.content:
處女座不是嫌東嫌西——
是他真的看到了那個你沒注意到的細節，而且看到之後就再也假裝沒看到不了。

他不太說「我關心你」，但會記得你不吃香菜、會在你還沒喊冷之前把外套遞過來。他的愛藏在那些你以為是巧合的小事裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴上很挑剔、行動卻把你照顧得很細的處女朋友
variations: 處女座腦中有個永遠關不掉的視窗，正在分析剛剛那句話的十七種可能意思。
處女座的「我沒事」，通常是在腦內已經把整件事重播第八遍了。

en.content:
A Virgo isn't nitpicking.
They genuinely spotted the detail you missed, and once they've seen it, they can't unsee it no matter how hard they try.

They rarely say 'I care about you,' but they'll remember you hate cilantro and hand you a jacket before you even mention you're cold. Their love hides in the small things you assumed were coincidences.
en.editorNote: Send to the Virgo who sounds picky but quietly looks after every detail of your life
variations: There's a window in a Virgo's brain that never closes — currently analyzing the seventeen possible meanings of what you just said.
When a Virgo says 'I'm fine,' they've usually already replayed the whole thing eight times in their head.

items.sourceNote: Libra — people-pleaser, hates conflict, smiles through discomfort, indecisive but charming

zh-tw.content:
天秤座可以一邊咬牙不想待在這裡，一邊對你笑得超甜。

他不是虛偽——是真的不想讓場面尷尬。你問他要吃什麼，他說「都可以」；你真的隨便點，他又會在心裡默默覺得「其實我不想吃這個」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠說「我都可以」結果根本有意見的天秤朋友，逼他做一次決定
variations: 天秤座的選擇障礙不是不會選，是怕選錯了要負責。
天秤座表面上八面玲瓏，回家關上門那一刻，是真的一句話都不想說了。

en.content:
A Libra can be gritting their teeth wishing they were anywhere else, while smiling sweetly right at you.

It's not fake — they genuinely don't want things to get awkward. Ask what they want to eat and they'll say 'anything's fine'; then once you actually pick, they'll quietly think 'I didn't really want this.'
en.editorNote: Send to the Libra who always says 'I'm easy' but absolutely has opinions. Make them choose for once.
variations: A Libra's indecision isn't that they can't choose — it's that they're scared of being blamed for choosing wrong.
A Libra works the whole room like a charm, then the second they get home and shut the door, they don't want to say a single word.

items.sourceNote: Scorpio — observes from the shadows, magnetic but private, intense loyalty, reads everyone

zh-tw.content:
聚會兩小時，天蠍座只講過三句話。

但他知道誰跟誰在冷戰、誰在硬撐、誰的笑是裝出來的。

他還沒決定要不要對你敞開，所以先站在角落把整場看完。
決定了他會掏心掏肺；哪天你傷到他，他會記得是第幾句話。
zh-tw.editorNote: 聚會結束後傳給那個全程安靜、卻好像什麼都看在眼裡的天蠍朋友
variations: 天蠍座的已讀不回，通常代表他正在腦內把你那句話拆到第三層含義。
想讓天蠍座信任你很難，但他一旦認定你，全世界與你為敵他都站你這邊。

en.content:
Two hours into the party, the Scorpio has said three sentences.

They also know who isn't speaking to whom, who is holding it together, and whose laugh is fake.

They haven't decided whether to let you in yet, so they'll stand in the corner and watch the whole thing first.
Once they decide, they give you everything — and if you hurt them, they'll remember which sentence did it.
en.editorNote: Send to the quiet Scorpio friend who somehow always seems to know everything
variations: A Scorpio leaving you on read usually means they're mentally unpacking your sentence down to its third layer.
Earning a Scorpio's trust is hard, but once they're sure of you, they'll stand by your side even if the whole world turns against you.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius — adventurous, friendly with everyone, freedom-loving, blunt honesty, hates being tied down

zh-tw.content:
射手座可以跟任何人聊起來，從便利商店店員聊到隔壁桌的陌生人。

他不是花心——是真的對全世界都好奇。你想綁住他，他會像被關住的風一樣難受。給他自由，他反而哪裡都不想去，因為知道自己隨時可以走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個說走就走、永遠在計畫下一趟旅行的射手朋友
variations: 射手座的「我們改天約」是真心的，只是那個「改天」要等他先把世界繞完一圈。
射手座講話很直，不是想傷你，是他覺得繞圈子比直說更累。

en.content:
A Sagittarius can strike up a conversation with literally anyone — from the cashier to the stranger at the next table.

It's not that they're flaky — they're genuinely curious about the whole world. Try to tie them down and they'll feel like wind trapped in a box. Give them freedom and suddenly they don't want to go anywhere, because they know they always could.
en.editorNote: Send to the spontaneous Sagittarius friend who's already planning their next trip
variations: When a Sagittarius says 'let's hang out sometime,' they mean it — that 'sometime' just has to wait until they've circled the globe first.
A Sagittarius is blunt not because they want to hurt you, but because beating around the bush feels more exhausting to them than just saying it.

items.sourceNote: Capricorn — disciplined, ambitious, dry humor, looks cold but deeply reliable, work-focused

zh-tw.content:
摩羯座看起來很冷——其實只是把力氣留給該努力的地方，懶得在社交上演戲。

他不太說情話，但他會記得你提過一次想要的東西，然後某天默默放到你面前。對摩羯來說，做到比說到重要太多了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴上不甜、卻總是默默把事情都扛好的摩羯朋友
variations: 摩羯座的休息方式是「先把事情做完」，所以他基本上沒在休息。
摩羯座的冷面笑話通常要三秒後你才反應過來——然後笑到不行。

en.content:
A Capricorn comes off cold — really they're just saving their energy for what actually matters and can't be bothered performing in social settings.

They won't whisper sweet nothings, but they'll remember that one thing you mentioned wanting and quietly set it in front of you one day. To a Capricorn, doing it beats saying it every single time.
en.editorNote: Send to the Capricorn friend who never says the sweet stuff but quietly carries everything for everyone
variations: A Capricorn's idea of resting is 'finish the work first,' which means they're basically never resting.
A Capricorn's deadpan jokes usually take three seconds to land — and then you're done for.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius — independent, unconventional, emotionally detached but humanitarian, needs alone time

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座可以在一群人裡笑得很開，回家後卻需要一整天誰都不理才能充飽電。

他不是冷漠——是腦袋裡的世界太精彩，常常自己一個人就玩得很開心。你以為他在生氣，其實他只是在放空想一些沒人想得到的事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個忽冷忽熱、突然就人間蒸發幾天的水瓶朋友，別擔心他只是在充電
variations: 水瓶座的「我想自己靜一靜」不是針對你，是他真的需要一個人待著。
水瓶座永遠在想一些奇怪的問題，例如「如果」，然後就自己研究一整晚。

en.content:
An Aquarius can be laughing in the middle of a crowd, then go home and need a full day of ignoring everyone just to recharge.

It's not coldness — the world inside their head is so interesting they're perfectly happy alone. You think they're mad at you, but really they're just spacing out, thinking about things no one else would ever come up with.
en.editorNote: Send to the hot-and-cold Aquarius friend who vanishes for a few days at a time. Don't worry — they're just recharging.
variations: When an Aquarius says 'I need some time alone,' it's not about you — they genuinely just need to be by themselves.
An Aquarius is always chewing on some odd question like 'what if,' then disappearing down the rabbit hole for an entire night.

items.sourceNote: Pisces — empathetic, dreamy, absorbs others' emotions, lives in own world, sensitive (I人 angle)

zh-tw.content:
雙魚座最強的能力，是把別人的情緒當成自己的。

你只是隨口說了一句心情不好，他可以難過一整晚，比你還認真。然後回到家又一個人躲進自己的小世界，編一齣根本不會發生的劇情，自己感動到哭。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是替別人擔心、又特別容易腦補的雙魚朋友，他會說「你怎麼知道」
variations: 雙魚座的「我沒事」有三種意思：真的沒事、有點事、以及我已經在心裡哭完一輪了。
雙魚座可以為了一部電影哭，也可以為了一支廣告哭，重點不是內容，是他太會感受了。

en.content:
A Pisces's superpower is taking on everyone else's emotions as their own.

You mention offhand that you're a little down, and they'll be sad about it all night — more invested than you are. Then they go home, retreat into their own little world, write a whole storyline that's never going to happen, and move themselves to tears over it.
en.editorNote: Send to the Pisces friend who's always worrying about everyone and spiraling into imaginary scenarios. They'll say 'how did you know.'
variations: A Pisces 'I'm fine' has three meanings: actually fine, a little not fine, and I already finished crying about it in my head.
A Pisces can cry over a movie or over a 30-second commercial. It's not the content — they just feel everything that hard.

items.sourceNote: Gemini — chatty, witty, adaptable, dual nature, social butterfly ruled by Mercury (E人 angle)

zh-tw.content:
雙子座可以跟陌生人從排隊聊到結帳，下車前還互留了 IG。

他不是花心，是腦袋同時開了八個分頁，每個都很想點進去看。你以為他在跟你聊天，其實他腦中已經接了三個話題、想到一個冷笑話、還順便回憶起國中的某件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一秒換三個話題、跟誰都能聊起來的雙子朋友，他大概正在同時回你和另外五個人
variations: 雙子座的「等等講完這個」永遠講不完，因為講完那個又想到新的。
雙子座最怕的不是沒朋友，是無聊——只要不無聊，他可以跟你聊三個小時都不累。

en.content:
A Gemini can strike up a conversation with a stranger in line and walk out having traded Instagram handles before checkout.

It's not flakiness — their brain just has eight tabs open and wants to click into all of them. You think they're talking to you, but they've already lined up three other topics, thought of a bad pun, and randomly remembered something from middle school.
en.editorNote: Send to the Gemini friend who switches topics three times a second and can talk to anyone. They're probably replying to you and five other people right now.
variations: A Gemini's 'let me finish this thought' never actually finishes, because finishing it sparks a brand-new one.
A Gemini's worst fear isn't being friendless — it's being bored. Keep it interesting and they'll talk to you for three hours straight.

items.sourceNote: Leo — confident, loves attention, warm, generous, ruled by the sun, most extroverted (E人 angle)

zh-tw.content:
獅子座一進場，全場的注意力就自動轉過去——他不用刻意，是天生自帶聚光燈。

但你以為他只是愛現？其實他是真心希望大家都開心，朋友被欺負他第一個跳出來，請客也最大方。他要的不是被崇拜，是被需要。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個很罩、永遠把氣氛炒到最高、但其實超在意你過得好不好的獅子朋友
variations: 獅子座可以一整晚當全場焦點，回家後卻會反覆想「我剛剛是不是太搶戲了」。
獅子座的驕傲是真的，但他的義氣也是真的——這兩件事在他身上一點都不衝突。

en.content:
A Leo walks into a room and all the attention just swings their way — they don't even try, the spotlight comes built in.

But you think they only want to show off? Really, they just want everyone to have a good time. Mess with their friend and they're the first to step up; they're also the most generous one picking up the tab. They don't want to be worshipped — they want to be needed.
en.editorNote: Send to the Leo friend who's always got your back, keeps the energy at max, and secretly cares a ton about whether you're okay.
variations: A Leo can be the center of attention all night, then go home and replay it wondering 'was I hogging the spotlight?'
A Leo's pride is real, but so is their loyalty — and in them, those two things don't clash at all.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius — adventurous, curious, freedom-loving, social magnet, blunt honesty (E人 angle)

zh-tw.content:
射手座揪你出去的訊息永遠是：「我們現在出發。」不是明天，是現在。

他熱愛自由到一個程度，連自己的計畫都綁不住自己。你問他下週要幹嘛，他會說「到時候再看」，因為他真的不知道——說不定明天就跑去別的城市了。別想拴住他，但他絕對是最好玩的旅伴。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個說走就走、行程永遠待定、但帶你出去一定超盡興的射手朋友
variations: 射手座的誠實是不分場合的——他不是想傷你，是真的覺得「這有什麼好不講的」。
射手座可以為了一張便宜機票，半夜兩點決定下週飛去一個沒去過的地方。

en.content:
A Sagittarius's invite always reads: 'We're leaving now.' Not tomorrow — now.

They love freedom so much that even their own plans can't pin them down. Ask what they're doing next week and you'll get 'we'll see,' because they genuinely don't know — they might be in another city by tomorrow. Don't try to tie them down, but they're absolutely the most fun person to travel with.
en.editorNote: Send to the spontaneous Sagittarius friend whose plans are perpetually TBD but who always shows you the best time.
variations: A Sagittarius's honesty doesn't read the room — it's not that they want to hurt you, they just genuinely think 'why wouldn't I say it?'
A Sagittarius will decide at 2 a.m. to fly somewhere they've never been next week, just because the flight was cheap.

items.sourceNote: Pisces — kind intentions, flaky follow-through, lives in fantasy, second angle on the same sign

zh-tw.content:
雙魚座傳了「有需要隨時找我」，然後手機就沒電了。

他的心意一百分是真的，行動力可能就……再說。雙魚不是不可靠，是他活在一個比現實溫柔很多的世界裡，一不小心就飄走了。但只要他真的記得你，那份在乎是整個星座裡最深的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個超級暖、但偶爾會神隱、回神後又認真道歉的雙魚朋友，他是真心的
variations: 雙魚座答應的事都是真心的，能不能準時做到是另一回事——通常會做到，只是會晚一點。
雙魚座放空的時候不是腦袋空白，是同時在演三齣內心小劇場。

en.content:
A Pisces texts 'I'm here whenever you need me' — and then their phone dies.

The intention is a solid 100; the follow-through is more of a 'we'll see.' A Pisces isn't unreliable — they just live in a world that's a lot softer than the real one, and they drift off into it without meaning to. But when they truly remember you, no sign in the zodiac cares more deeply.
en.editorNote: Send to the super-warm Pisces friend who occasionally vanishes, then comes back and apologizes sincerely. They mean it.
variations: Everything a Pisces promises is sincere — whether they do it on time is a separate question. Usually they do. Just a little late.
When a Pisces spaces out, their mind isn't blank — they're running three inner dramas at once.

items.sourceNote: Gemini dual personality — wants social life but ignores texts; introvert/extrovert switching

zh-tw.content:
雙子座的一天：早上十點連發二十則語音，下午三點三十則未讀全部放著。

社交電量從滿格掉到零，只花了他四個小時；再充回來，可能只需要一通電話。

你永遠猜不到今天開門的是E人雙子還是I人雙子。
連他自己出門前都要先抽個籤。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個明明很愛聊天、卻常常已讀不回的雙子朋友，他會回「哈哈對欸」然後又消失
variations: 雙子座的超能力：做完決定的下一秒立刻後悔，然後再做一個新的決定來後悔。
雙子座身上住著兩個意見不合的室友，你今天遇到哪一個，得看運氣。

en.content:
A Gemini's day: twenty voice memos at 10 a.m., thirty unread texts ignored by 3 p.m.

Their social battery went from full to empty in four hours; one phone call can fill it back up.

You never know which Gemini opens the door today, the extrovert or the introvert.
Neither do they — they basically draw straws on the way out.
en.editorNote: Send to the Gemini friend who loves to chat but leaves you on read for days. They'll reply 'lol so true' and then disappear again.
variations: Gemini superpower: making a decision and regretting it one second later, then making a brand-new decision to regret.
Two roommates who never agree live inside one Gemini; which one you get today is luck.

items.sourceNote: Leo — main character energy, attention required applause optional, secret softness

zh-tw.content:
獅子座走進任何房間的內心OS：主角到場了，大家可以開始了。

但很少人知道，獅子座那麼需要被看見，是因為他真的把全部的熱情都給你了，只是想換一句「我有看到你的努力」。掌聲可以省，但別讓他覺得自己是空氣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看起來超有自信、其實很需要被肯定的獅子朋友，再補一句「我有看到你」
variations: 獅子座要的不是讚美，是「被認真看見」——讚美只是順便。
獅子座可以一個人扛下全場，但回到家也會偷偷希望有人問一句：你還好嗎？

en.content:
A Leo walking into any room, internally: the main character has arrived, you may begin.

What most people miss is that a Leo needs to be seen because they've handed you all of their warmth up front — all they want back is one 'I noticed what you did.' You can skip the applause. Just don't make them feel invisible.
en.editorNote: Send to the Leo friend who looks endlessly confident but quietly needs reassurance — then add 'I see you.'
variations: A Leo doesn't want praise so much as to be genuinely seen — the praise is just a bonus.
A Leo can carry the whole room alone, then go home secretly hoping someone asks 'are you okay?'

items.sourceNote: Virgo — perfectionist, fixes the world before their own room, overthinking as love language

zh-tw.content:
處女座：要先把全世界的細節修到完美，自己的房間明天再整理。

他挑你毛病不是嫌你，是他腦袋裡有一套「我希望你過得更好」的清單，而他只是不小心唸出來了。處女座的碎念其實是另一種版本的「我在乎你」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一直碎念、但每次你出事第一個跳出來幫你善後的處女朋友
variations: 處女座的笑點門檻很高，一個笑話要完美到99%他才願意笑——剩下那1%還在他腦中被審查。
處女座說「沒事我隨便」的時候，是他正在心裡列第三版方案。

en.content:
Virgo: fixing every detail in the world to perfection, then planning to clean their own room tomorrow.

When a Virgo nitpicks you, it's not disapproval — there's a running list in their head titled 'things that would make your life better,' and they just accidentally read it out loud. A Virgo's nagging is simply another dialect of 'I care about you.'
en.editorNote: Send to the Virgo friend who never stops critiquing but is always the first to clean up your mess when things go wrong.
variations: A Virgo's bar for laughing is brutal — a joke has to be 99% perfect, and the last 1% is still under review in their head.
When a Virgo says 'whatever, I don't mind,' they are mentally on draft three of the plan.

items.sourceNote: Scorpio — intense, hard to read whether plotting revenge or snacks, loyalty underneath

zh-tw.content:
天蠍座安靜地坐在角落，你永遠分不清他是在密謀復仇還是在想晚餐吃什麼。

大部分時間是後者。天蠍的高冷只是外殼，裡面是一個一旦認定你、就會把你放進名單前三名、誰都動不了的人。他不輕易交心，但交了就是一輩子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看起來很難親近、其實對自己人超級護短的天蠍朋友
variations: 天蠍座的已讀不回不是冷漠，是他正在心裡把你說的每一句話分析第七遍。
天蠍座可以一秒看穿你在裝沒事，然後選擇陪你一起裝——這就是他的溫柔。

en.content:
A Scorpio sitting quietly in the corner — and you genuinely can't tell if they're plotting revenge or deciding what to have for dinner.

Usually it's dinner. The icy exterior is just packaging; inside is someone who, once they've chosen you, puts you in their top three and lets no one touch you. A Scorpio doesn't open up easily, but when they do, it's for life.
en.editorNote: Send to the Scorpio friend who seems impossible to approach but is fiercely protective of their inner circle.
variations: A Scorpio leaving you on read isn't coldness — they're analyzing everything you said for the seventh time.
A Scorpio can see through your 'I'm fine' in a second, then choose to play along with you. That's their version of tenderness.

items.sourceNote: Capricorn — workaholic, guilt over rest, ambition as default mode, soft side rarely shown

zh-tw.content:
摩羯座努力工作的理由：好讓週末休息的時候有罪惡感可以背。

他不是不會玩，是他的腦袋裡有一個永遠關不掉的進度條。摩羯座很少喊累，因為他覺得喊了也沒人能幫，不如自己默默撐過去——這份硬，其實是另一種溫柔，他只是習慣把自己排在最後。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是埋頭苦幹、連休假都在偷看訊息的摩羯朋友，提醒他休息不用有罪惡感
variations: 摩羯座的放鬆方式：規劃下一個更有效率的工作流程。
摩羯座說「我沒事」的時候，通常已經一個人扛了三件不關他的事。

en.content:
Why a Capricorn works so hard: so that resting on the weekend comes with a side of guilt to carry.

It's not that they can't relax — there's a progress bar in their head that never switches off. A Capricorn rarely admits they're tired, because they figure no one can help anyway, so they might as well grind through it quietly. That toughness is its own kind of tenderness — they're just used to putting themselves last.
en.editorNote: Send to the Capricorn friend who's always heads-down and secretly checks messages even on vacation. Remind them rest doesn't require guilt.
variations: A Capricorn's idea of relaxing: designing a more efficient workflow for next week.
When a Capricorn says 'I'm fine,' they're usually already carrying three problems that weren't even theirs.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius — lives in the future, logic over feelings, unique by default, emotionally elsewhere

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座的腦袋永遠活在三年後，身體卻忘了帶情緒一起出門。

你問他在想什麼，他可能在規劃一個拯救世界的計畫，也可能在想宇宙會不會其實是一台電腦。水瓶不是冷血，他只是把「邏輯」排在「感覺」前面，等他願意對你掏心，那是真的把你當自己人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個常常放空、講話跳tone卻又莫名其妙很有道理的水瓶朋友
variations: 水瓶座的怪不是裝出來的，是他真心覺得跟大家一樣才奇怪。
水瓶座可以一個人在房間裡想一整天，然後出來丟給你一句改變你人生觀的話。

en.content:
An Aquarius's brain lives three years into the future, while their body forgot to bring its emotions along for the trip.

Ask what they're thinking and it could be a plan to save the world, or whether the universe is secretly just a giant computer. An Aquarius isn't cold — they just file 'logic' ahead of 'feelings.' When they finally open up to you, it means they truly count you as one of their own.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aquarius friend who spaces out constantly and talks in tangents that somehow turn out to be deeply right.
variations: An Aquarius's weirdness isn't an act — they genuinely think being like everyone else is the strange part.
An Aquarius can sit alone in a room all day, then walk out and hand you one sentence that rearranges your whole worldview.

items.sourceNote: Pisces — dreamy, reality optional, feels everything deeply, emotional artist

zh-tw.content:
雙魚座的世界裡，現實是選配的，想像力才是標配。

他可以為一首歌哭、為一部電影難過一整天、也能在通勤的捷運上自己腦補完三集連續劇。雙魚的感受力強到自己都受不了，所以他學會了把情緒藏進溫柔裡——你以為他很好哄，其實他只是不想讓你擔心。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個容易感動、總是替別人著想到忘了照顧自己的雙魚朋友
variations: 雙魚座的內心戲多到可以拍一部電影，而且通常是悲劇收尾然後自己療傷。
雙魚座說「沒關係」的時候，多半是真的有關係，只是不想讓場面尷尬。

en.content:
In a Pisces's world, reality is optional — imagination is the standard package.

They'll cry over a song, stay sad about a movie all day, and mentally film three episodes of a drama series on the morning train. A Pisces feels things so intensely it overwhelms even them, so they've learned to tuck their emotions inside their gentleness. You think they're easy to comfort — really, they just don't want you to worry.
en.editorNote: Send to the Pisces friend who's moved to tears easily and looks after everyone else until they forget themselves.
variations: A Pisces's inner monologue has enough material for a feature film — usually a tragedy, and they handle the recovery alone.
When a Pisces says 'it's fine,' it usually isn't — they just don't want to make things awkward.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius — freedom addict, dangerous honesty, optimistic, class clown energy

zh-tw.content:
射手座最大的恐懼不是失敗，是被綁住。

你可以約他十次他答應九次，但真正能準時出現的看心情。射手的誠實有時候會誤傷路人——他不是故意的，他只是覺得「真話」比「客套」省事。跟射手相處久了你會發現，他的隨性底下藏著一顆超怕讓你失望、所以乾脆先把醜話講清楚的心。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個講話超直、行程永遠抓不準、但相處起來莫名其妙很自由的射手朋友
variations: 射手座的人生規劃就是：不要有規劃，這樣才有驚喜。
射手座說「我等等就到」的「等等」，是一個沒有單位的時間概念。

en.content:
A Sagittarius's biggest fear isn't failure — it's being tied down.

You can invite them ten times and they'll say yes to nine, but whether they actually show up on time depends on the vibe. A Sagittarius's honesty occasionally takes out an innocent bystander — not on purpose, they just find 'the truth' less effort than 'being polite.' Spend enough time with one and you'll see that under all that spontaneity is someone so afraid of letting you down that they'd rather get the awkward part over with up front.
en.editorNote: Send to the Sagittarius friend who's brutally direct, impossible to pin to a schedule, yet somehow makes everything feel freer.
variations: A Sagittarius's life plan is to have no plan — that way there's always a surprise.
When a Sagittarius says 'I'll be there in a bit,' the 'bit' is a unit of time with no fixed value.

items.sourceNote: Gemini — first to the party last to leave, then disappears for a week to recharge; both introvert and extrovert

zh-tw.content:
雙子座是派對裡第一個到、最後一個走的人，然後接下來一整個禮拜人間蒸發。

別擔心，他沒生氣也沒怎樣，他只是把社交電量一次用完，需要回去充電。雙子不是善變，是他腦袋裡同時開了十個分頁，每一個都是真心的他。你以為你認識他，其實你只認識他今天打開的那一頁。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一下超嗨一下又突然安靜消失、但你還是很愛跟他聊天的雙子朋友
variations: 雙子座可以同時對三件事充滿熱情，然後在隔天全部忘記，再對三件新的充滿熱情。
跟雙子座聊天的好處是永遠不無聊，缺點是你永遠跟不上他的話題跳了幾次。

en.content:
A Gemini is the first to arrive at the party and the last to leave — and then they vanish off the face of the earth for a full week.

Don't worry, they're not mad and nothing's wrong; they just spent their entire social battery in one go and need to recharge. A Gemini isn't fickle — they've got ten browser tabs open in their head at once, and every one of them is the real them. You think you know them, but you only know the tab they happened to open today.
en.editorNote: Send to the Gemini friend who's wildly hyped one moment and silently gone the next, but you still love chatting with anyway.
variations: A Gemini can be passionate about three things at once, forget all of them by tomorrow, then get passionate about three new ones.
The upside of talking to a Gemini is it's never boring; the downside is you can never tell how many times the topic just jumped.

items.sourceNote: Libra — switches between introvert and extrovert depending on situation, smiles while gritting teeth, avoids conflict, indecisive

zh-tw.content:
天秤座可以為了「中午吃什麼」糾結四十分鐘，最後說「都可以」。

他不是沒有意見，是他同時看到了每個選項的優缺點，公平到連自己都被卡住。天秤在人群裡能笑著炒熱全場，回家卻能安靜一整天——他是看場合切換的高手。那份「都可以」的背後，其實是怕選錯讓別人不開心。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠把「你決定就好」掛在嘴邊、其實超級在意你開不開心的天秤朋友
variations: 天秤座的選擇困難不是不會選，是他連「不選」這個選項都要先評估一下利弊。
天秤座表面上和氣，心裡其實有一座超精密的天平，正在默默幫所有人打分數。

en.content:
A Libra can agonize for forty minutes over 'what to have for lunch' and then conclude with 'anything's fine.'

It's not that they have no opinion — they see the pros and cons of every option so clearly, and so fairly, that they get stuck on their own balance. A Libra can light up a whole room in a crowd, then go quiet for an entire day at home — they're masters of switching modes by setting. Behind that 'anything's fine' is really a fear of choosing wrong and making someone unhappy.
en.editorNote: Send to the Libra friend who always says 'you decide' but secretly cares enormously whether you're happy.
variations: A Libra's indecision isn't an inability to choose — they even weigh the pros and cons of the option to 'not choose.'
A Libra seems easygoing on the surface, but inside there's a precision scale quietly grading everyone in the room.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius — most instinctively introverted sign, appears relatable/extroverted in short bursts but drained by too much company, needs space to process

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座在短時間內可以表現得超級好相處，甚至有點外向，讓你以為交到了新朋友。

但那是限量版的。聊太久他就會開始放空，然後找個理由先閃。水瓶不是高冷，是他的大腦需要獨處才能把剛剛那場社交「跑完一遍」——他得回去確認一下自己到底開不開心。你以為他在已讀不回，其實他在重新開機。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個明明聊起來很有趣、卻三不五時就人間蒸發去「思考人生」的水瓶朋友
variations: 水瓶座的社交模式是：短期高效，長期關機。
水瓶座最常說的話是「我想自己一個人靜一靜」，而且他是認真的。

en.content:
An Aquarius can come across as super easy to talk to — even a little extroverted — for a short while, and you'll think you just made a new friend.

But that's the limited edition. Talk too long and they'll start zoning out, then find a reason to slip away early. An Aquarius isn't aloof — their brain needs solitude to 'finish processing' that whole social session, to go back and confirm whether they actually enjoyed it. You think they're leaving you on read; really, they're rebooting.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aquarius friend who's genuinely fun to talk to but periodically vanishes to 'think about life.'
variations: An Aquarius's social mode: high efficiency short-term, fully powered off long-term.
An Aquarius's favorite line is 'I just need some time alone' — and they mean it.

items.sourceNote: Cancer — happily self-isolates in their shell but stays connected through emotional intuition; introvert who thrives on a close-knit circle

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座如果可以，會想一輩子待在自己的殼裡不出來。

但他不是孤僻——他只是把全部的能量留給那兩三個真正懂他的人。對外面的世界，他客氣但有距離；對自己人，他可以掏心掏肺到讓你受不了。巨蟹的殼不是用來躲你的，是用來保護那些他最在乎的東西，包括他自己那顆超級容易心軟的心。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個約出門很難、但只要你難過一定第一個出現的巨蟹朋友
variations: 巨蟹座的理想週末：待在家，旁邊有他愛的人，世界其他部分請自行運轉。
巨蟹座對外人是磨砂玻璃，對自己人是透明的——而且還會主動幫你蓋棉被。

en.content:
If a Cancer could, they'd happily spend their whole life inside their shell and never come out.

But they're not antisocial — they just save all their energy for the two or three people who truly get them. To the outside world they're polite but keep their distance; to their inner circle they'll pour their whole heart out until you can't handle it. A Cancer's shell isn't there to hide from you — it's there to protect the things they care about most, including that ridiculously soft heart of theirs.
en.editorNote: Send to the Cancer friend who's hard to drag out of the house but is always the first to show up when you're sad.
variations: A Cancer's ideal weekend: home, the people they love nearby, and the rest of the world kindly running itself.
A Cancer is frosted glass to strangers and transparent to their own people — and they'll tuck you in too.

items.sourceNote: Virgo — moderately introverted, not the life of the party but the one organizing details with precision, prefers one-on-one over crowds

zh-tw.content:
你問處女座為什麼一整晚都待在餐桌那邊？

因為零食盤歪了。

他把餅乾照大小排好，順手把飲料標籤全部轉向同一邊，然後才安心坐下。
剛剛你袖口那根脫線他也看到了，只是決定今天先不講，讓你玩得開心一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴上一直唸、卻把你的事記得比你還清楚的處女座朋友
variations: 處女座的愛是行動派：他不會說太多甜言蜜語，但他會把你隨口提過的小事全部記下來。
處女座在人群裡看起來很安靜，其實腦袋裡正在同步幫現場做一份待辦清單。

en.content:
You want to know why the Virgo spent the whole night by the snack table?

Because the platter was crooked.

They sorted the crackers by size, turned every drink label to face the same way, and only then sat down.
They also spotted the loose thread on your cuff — and decided not to mention it tonight, so you could enjoy yourself.
en.editorNote: Send to the Virgo friend who nags nonstop but somehow remembers your stuff better than you do.
variations: A Virgo's love is action-based: not many sweet words, but they've logged every little thing you mentioned in passing.
A Virgo looks quiet in a crowd, but their brain is busy drafting a live to-do list for the whole room.

items.sourceNote: Capricorn — disciplined, quietly ambitious long-game player; introverted and prone to overthinking made-up worst-case scenarios

zh-tw.content:
摩羯座的腦袋裡有九十九個問題，其中八十六個是他自己腦補出來、根本還沒發生的災難。

他表面上冷靜得像一塊石頭，內心其實正在把每一個最壞的結果都先預演一遍。摩羯不是悲觀，是他覺得「先準備好就不會被嚇到」。他不太說自己的目標，因為他寧願默默做完再讓結果說話——這種人通常笑得最少，但走得最遠。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看起來超穩、其實私底下煩惱一堆還都自己扛的摩羯朋友
variations: 摩羯座的人生策略：別人在衝刺，他在鋪路；十年後你才會發現他早就到了。
摩羯座不說「我很累」，他只會默默把事情做完，然後回家累到懷疑人生。

en.content:
A Capricorn has ninety-nine problems on their mind, and eighty-six of them are made-up disasters they've fully scripted that haven't even happened yet.

They look calm as a rock on the outside, but inside they're rehearsing every worst-case scenario in advance. A Capricorn isn't pessimistic — they just figure 'if I'm prepared, nothing can catch me off guard.' They rarely announce their goals, because they'd rather quietly finish and let the results talk. People like this smile the least but go the furthest.
en.editorNote: Send to the Capricorn friend who looks rock-solid but is privately carrying a mountain of worries alone.
variations: A Capricorn's life strategy: while everyone else sprints, they pave the road — ten years later you realize they arrived long ago.
A Capricorn won't say 'I'm exhausted.' They'll just quietly finish everything, then go home and question their entire existence.

items.sourceNote: Cancer season traits — sentimental hoarding, keeping mementos, ticket stubs, old messages

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座的抽屜裡有：五年前的電影票根、一張已經看不清字的紙條、某人送的一顆糖果的包裝紙。

你問他為什麼還留著，他也說不上來——只知道丟了會捨不得。對巨蟹來說，那不是垃圾，是「那一天我真的很快樂」的證據。他們捨不得的從來不是東西，是回不去的那個瞬間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 巨蟹座季節（6/21–7/22）正應景，傳給那個抽屜裡塞滿紀念品、怎麼勸都不肯丟的巨蟹朋友
variations: 巨蟹座最捨不得丟的不是東西，是「那時候的感覺」——所以他們家永遠有一個裝滿回憶的盒子。
巨蟹座的斷捨離永遠卡在同一步：拿起來、想起一段回憶、又放回去。

en.content:
Inside a Cancer's drawer you'll find: a movie ticket from five years ago, a note whose ink has faded past reading, and the wrapper from a single candy someone once gave them.

Ask why they still keep it and they can't quite explain — they just know they'd hate to throw it out. To a Cancer, it isn't junk. It's proof that 'on that day, I was really happy.' What they can't let go of was never the object. It's the moment they can't get back.
en.editorNote: Perfect for Cancer season (Jun 21–Jul 22). Send to the Cancer friend whose drawers are packed with keepsakes they refuse to toss no matter what.
variations: What a Cancer can't throw away isn't the thing — it's 'how it felt back then.' Which is why there's always one box of memories in their home.
A Cancer's decluttering always stalls at the same step: pick it up, remember a moment, put it back.

items.sourceNote: Cancer moodiness — Moon-ruled emotional shifts, laughing then crying, mood tied to the people around them

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座的情緒像月亮——會圓會缺，而且不一定準時。

上一秒還在笑，下一秒因為一句話突然安靜；不是他難搞，是他把周圍每個人的心情都接收得太清楚。你今天心情不好，他其實比你還先感覺到。巨蟹的敏感不是缺點，是他愛人的方式，只是有時候連他自己都關不掉這個開關。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個情緒起伏大、又特別會替別人著想的巨蟹朋友，讓他知道那份敏感有人懂
variations: 巨蟹座最累的一點：別人的情緒他都收得到，自己的卻常常不知道要往哪裡放。
跟巨蟹座相處的說明書只有一句：他的情緒跟月亮一樣有週期，你只要記得月亮從來沒有真的消失過。

en.content:
A Cancer's moods work like the moon — they wax, they wane, and they don't always keep to a schedule.

Laughing one second, gone quiet the next because of a single sentence. It's not that they're difficult. It's that they pick up on everyone's mood around them a little too clearly. If you're having a bad day, they usually felt it before you did. A Cancer's sensitivity isn't a flaw — it's how they love. They just can't always switch the receiver off.
en.editorNote: Send to the Cancer friend whose moods swing fast but who always looks out for everyone else — so they know that sensitivity is seen.
variations: The exhausting part of being a Cancer: they receive everyone else's emotions loud and clear, but rarely know where to put their own.
The whole manual for a Cancer is one line: their moods have phases, like the moon — and the moon never actually disappears.

items.sourceNote: Introvert vs extrovert zodiac signs replying to texts — I-types read and delay, E-types reply instantly

zh-tw.content:
各星座回訊息的方式：

E人星座（獅子、雙子、射手）：訊息還沒讀完就先打「哈哈哈」，回得比你傳得還快。

I人星座（巨蟹、處女、天蠍、水瓶）：已讀。在腦中把完整回覆打了三遍。都很滿意。一個字都沒送出去。

然後三小時後傳來一句：「欸剛剛在忙」——其實他只是需要一點時間，把想說的話整理成他敢送出去的樣子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳到你那個I人E人混雜的群組，看誰先跳出來認領
variations: I人回訊息的流程：讀、想、寫、刪、再想、放著、隔天回。E人回訊息的流程：讀、回。結束。
已讀不回不代表不在乎——對I人來說，那句話他可能已經在心裡回你二十次了。

en.content:
How the zodiac signs reply to texts:

Extrovert signs (Leo, Gemini, Sagittarius): Fire off 'hahaha' before they've even finished reading it. They reply faster than you can send.

Introvert signs (Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Aquarius): Read the message. Compose the full reply three times in their head. Happy with all three. Send zero of them.

Then three hours later: 'oh sorry, was busy' — when really they just needed time to shape what they wanted to say into something they were brave enough to send.
en.editorNote: Drop this in your mixed introvert/extrovert group chat and watch who claims which one first.
variations: An introvert's texting process: read, think, write, delete, rethink, leave it, reply tomorrow. An extrovert's: read, reply. Done.
Leaving a text on read doesn't mean they don't care — for an introvert, they've probably already replied to you twenty times in their head.

items.sourceNote: Cancer as the caretaker of the friend group — checks in privately, remembers everyone's problems, forgets to take care of self

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座是那個從來不會忘記問你「後來那件事怎麼樣了？」的朋友。

他記得你上週提過的煩惱，記得你不喜歡吃香菜，記得你哪天要面試——而且會默默傳一句「加油，我相信你」。他把每個人都照顧得好好的，唯一常常被忽略的，就是他自己。如果你身邊有這樣一個巨蟹，記得偶爾也回頭問一句：「那你呢？你還好嗎？」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給你身邊那個總是在照顧別人、卻很少讓別人照顧的巨蟹朋友
variations: 巨蟹座的超能力：記得所有人的小事。巨蟹座的弱點：以為自己不重要。
群組裡最溫暖的那個人，通常不是話最多的，是那個私訊你「你今天看起來怪怪的，還好嗎」的巨蟹。

en.content:
A Cancer is the friend who never forgets to ask, 'hey, how did that thing turn out?'

They remember the worry you mentioned last week, remember you hate cilantro, remember the day of your interview — and they'll quietly send a 'you've got this, I believe in you.' They take care of everyone so well. The only person who regularly slips through the cracks is themselves. If you have a Cancer like this in your life, remember to turn around every now and then and ask: 'and you? are you okay?'
en.editorNote: Send to the Cancer friend who's always taking care of everyone else but rarely lets anyone take care of them.
variations: A Cancer's superpower: remembering the little things about everyone. A Cancer's weak spot: assuming they don't matter.
The warmest person in the group chat usually isn't the loudest — it's the Cancer who DMs you 'you seemed a little off today, everything okay?'

items.sourceNote: Cancer and home comfort — would rather stay in, home as emotional safe base, declining plans to recharge

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座最理想的週末：不用出門、不用回訊息、燈調暗、窩在自己的角落，世界暫時關機。

他不是不喜歡你，他只是需要「回到自己的殼裡」充電。對巨蟹來說，家不只是一個地方，是一個可以卸下所有防備、不用當任何人的角色的安全區。你約他出門他說「下次啦」，不是敷衍——是他今天的電真的用完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一到週末就消失、只想待在家的巨蟹朋友，順便告訴他你懂
variations: 巨蟹座的極樂：一個人、在家、有零食、沒有行程、手機安靜。這就是他的度假村。
巨蟹座拒絕邀約不是討厭你，是他的社交電量顯示只剩百分之三，需要回家插電。

en.content:
A Cancer's ideal weekend: no going out, no replying to texts, lights dimmed, curled up in their own corner, the world switched off for a while.

It's not that they don't like you. They just need to 'retreat back into their shell' to recharge. To a Cancer, home isn't only a place — it's a safe zone where they can drop every defense and stop playing any role. When you invite them out and they say 'next time,' it's not a brush-off. Their battery genuinely hit empty today.
en.editorNote: Send to the Cancer friend who vanishes every weekend and just wants to stay home — and let them know you get it.
variations: Peak bliss for a Cancer: alone, at home, snacks within reach, nothing scheduled, phone on silent. That's their resort.
When a Cancer turns down your invite, it's not that they dislike you — their social battery is reading three percent and they need to go home and plug in.

items.sourceNote: Leo main-character energy — needs attention, secretly wants to be adored, life feels boring without them

zh-tw.content:
獅子座不是愛出風頭，他只是天生站在哪裡都像聚光燈自己打過來。

他嘴上說「不用特別為我慶祝」，但你要是真的沒準備，他會記到明年。獅子要的其實很簡單：被看見、被在乎、被誇一句「還是你最厲害」。承認吧，少了那個到哪都能把氣氛炒起來的獅子，這個群組真的會安靜到有點無聊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴硬說不用慶祝、心裡其實超期待的獅子朋友，附上一句「今天你最閃」
variations: 獅子座的謙虛是有上限的——你誇他三句他會客氣，你不誇他他會納悶你是不是眼睛有問題。
獅子座不需要全世界都喜歡他，他只需要在場的每一個人都知道他來了。

en.content:
A Leo isn't a show-off — they just happen to look like the spotlight followed them into the room.

They'll say 'you really don't need to make a fuss over me,' but if you actually don't, they'll remember it until next year. What a Leo wants is simple: to be seen, to be cared about, to hear 'honestly, you're the best.' Admit it — without the Leo who lights up every room, this group chat would be quiet enough to be kind of boring.
en.editorNote: Send to the Leo who insists on no fuss but is secretly counting on one — with a 'you're the brightest one today.'
variations: A Leo's humility has a ceiling — compliment them three times and they'll act modest; don't compliment them at all and they'll wonder what's wrong with your eyes.
A Leo doesn't need the whole world to love them. They just need everyone in the room to know they've arrived.

items.sourceNote: Scorpio intensity — reads everyone, says nothing, loyal but never forgets being crossed

zh-tw.content:
天蠍座在角落安靜地滑手機，看起來人畜無害——其實他早就把全場的關係、氣氛、還有誰在假笑都摸透了。

他話不多，不是沒想法，是覺得沒必要說。你對他好，他會記一輩子、加倍還你；你惹到他，他不吵不鬧，只是從此把你歸到「不再花心力」那一欄。天蠍不是難相處，他只是很清楚誰值得他掏心。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個平常安靜、但你知道絕對不能背叛的天蠍朋友
variations: 天蠍座的已讀不回分兩種：一種是在忙，一種是你已經被移出他的世界了——而且你分不出來是哪一種。
天蠍座不需要問問題，他光看你打字的速度就知道你在隱瞞什麼。

en.content:
A Scorpio sitting quietly in the corner on their phone looks completely harmless — meanwhile they've already read the room, mapped every relationship in it, and clocked exactly who's fake-smiling.

They don't say much, not because they have no thoughts, but because they don't see the point. Treat them well and they'll remember it forever and pay you back double. Cross them and they won't yell — they'll just quietly file you under 'no longer worth the energy.' A Scorpio isn't hard to get along with. They just know exactly who's worth opening up to.
en.editorNote: Send to the quiet Scorpio friend you know you should never, ever betray.
variations: A Scorpio's unanswered text comes in two flavors: they're busy, or you've been removed from their world — and you can't tell which.
A Scorpio doesn't need to ask questions. They can tell you're hiding something just from how fast you're typing.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius freedom-lover — disappears when responsibility appears, craves adventure, hates being tied down

zh-tw.content:
射手座的手機定位永遠是「移動中」。你問他在哪，他自己有時候也不太確定。

一講到出去玩他秒回，一講到要負責任他訊息就沉入海底。這不是不可靠，是他的靈魂真的關不住——把射手綁在同一個地方太久，他會像被關起來的風，整個人失去光澤。你要愛一個射手，就別問他「我們的未來規劃」，改問他「下一站要去哪」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠在計畫下一趟旅行、卻總逃避長期承諾的射手朋友
variations: 射手座的行事曆只有兩種狀態：空白，或塞滿了說走就走的行程。中間值不存在。
叫射手座「安定下來」，跟叫風「站著別動」是差不多的難度。

en.content:
A Sagittarius's location is permanently set to 'in transit.' Ask where they are and honestly, sometimes they're not sure either.

Mention a trip and they reply in one second; mention responsibility and their message sinks to the bottom of the ocean. It's not that they're unreliable — their soul genuinely can't be caged. Keep a Sagittarius tied to one place too long and they'll go dull, like wind locked in a room. If you want to love a Sagittarius, don't ask about 'our five-year plan.' Ask them where the next stop is.
en.editorNote: Send to the Sagittarius friend forever planning their next trip while dodging any long-term commitment.
variations: A Sagittarius's calendar has two settings: totally blank, or packed with spontaneous plans. There is no middle.
Telling a Sagittarius to 'settle down' is about as effective as telling the wind to stand still.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius — most instinctively introverted, values deep conversation over small talk, happy alone with a few close people

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座可以跟你聊外星文明、平行宇宙、人為什麼會做夢聊到半夜——但你問他「今天天氣不錯齁」，他會愣三秒不知道怎麼接。

他不是冷漠，是對「沒有內容的社交」真的沒電。水瓶要的朋友不用多，一兩個能一起深夜聊怪問題的就夠了。你以為他孤僻，其實他只是在自己的世界裡活得很自在——那裡不吵、不用假裝，還隨時歡迎懂他的人進來坐坐。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個不愛寒暄、但一聊起有趣的話題就停不下來的水瓶朋友
variations: 水瓶座的社交模式：閒聊零分，深夜哲學十萬分。
水瓶座一個人不叫寂寞，叫終於可以好好想事情了。

en.content:
An Aquarius will talk to you until 2am about alien civilizations, parallel universes, and why people dream — but say 'nice weather today, huh?' and they'll freeze for three seconds, genuinely unsure how to respond.

It's not coldness. They just have zero battery for content-free small talk. An Aquarius doesn't need many friends — one or two people to trade weird late-night questions with is plenty. You think they're a loner, but really they're just perfectly content in their own world — quiet, no pretending required, and always open to the people who actually get them.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aquarius friend who hates chit-chat but won't stop once you hit an interesting topic.
variations: An Aquarius's social settings: small talk, zero out of ten; late-night philosophy, a hundred thousand out of ten.
An Aquarius alone isn't lonely — it's finally getting to think in peace.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 天蠍座不是難搞，只是把信任放在很深的地方——一旦你走進去，他們會替你守住那道門一輩子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在星座專頁貼文，或送給重感情的天蠍朋友當生日留言。
variations: 天蠍的冷淡是一種篩選：留下來的人，才配看見他們最柔軟的那面。
別誤會天蠍的沉默，那是他們正在決定要不要把你放進心裡。

en.content: A Scorpio isn't hard to love—they just keep trust in a deep place. Once you're inside, they'll guard that door for you for life.
en.editorNote: Great as a zodiac-page caption or a birthday note for a fiercely loyal Scorpio friend.
variations: A Scorpio's cold shoulder is really a filter—only the ones who stay get to see how soft they are.
Don't read a Scorpio's silence as distance. That's just them deciding whether to let you all the way in.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 雙子座的腦袋像同時開了三十個分頁，每個都很重要，每個都還沒讀完——但至少他們永遠不無聊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合當雙子朋友的自嘲式生日祝福，或社群趣味星座圖文。
variations: 跟雙子聊天像轉電視頻道，話題一直換，但你就是捨不得離開沙發。
雙子不是善變，只是他們的好奇心跑得比決定快一步。

en.content: A Gemini's brain runs thirty tabs at once—all important, none finished loading. But hey, at least they're never boring.
en.editorNote: Works as a playful birthday line for a Gemini friend or a fun zodiac social post.
variations: Talking to a Gemini is like channel-surfing: the topic keeps changing, but you never want to leave the couch.
A Gemini isn't flaky—their curiosity just runs a step ahead of their decisions.

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content: 摩羯座不太說夢想，因為他們忙著把夢想拆成待辦清單，然後一項一項默默劃掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合送給正在拚事業的摩羯朋友，當作打氣或年度回顧文案。
variations: 摩羯的浪漫，是把「我會撐住」變成一件你根本不用擔心的事。
別人還在許願的時候，摩羯已經在存錢、排程、動工了。

en.content: A Capricorn doesn't talk much about dreams—they're too busy breaking them into a to-do list and quietly checking off one line at a time.
en.editorNote: A good pick-me-up for a hardworking Capricorn friend, or a year-in-review caption.
variations: A Capricorn's idea of romance is turning 'I've got you' into something you never have to worry about.
While everyone else is still wishing, a Capricorn is already saving, scheduling, and getting to work.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius group chat behavior — joins many chats but lurks silently, reads everything, replies to nothing

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座同時待在十個群組裡，
每一則都看，一則都不回。

他不是已讀不回——
他是把「參與感」跟「發言」當成兩件完全不同的事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳到那個永遠有人已讀卻沒人回的群組，配一句「說的就是你吼」
variations: 水瓶座的群組哲學：我知道發生了什麼事，這樣就夠了，至於回不回，看心情。
水瓶座潛水潛得很深，但你以為他不在，他其實什麼都知道。

en.content:
An Aquarius is in ten group chats at once.
Reads every message. Replies to none.

It's not that they're ignoring you—
they just filed 'being present' and 'actually saying something' under totally separate categories.
en.editorNote: Drop this in the group chat where everyone reads and no one replies, with a 'yeah, we see you.'
variations: An Aquarius group-chat philosophy: I know what's going on, and that's enough. Replying is optional.
You think an Aquarius has gone quiet. Actually they've read everything and formed opinions.

items.sourceNote: Gemini texting habit — sends a burst of messages in a row as thoughts arrive faster than they can type

zh-tw.content:
雙子座傳訊息不會只傳一則，
他會傳一則、補一則、想到又一則、然後再更正前面那則。

你手機還沒亮完，他已經講到第三個話題了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個訊息永遠一次跳出五條的雙子朋友，他會回你六條
variations: 跟雙子聊天像在追直播——訊息一直來，你永遠慢半拍。
雙子座不是話多，是腦袋比手指快，手指又比你回覆的速度快。

en.content:
A Gemini never sends just one text.
One message, then a follow-up, then a new thought, then a correction to the first one.

Your phone's still lighting up and they've already moved on to topic number three.
en.editorNote: Send to the Gemini friend whose texts always arrive in bursts of five. They'll reply with six.
variations: Texting a Gemini is like watching a livestream—the messages keep coming and you're always a beat behind.
A Gemini isn't chatty. Their brain just runs faster than their thumbs, and their thumbs run faster than your replies.

items.sourceNote: Cancer texting behavior — sends random caring 'thinking of you' check-ins, emotionally attuned

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座會在你什麼都沒說的時候，
突然傳一句「你最近還好嗎」。

他不是無聊——
他是感覺到你有點不對勁，只是你自己還沒發現。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個總在你低潮時剛好出現的巨蟹朋友，說聲謝謝
variations: 巨蟹座的雷達永遠開著，你笑得再自然，他還是會多問一句「真的沒事？」
別人已讀你的訊息，巨蟹已讀你的心情。

en.content:
A Cancer will text you 'hey, you doing okay?'
out of nowhere, when you haven't said a thing.

They're not bored—
they sensed something was off before you even noticed it yourself.
en.editorNote: Send to the Cancer friend who always shows up right when you're low, just to say thanks.
variations: A Cancer's radar is always on. No matter how natural your smile looks, they'll still ask 'you sure you're okay?'
Other people read your texts. A Cancer reads your mood.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius texting energy — keeps countless chats alive, can't stand going a day without messaging everyone

zh-tw.content:
射手座覺得一天不傳訊息給認識的每個人，
就好像世界少了他一角。

他能同時養活五個群組、三段私訊、還有兩個「等等再回」的對話——
而且每一個他都是真心的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個永遠有力氣揪你出門的射手朋友，順便問他今天約去哪
variations: 射手座的訊息列表像機場航班表：永遠有東西在起飛，永遠沒有停過。
別人怕已讀不回，射手怕的是沒人可以聊。

en.content:
To a Sagittarius, going a whole day without texting everyone they know
feels like the world is missing a piece.

They can keep five group chats, three DMs, and two 'I'll reply later' threads alive at once—
and mean every word in all of them.
en.editorNote: Send to the Sagittarius friend who always has the energy to drag you out, then ask where you're going today.
variations: A Sagittarius's message list is like an airport departures board: something's always taking off, and it never stops.
Other people fear being left on read. A Sagittarius fears having no one to talk to.

items.sourceNote: Virgo stress response — the overthinker supreme, runs endless mental checklists, turns small imperfections into anxiety

zh-tw.content:
處女座壓力大的時候不會崩潰大哭，
他會安靜地坐著，然後在腦中把整件事重播十七遍。

每一遍都在找「是不是我哪裡沒做好」——
即使那件事根本不是他的錯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個總是自己扛下所有責任的處女朋友，跟他說「這次真的不是你的問題」
variations: 處女座的焦慮不是來自事情做不完，是來自「萬一有個細節被我漏掉怎麼辦」。
別人壓力大會找人抱怨，處女座壓力大會先檢討自己。

en.content:
When a Virgo is stressed, they don't break down and cry.
They sit quietly and replay the whole thing seventeen times in their head.

Every replay is hunting for 'what did I do wrong'—
even when it was never their fault to begin with.
en.editorNote: Send to the Virgo friend who always shoulders the blame, and remind them: this one really isn't on you.
variations: A Virgo's anxiety isn't about running out of time. It's the 'what if I missed one tiny detail' that keeps them up.
Other people vent when they're stressed. A Virgo audits themselves first.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius stress response — hard to let anything get to them, ruled by Jupiter's optimism, brushes stress off

zh-tw.content:
同樣一件爛事，別人壓力大到睡不著，
射手座的反應是：「那我們去吃個宵夜吧。」

他不是不在乎——
只是他很早就發現，煩惱到天亮，事情也不會自己變好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個總能把你從情緒泥沼裡拖出去透氣的射手朋友
variations: 射手座的抗壓能力來自一個信念：「船到橋頭自然直，橋沒了就跳下去游。」
別人在原地內耗，射手已經打包好情緒出發下一站了。

en.content:
Same bad news. Other people lose sleep over it,
and a Sagittarius goes, 'cool, let's grab a late-night snack.'

It's not that they don't care—
they just figured out early that worrying till sunrise never fixed anything.
en.editorNote: Send to the Sagittarius friend who always drags you out of your own head for some air.
variations: A Sagittarius's stress tolerance runs on one belief: it'll work out, and if the bridge is gone, they'll just swim.
While everyone else spirals in place, a Sagittarius has already packed up their feelings and left for the next stop.

items.sourceNote: Gemini stress response — most stressed sign due to indecisiveness, copes by distraction and juggling many things at once

zh-tw.content:
雙子座壓力大的時候，會突然同時開始學吉他、報名健身房、
研究要不要轉職、還順便重新整理房間。

他不是精力太多——
是他不敢停下來，因為一停下來就得面對那個他不想做的決定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個一焦慮就瘋狂找事做的雙子朋友，提醒他偶爾也可以什麼都不做
variations: 雙子座逃避壓力的方式，是製造更多讓自己忙起來的壓力。
別人壓力大想躺平，雙子壓力大想開分身。

en.content:
When a Gemini is stressed, they'll suddenly start learning guitar, sign up for a gym,
research a career change, and reorganize their whole room—all at once.

It's not that they have too much energy.
It's that stopping means facing the one decision they've been dodging.
en.editorNote: Send to the Gemini friend who spins up ten new projects the second they're anxious. Remind them it's okay to do nothing sometimes.
variations: A Gemini's way of avoiding stress is to manufacture more stress that keeps them too busy to feel it.
Other people want to lie flat when they're stressed. A Gemini wants to clone themselves.

items.sourceNote: Cancer stress response — most emotional water sign, releases stress by crying, needs to feel it fully to move on

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座處理壓力的SOP，時間軸如下。

晚上十一點，躲進被窩，哭。
凌晨十二點半，起來洗臉，換掉哭皺的枕頭套。
早上八點，若無其事地把昨天的爛攤子一件一件收好。

他很清楚，情緒不先流乾，事情就理不清。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個習慣自己一個人消化情緒的巨蟹朋友，跟他說哭完記得跟你講一聲
variations: 巨蟹座的眼淚是重開機鍵，哭完就滿血回歸。
別人壓力大會爆炸，巨蟹壓力大會先關機，靜靜地把自己修好。

en.content:
A Cancer's standard procedure for stress, on a timeline.

11 p.m. — under the covers, crying.
12:30 a.m. — up, face washed, tear-crumpled pillowcase swapped out.
8 a.m. — cleaning up yesterday's mess, piece by piece, like nothing happened.

They know the feelings have to drain out first, or nothing gets sorted.
en.editorNote: Send to the Cancer friend who always processes their emotions alone, and tell them to text you once the crying's done.
variations: A Cancer's tears are the reset button — cry it out, come back at full health.
Other people explode under stress. A Cancer powers down first, then quietly repairs themselves.

items.sourceNote: Leo traits — needs attention, big personality, dramatic when ignored

zh-tw.content:
獅子座不是愛出風頭——
他只是覺得，一個場子要是沒有他，那氣氛也太可惜了。

你可以不同意他，但拜託不要無視他。
對獅子座來說，被討厭都比被當空氣好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一進場就自帶聚光燈的獅子朋友，他會說「本來就是這樣啊」
variations: 獅子座最大的恐懼不是失敗，是全場的人都在聊天，沒有一個人在看他。
獅子座的邏輯：可以輸，可以錯，但不能安靜。

en.content:
A Leo isn't a show-off—
they just think any room without them in the spotlight is a bit of a waste.

You're allowed to disagree with them. Just please don't ignore them.
For a Leo, being disliked still beats being treated like furniture.
en.editorNote: Send to the Leo friend who walks in with their own spotlight. They'll just say 'Obviously.'
variations: A Leo's biggest fear isn't failing. It's a whole room full of people chatting and not one of them looking at them.
Leo logic: they can lose, they can be wrong, but they cannot be quiet.

items.sourceNote: Virgo traits — perfectionist, can't relax until details are fixed, overthinking

zh-tw.content:
處女座的放鬆，是先把整個房間整理好、把明天的行程排好、把所有可能出錯的地方預想一遍之後——
然後才有辦法坐下來。

他不是龜毛，他只是沒辦法在一團亂裡面假裝沒事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個歪掉一張桌墊就會坐立難安的處女朋友，附註「先深呼吸」
variations: 處女座嘴上說「都可以」，心裡已經默默把三個方案的優缺點列成表格了。
叫處女座別想太多，等於叫魚別游泳——生理上做不到。

en.content:
A Virgo relaxes by first tidying the whole room, planning tomorrow's schedule, and mentally rehearsing everything that could possibly go wrong—
and only then can they sit down.

They're not fussy. They just can't pretend everything's fine while sitting in a mess.
en.editorNote: Send to the Virgo friend who can't sit still if one placemat is crooked. Add: 'Breathe first.'
variations: A Virgo says 'anything works,' but they've already built a spreadsheet weighing the pros and cons of all three options.
Telling a Virgo to stop overthinking is like telling a fish to stop swimming—biologically impossible.

items.sourceNote: Libra traits — indecisive, hates deadlines and commitment, weighs everything

zh-tw.content:
會讓天秤座當場當機的三個詞：
決定、承諾、截止日。

他不是不會選，他是同時看得到兩邊的好，
然後在「都想要」跟「怕選錯」之間，卡了整整一個下午。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個問他要吃什麼會回你「都可以你決定」的天秤朋友
variations: 天秤座點餐流程：認真研究菜單十分鐘，最後點跟隔壁桌一樣的。
天秤座不是沒有主見，是他的主見有兩個，而且吵得不可開交。

en.content:
Three words that make a Libra freeze on the spot:
decision, commitment, deadline.

It's not that they can't choose. It's that they see the upside of both sides,
so they spend the whole afternoon stuck between 'I want both' and 'what if I pick wrong.'
en.editorNote: Send to the Libra friend who answers 'anywhere's fine, you decide' every single time.
variations: A Libra's ordering process: study the menu for ten minutes, then get the same thing as the table next to them.
A Libra isn't opinion-less. They have two opinions, and the two are having a fight.

items.sourceNote: Scorpio traits — intense, brutally honest, either silent or tells the full truth

zh-tw.content:
跟天蠍座相處只有兩種狀態：
要嘛他一句話都不說，要嘛他把真相整包倒給你。

沒有中間值。
因為他覺得，講一半的真話，比說謊還要沒禮貌。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個要嘛安靜要嘛一針見血的天蠍朋友，附註「我需要的是溫柔版」
variations: 天蠍座的沉默不是沒意見，是他正在決定要不要讓你承受得住那個意見。
問天蠍座真心話大冒險，記得先想清楚——他真的會講。

en.content:
There are only two modes when dealing with a Scorpio:
either they say nothing at all, or they hand you the whole truth in one go.

No in-between.
Because to them, a half-told truth is ruder than an outright lie.
en.editorNote: Send to the Scorpio friend who's either silent or devastatingly blunt. Add: 'I'd like the gentle version, please.'
variations: A Scorpio's silence isn't a lack of opinion. They're deciding whether you can handle the opinion.
Play truth or dare with a Scorpio only if you're ready—they will actually tell you the truth.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius traits — freedom-loving, restless, allergic to being tied down

zh-tw.content:
射手座答應你「我一定到」的意思是：
如果那天沒有臨時想去別的地方的話。

他不是不重視你，
是他連自己下一秒想幹嘛都不敢保證。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠說走就走、行程排了也隨時會改的射手朋友
variations: 綁住射手座最快的方法，就是告訴他「你一定要留下來」——然後看他下一秒消失。
射手座的行事曆是用鉛筆寫的，因為每一格都隨時可能被擦掉重來。

en.content:
When a Sagittarius promises 'I'll definitely be there,' what they mean is:
unless something more interesting comes up that day.

It's not that they don't care about you.
It's that they can't even guarantee what they'll want to do in the next five minutes.
en.editorNote: Send to the Sagittarius friend who's always ready to bolt and reschedules plans on a whim.
variations: The fastest way to lose a Sagittarius is to tell them 'you have to stay'—then watch them vanish.
A Sagittarius writes their calendar in pencil, because every slot might get erased and redone at any moment.

items.sourceNote: Leo contrast trait — commanding at work, secretly craves affection in relationships

zh-tw.content:
獅子座在職場：氣場全開，講話有份量，一進會議室大家自動安靜。

獅子座在感情裡：一句「你今天怎麼都沒理我」就能讓他瞬間退化成一隻求摸頭的貓。

威風是演給外人看的，撒嬌是留給你一個人的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在外面超罩、回到你面前秒變小孩的獅子，附註「我知道你的秘密」
variations: 獅子座的威嚴有效期限，只到他喜歡的人出現為止。
別被獅子座的霸氣騙了，他只是還沒遇到能讓他撒嬌的人。

en.content:
Leo at work: full presence, every word lands, the room goes quiet the second they walk in.

Leo in a relationship: one 'why have you been ignoring me all day' and they instantly melt into a cat begging for head pats.

The power act is for everyone else. The clinginess is for you alone.
en.editorNote: Send to the Leo who runs the room at work but turns into a kid the moment they're with you. Add: 'I know your secret.'
variations: A Leo's authority has an expiration date—it ends the moment their favorite person walks in.
Don't be fooled by a Leo's swagger. They just haven't met the person they'll get needy for yet.

items.sourceNote: Gemini contrast trait — the loud gossip hub of the group who is secretly deeply sensitive

zh-tw.content:
雙子座在聚餐上是全場的八卦發布中心，笑話一個接一個，冷場了大家就等他救。

沒人知道的是，回到家關上門，他會為一句無心的話反覆想到半夜。

最會炒熱氣氛的人，往往也最容易被氣氛裡的一個眼神弄傷。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個在群組裡最吵、私訊裡卻突然很安靜的雙子，讓他知道你有看見另一面
variations: 雙子座能同時跟五個人聊天，卻沒辦法跟自己的情緒好好聊一次。
雙子座的嘴巴很快，心思更快——快到連他自己都追不上。

en.content:
At a dinner, a Gemini is the group's gossip headquarters—jokes on tap, and when things go quiet everyone waits for them to rescue it.

What nobody sees: once the door closes at home, they'll replay one careless comment until 2 a.m.

The person best at lighting up a room is often the one most easily bruised by a single look inside it.
en.editorNote: Send to the Gemini who's loudest in the group chat but suddenly quiet in your DMs. Let them know you see the other side.
variations: A Gemini can hold five conversations at once but can't sit down for one honest talk with their own feelings.
A Gemini's mouth is fast, but their mind is faster—too fast for even them to keep up.

items.sourceNote: Cancer contrast trait — cold and distant at first, becomes the goofiest one once close

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座剛認識的時候：高冷、話少、看起來很難搞。

熟了之後：全場最吵、最會亂、笑點最低的那一個。

那層殼不是用來拒人，是用來確認你值不值得看見裡面那個很傻很暖的自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一開始你以為很難親近、後來卻變超好笑的巨蟹，寫「還好我有耐心」
variations: 巨蟹座的高冷只是試用版，通過測試的人才能解鎖搞笑正式版。
對巨蟹座來說，願意在你面前變笨，就是最高等級的信任。

en.content:
When you first meet a Cancer: cold, quiet, seems like a lot of work.

Once they trust you: the loudest, silliest, easiest-to-crack-up person in the room.

The shell isn't there to keep people out. It's there to check whether you're worth showing the goofy, warm self hiding inside.
en.editorNote: Send to the Cancer you once thought was unapproachable who turned out hilarious. Add: 'Good thing I was patient.'
variations: A Cancer's cold front is just the trial version. Pass the test and you unlock the full goofball edition.
For a Cancer, being willing to act dumb in front of you is the highest form of trust.

items.sourceNote: Virgo trait — nitpicking as a hidden love language, introvert who shows care through details

zh-tw.content:
處女座不會跟你說「我很在乎你」，
他只會說：「你外套沒帶，等等會冷。」「這家你上次說不好吃，我們換一間。」「你昨天沒睡好對不對。」

他挑剔的每一個細節，其實都是他偷偷記住你的證據。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴上一直唸、卻把你的事記得比誰都清楚的處女座，讓他知道你都懂
variations: 處女座愛一個人的方式，就是把你隨口說過的每句話，默默列成待辦清單。
被處女座嫌，有時候是全世界最溫柔的一種被在乎。

en.content:
A Virgo will never tell you 'I care about you.'
They'll say: 'You forgot your jacket, you'll be cold later.' 'You said this place was bad last time—let's go somewhere else.' 'You didn't sleep well yesterday, did you.'

Every little thing they nitpick is quiet proof they've been paying attention to you.
en.editorNote: Send to the Virgo who nags nonstop but remembers your life better than anyone. Let them know you get it.
variations: A Virgo's way of loving you is quietly turning every offhand thing you said into a to-do list.
Getting nitpicked by a Virgo is sometimes the gentlest way in the world to be cared about.

items.sourceNote: Leo trait — main character energy, extrovert who needs the spotlight but craves genuine validation

zh-tw.content:
獅子座走進一個場合，不是加入氣氛，是把氣氛整個接管過來。

他們看起來超有自信，其實比誰都需要被看見——不是被崇拜，是被真的懂。

那個站在舞台中央發光的人，散場後最怕的是沒有人問他：「你今天還好嗎？」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看起來天不怕地不怕、其實很想被關心的獅子朋友，寫一句「你今天還好嗎」就夠了
variations: 獅子座的自信是真的，玻璃心也是真的，兩個可以同時存在，別懷疑。
對獅子座來說，掌聲很好聽，但有一個人記得他不開心過，更難得。

en.content:
When a Leo walks into a room, they don't join the vibe—they take it over.

They look impossibly confident, but they need to be seen more than anyone—not worshipped, actually understood.

The one glowing at center stage? After everyone leaves, their biggest fear is that nobody asks, 'Hey, are you okay today?'
en.editorNote: Send to the Leo who acts fearless but secretly wants to be checked on. Just 'Hey, you okay today?' is enough.
variations: A Leo's confidence is real, and so is the glass heart underneath. Both exist at once—don't second-guess it.
Applause sounds great to a Leo, but one person remembering they were sad matters more.

items.sourceNote: Scorpio trait — guarded, slow to trust, all-in loyalty once you're let in

zh-tw.content:
天蠍座的信任清單，比夜市抽獎中頭獎還難擠進去。

他們對你冷淡，不是討厭你，是還在觀察你會不會是下一個讓他後悔的人。

但一旦讓你進去了，他會用一種你自己都沒發現的方式，默默把你放在最重要的位置。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一開始很難靠近、後來卻對你死心塌地的天蠍，讓他知道你有感覺到那份重量
variations: 天蠍座不是冷，是把熱都留給少數幾個通過審核的人。
被天蠍座信任這件事，你可能要花一年才會發現，然後花一輩子都不想辜負。

en.content:
Getting onto a Scorpio's trust list is harder than winning the grand prize at a night-market raffle.

When they're cold to you, it's not dislike—they're still watching to see if you'll be the next person they regret.

But once you're in, they'll quietly put you at the top of the list in a way you won't even notice.
en.editorNote: Send to the Scorpio who was hard to approach but ended up fiercely loyal. Let them know you feel the weight of it.
variations: A Scorpio isn't cold—they just save all their warmth for the few who passed the vetting.
It might take you a year to realize a Scorpio trusts you, then a lifetime of not wanting to blow it.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius trait — no filter, freedom-loving extrovert whose bluntness hides real kindness

zh-tw.content:
射手座沒有濾鏡功能，出廠就沒裝。

他們講話直到你有時候會想「你是不是欠罵」，但轉頭又會發現，全場只有他敢在你難過的時候戳破你在逞強。

那些直白，其實是一種懶得跟你演戲的溫柔。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個講話很欠揍、關鍵時刻卻最挺你的射手朋友，配一句「還好有你這張破嘴」
variations: 射手座的自由不是不在乎你，是相信真的重要的人不用綁著也不會走。
射手座傷人的話通常是真話，暖心的話也是真話——他只是不會包裝。

en.content:
A Sagittarius shipped from the factory with no filter installed.

They're so blunt you'll sometimes think 'are you asking for a fight,' but then you notice they're the only one brave enough to call out that you're faking being fine.

That bluntness is just kindness that couldn't be bothered to put on an act with you.
en.editorNote: Send to the Sagittarius whose mouth gets them in trouble but who always has your back. Add: 'Glad your loud mouth is on my side.'
variations: A Sagittarius's freedom isn't a lack of care—it's trusting that the people who matter won't leave even without a leash.
A Sagittarius's harsh words are usually true. So are their sweet ones. They just don't gift-wrap either.

items.sourceNote: Libra trait — people-pleasing peacekeeper who struggles to voice their own needs

zh-tw.content:
天秤座最會的是照顧全場的情緒，最不會的是照顧自己的。

「都可以」「你決定就好」「我沒關係」——這三句話講久了，連他自己都忘記真正想要什麼。

他不是沒有意見，是太怕自己的意見會讓氣氛變得不好看。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是配合別人、卻很少說自己想法的天秤，主動問他「那你呢？你想怎樣？」
variations: 天秤座的公平是給全世界的，唯獨忘了分一點給自己。
下次天秤座說「都可以」的時候，多問一句，他其實偷偷有答案。

en.content:
A Libra is a master at managing everyone else's mood and terrible at managing their own.

'Whatever works,' 'you decide,' 'I don't mind'—say those enough and even they forget what they actually want.

It's not that they have no opinion. They're just scared their opinion might make the vibe awkward.
en.editorNote: Send to the Libra who always goes along with everyone but rarely speaks up. Then actually ask them: 'And you? What do you want?'
variations: A Libra hands out fairness to the whole world and forgets to save any for themselves.
Next time a Libra says 'whatever works,' ask one more time—they secretly have an answer.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius introvert trait — seems social in short bursts but people-time drains them fast

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座是那種聊十分鐘讓你以為他超好聊，聊兩小時他已經在心裡回家三趟的人。

他不是討厭你，是他的社交電量只有一格，而且不能快充。

下次他突然安靜下來，別擔心，那不是冷場，是他在後台重開機。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個聚會聊一聊就默默消失的水瓶朋友，他大概正躺在家裡慶幸終於下線
variations: 水瓶座的熱情是限量版，用完就要一個人關機充電，急不得。
水瓶座能瞬間跟你很熟，也能瞬間需要離開現場，這兩件事同時成立。

en.content:
An Aquarius will chat for ten minutes and make you think they're the easiest person alive—chat for two hours and they've mentally gone home three times.

It's not that they don't like you. Their social battery just has one bar and no fast charging.

Next time they go quiet, don't panic. That's not an awkward lull—it's them rebooting in the background.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aquarius friend who quietly vanishes halfway through a party. They're probably home already, relieved to be offline.
variations: An Aquarius runs on a limited-edition kind of warmth—use it up and they need to power down alone. No rushing it.
An Aquarius can click with you instantly and need to leave instantly. Both are true at the same time.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius extrovert trait — friendliest sign, will make small talk with anyone, restless energy

zh-tw.content:
射手座跟便利商店店員聊到對方知道他家的貓叫什麼，三分鐘後說「那我先走了」。

他說世界上每個地方都很有趣，可惜沒有一個地方值得停下來太久。

想留住射手，最好的方法是別留。
你越不追，他越常自己晃回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠在計畫下一趟旅行、坐不住的射手，問他「這次又要去哪」
variations: 射手座的浪漫是「我隨時可以出發」，行李永遠只收一半是因為他根本沒打算固定在哪。
射手座能跟任何人聊得很開心，但別誤會，那不代表他會留下來。

en.content:
A Sagittarius will chat with the convenience store clerk until the clerk knows their cat's name, then announce "okay, heading out" three minutes later.

They'll tell you everywhere is interesting, and nowhere is worth stopping for very long.

The best way to keep a Sagittarius is to not hold on.
The less you chase, the more often they wander back on their own.
en.editorNote: Send to the restless Sagittarius who's always planning the next trip. Ask them: 'So where to this time?'
variations: A Sagittarius's version of romance is 'I could leave any minute.' Their bag is half-packed because they never planned to settle anywhere.
A Sagittarius can have a blast talking to anyone. Don't read too much into it—it doesn't mean they'll stick around.

items.sourceNote: Pisces overthinking texter — reads a short reply as rejection, agonizes over every emoji

zh-tw.content:
雙魚座收到一個「嗯」，能腦補出一部三集完結的內心小劇場：他是不是生氣了？我是不是說錯話？還是他其實根本不想理我？

真相通常只是對方在忙，沒空打字。

雙魚座不是玻璃心，是他把一個標點符號都當成情緒訊號在解讀。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為一則已讀不回煩惱一整晚的雙魚，提醒他「對方可能只是在洗澡」
variations: 雙魚座選一個貼圖的時間，足夠別人回三則訊息了——因為每個貼圖背後都有他的隱藏含意。
雙魚座能從一句「好喔」讀出十種語氣，可惜每一種都是他自己嚇自己。

en.content:
A Pisces gets a one-word 'k' and immediately spins up a three-episode inner drama: Are they mad? Did I say something wrong? Or do they just not want to talk to me?

The truth is usually just that the other person was busy and didn't have time to type.

A Pisces isn't fragile. They just read every single punctuation mark as an emotional signal.
en.editorNote: Send to the Pisces who spends a whole night stewing over a left-on-read. Remind them: 'They were probably just in the shower.'
variations: The time a Pisces spends picking one sticker is enough for anyone else to send three texts—because every sticker carries a hidden meaning.
A Pisces can read ten different tones into a simple 'sure.' Sadly, all ten are just them scaring themselves.

items.sourceNote: Capricorn group chat trait — replies in a full structured paragraph, ignores off-topic chatter

zh-tw.content:
群組吵得沸沸揚揚，摩羯座通常不出聲，等到真的要決定事情，他一則訊息丟出來，分點、有結論、附時間地點，直接結束討論。

他不是冷漠，是那些閒聊他真的沒興趣參與，但正事他一個字都不會漏。

摩羯座的沉默不是已讀不回，是他在等一個值得回的重點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個群組裡平常潛水、關鍵時刻一發定江山的摩羯，謝謝他每次都幫大家收尾
variations: 摩羯座在群組裡的角色是「最後那個把話講完的人」，前面一百則廢話他一則都沒點開。
別看摩羯座在群組很安靜，真的要辦事的時候，全靠他那則有條理的長訊息。

en.content:
The group chat is going wild and a Capricorn stays silent—until an actual decision needs making. Then they drop one message: bullet points, a clear conclusion, time and place attached, discussion over.

It's not that they're cold. They genuinely have zero interest in the small talk, but they won't miss a single word of the real business.

A Capricorn's silence isn't leaving you on read. They're just waiting for something worth replying to.
en.editorNote: Send to the Capricorn who lurks in the group chat and then settles everything in one shot. Thank them for always wrapping things up.
variations: A Capricorn's role in the group chat is 'the one who says the final word.' They didn't open a single one of the hundred pointless messages before it.
Don't mistake a quiet Capricorn for a checked-out one—when things actually need doing, everyone relies on that one organized wall of text.

items.sourceNote: Gemini texting trait — types a whole message then deletes it, dual-mode communicator

zh-tw.content:
雙子座打字打了一大段，讀三遍，覺得這樣講會不會太over，然後全部刪掉，最後只回一個「哈哈」。

他不是話少，是腦子裡同時有五個版本的回覆在打架，選哪個都覺得不太對。

雙子座的「已讀不回」，其實是他回了又刪、刪了又打的三十分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個訊息永遠打了半天卻只送出兩個字的雙子，跟他說「你原本想講的那段我想聽」
variations: 雙子座能同時經營三個對話、想六件事、然後在最重要那則訊息前面卡住十分鐘。
別以為雙子座秒回代表沒在想，他只是刪掉的比送出的還多。

en.content:
A Gemini types out a whole paragraph, reads it three times, decides it might be too much, deletes all of it, and replies with a single 'haha.'

It's not that they're quiet. There are five versions of the reply fighting in their head and none of them feels quite right.

What looks like a Gemini leaving you on read is actually thirty minutes of typing, deleting, and typing again.
en.editorNote: Send to the Gemini who spends forever on a text and sends two words. Tell them: 'I actually want to hear the part you deleted.'
variations: A Gemini can run three conversations at once, juggle six thoughts, and then freeze for ten minutes before the one message that matters.
Don't assume a fast-replying Gemini isn't overthinking—they just delete more than they send.

items.sourceNote: Aries money habit — impulsive 'see it, want it, bought it' spender, decides before questioning

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座的購物流程只有兩步：看到、下單。
中間那個「我需要嗎」的思考環節，被他直接跳過了。

他不是亂花錢，他只是覺得猶豫太久，喜歡的東西就被別人買走了。

牡羊座的錢包沒有存款，只有一堆「當下真的很想要」的證據。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠在跟你分享剛剛手滑買了什麼的牡羊，順便問他這個月第幾次手滑
variations: 牡羊座的理財觀：能用錢解決的煩惱，就在三秒內解決掉，反正之後再賺。
問牡羊座「這個要不要買」根本是多此一舉，他問你的時候通常已經在結帳頁面了。

en.content:
An Aries shopping process has two steps: see it, buy it.
The 'do I actually need this' step in the middle? Skipped entirely.

It's not that they're reckless. They just figure that if they hesitate too long, someone else will grab the thing they wanted.

An Aries wallet holds no savings—just a pile of receipts proving they really wanted it in the moment.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aries who keeps texting you what they just impulse-bought. Ask how many times that's been this month.
variations: An Aries money philosophy: any problem money can fix gets fixed in three seconds. They'll earn it back later.
Asking an Aries 'should I buy this' is pointless—by the time they ask you, they're already on the checkout page.

items.sourceNote: Scorpio money habit — keeps finances private, strategic long-term thinker, rarely impulsive

zh-tw.content:
你永遠不會知道天蠍座存了多少錢。
他可能穿著三年前的衣服，卻默默在你看不到的地方布好了局。

天蠍座花錢不衝動，因為他早就在腦中演算過這筆錢十年後的樣子。

別人的財務是攤在陽光下的帳單，天蠍座的財務是一個沒人破解得了的保險箱。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個從來不聊自己薪水、卻總是最有底氣的天蠍朋友，他只會神秘一笑
variations: 天蠍座不是不花錢，他只是每一筆都算過報酬率，連請你喝的那杯咖啡都在計畫內。
問天蠍座存款有多少，跟問他祕密一樣——你問了也白問，他有一百種方式含糊帶過。

en.content:
You'll never know how much a Scorpio has saved.
They might be wearing a shirt from three years ago while quietly setting up moves you can't see.

A Scorpio doesn't spend on impulse, because they've already run the math on what that money becomes in ten years.

Other people's finances are bills laid out in the open. A Scorpio's finances are a safe nobody's cracking.
en.editorNote: Send to the Scorpio who never discusses their salary but always seems the most secure. They'll just smile mysteriously.
variations: It's not that a Scorpio won't spend—they've calculated the return on every dollar, including the coffee they bought you.
Asking a Scorpio how much they've saved is like asking their secrets: you'll get a hundred ways of not answering.

items.sourceNote: Taurus anger — bites tongue, internalizes, explodes only after built-up resentment, slow to cool

zh-tw.content:
金牛座生氣的時候不會馬上翻臉，
他會先忍，忍到你以為沒事了，然後在某個你完全想不到的時間點一次爆發。

那個「一次爆發」，其實是他默默記了三個月的帳。

金牛座不記仇，他只是把每一件小事都好好收在心裡，等一個剛好的日子拿出來算。
zh-tw.editorNote: 如果你身邊的金牛突然翻舊帳，別驚訝——那些帳他早就一筆一筆記好了，傳這則讓他知道你懂
variations: 金牛座的怒氣像慢燉鍋，你以為滅火了，其實它在底下悶了很久很久。
別以為金牛座沒生氣，他只是還沒到把三個月份的委屈一次講完的那天。

en.content:
A Taurus doesn't snap the moment they're angry.
They hold it in, hold it until you think everything's fine, then blow up at a moment you'd never see coming.

That 'sudden' explosion is actually three months of quietly kept receipts.

A Taurus doesn't hold grudges—they just tuck every small thing away carefully, waiting for the right day to add it all up.
en.editorNote: If your Taurus friend suddenly brings up old grievances, don't be surprised—they logged every one. Send this so they know you get it.
variations: A Taurus's anger is a slow cooker: you think you put out the fire, but it's been simmering underneath for a long, long time.
Don't assume a Taurus isn't mad—they just haven't reached the day where they lay out three months of grievances at once.

items.sourceNote: Leo anger — goes beyond anger into rage, roars loudly, feels better the louder they are

zh-tw.content:
獅子座生氣不會躲起來，他會讓全世界都知道。
聲音越大、氣勢越足，他心裡反而越舒坦。

但你只要看他吼完，通常五分鐘後就沒事了——因為他要的其實不是贏，是被聽見。

獅子座的怒吼像雷陣雨，來得又急又猛，走得也乾乾淨淨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個生氣起來全辦公室都聽得到、但轉頭就忘的獅子，跟他說「你其實只是想被重視吧」
variations: 獅子座的生氣沒有暗示這種東西，他要嘛不氣，要嘛讓你完全不用猜。
別怕獅子座吼你，真正該擔心的是他安靜下來、連看都不看你的時候。

en.content:
A Leo doesn't hide when they're angry—they let the whole world know.
The louder they get, the more fired up they are, the better they actually feel.

But watch them: five minutes after the roar, it's usually over—because what they wanted wasn't to win, it was to be heard.

A Leo's anger is a thunderstorm: it hits fast and hard, then clears right up.
en.editorNote: Send to the Leo whose anger echoes through the whole office but is forgotten minutes later. Tell them: 'You just want to feel valued, huh.'
