variations: A Leo's anger doesn't do subtle hints—either they're fine, or you won't have to guess for a second.
Don't fear a Leo yelling at you. Worry when they go quiet and won't even look your way.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius money habit — spends on experiences (trips, festivals) over things, finds saving boring

zh-tw.content:
射手座的錢不是拿來存的，是拿來換體驗的。
一張說走就走的機票、一場臨時決定的音樂祭，對他來說比銀行數字實在多了。

你勸他存錢，他會反問你：「存那麼多，然後呢？」

射手座的富有不在戶頭裡，在他手機那三千張到處亂跑的照片裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個戶頭永遠見底、但去過的地方比誰都多的射手，順便問他下一站要去哪
variations: 射手座的購物車裡沒有東西，只有一堆機票和活動門票。
叫射手座存錢，就像叫他別呼吸——他不是不會，是覺得那樣活著很無聊。

en.content:
A Sagittarius's money isn't for saving—it's for trading in on experiences.
A last-minute plane ticket, a festival they decided on that morning: those feel far more real than a number in a bank account.

Tell them to save, and they'll ask you back: 'Save it all up, and then what?'

A Sagittarius's wealth isn't in their account—it's in the three thousand photos on their phone from everywhere they've been.
en.editorNote: Send to the Sagittarius whose account is always near empty but who's been more places than anyone. Ask where they're headed next.
variations: A Sagittarius's shopping cart has no products in it—just a pile of plane tickets and event passes.
Telling a Sagittarius to save money is like telling them to stop breathing. They can, they just think living that way is boring.

items.sourceNote: Aries — impulsive prankster energy, acts first and thinks never

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座傳訊息的順序是這樣的：
先按送出，再開始想剛剛到底打了什麼。

別人是三思而後行，牡羊座是行了之後看要不要三思一下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個常常訊息已讀秒回、然後又補一句「等等我剛剛在說什麼」的牡羊朋友
variations: 牡羊座的道歉都很真誠，因為他們自己也是事情發生之後才知道原來會這樣。

en.content:
The order in which an Aries sends a text:
Hit send first, then start figuring out what they just typed.

Other people look before they leap. An Aries leaps, then decides whether looking was worth it.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aries who replies in half a second and then adds 'wait, what was I even saying'
variations: An Aries apology is always sincere, because they found out what would happen at the exact same moment you did.

items.sourceNote: Taurus — deadpan sarcasm, refuses to move once comfortable

zh-tw.content:
金牛座一旦在沙發上找到那個最舒服的姿勢，
就算天塌下來，也是等姿勢不舒服了再處理。

他們不是懶，只是很清楚起身的成本有多高。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友喊你出門、但你已經躺平的時候，附上一句「懂的都懂」
variations: 叫金牛座起來拿一下遙控器，他會先評估：這個節目有難看到值得我起身嗎？

en.content:
Once a Taurus finds the perfect spot on the couch,
the sky could fall and they'd deal with it after the position gets uncomfortable.

It's not laziness. They just have a very accurate estimate of what standing up costs.
en.editorNote: Send when someone's begging you to go out but you've already achieved horizontal perfection
variations: Ask a Taurus to grab the remote and they'll first calculate: is this show bad enough to justify me standing up?

items.sourceNote: Pisces — overanalyzes ancient texts, lives half in a dream world

zh-tw.content:
雙魚座此刻的心情，
有一半是為了現實中的事，另一半是為了三年前那則沒回的訊息。

他們可以一邊洗碗，一邊在腦中演完一整部電影，主角是自己，配樂也是自己選的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個常常放空、你叫他名字要叫第三次才會回神的雙魚朋友
variations: 雙魚座的世界一半是現實一半是幻想，而他們最喜歡待的，永遠是幻想那一半。

en.content:
A Pisces's current mood:
half about something real, half about a text they never answered three years ago.

They can wash the dishes while playing an entire movie in their head—starring themselves, with a soundtrack they picked out too.
en.editorNote: Send to the Pisces who spaces out so hard you have to say their name three times
variations: A Pisces's world is half reality, half fantasy—and the half they love living in is always the fantasy one.

items.sourceNote: Capricorn — workaholic who treats rest as a scheduled task

zh-tw.content:
摩羯座連放鬆都要排進行事曆，
不然那段時間他們會慌，覺得自己是不是浪費了什麼。

你說「你休息一下啦」，他聽到的是「請你有效率地休息，並在時間內回到崗位」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個週末也在偷看工作訊息、還說「我只是確認一下」的摩羯朋友
variations: 摩羯座的休假不是不工作，是換一個沒有人打擾的地方，安靜地把工作做完。

en.content:
A Capricorn has to schedule relaxation into their calendar,
otherwise that free time makes them panic that they're wasting something.

You say 'just take a break,' and what they hear is 'please rest efficiently and return to your post on time.'
en.editorNote: Send to the Capricorn who checks work messages on weekends and insists 'I'm just glancing at it'
variations: A Capricorn's vacation isn't about not working. It's finding a quieter place where nobody bothers them while they finish the work.

items.sourceNote: Leo — confident to the point of clingy, needs to be the main character

zh-tw.content:
獅子座不是愛出風頭，
只是走進任何一個場合，他都自動預設自己是主角。

他們表面上超有自信，其實只要你三小時沒回訊息，內心已經演完一齣「他是不是不愛我了」的大戲。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴巴很兇、其實超級需要被秒回的獅子朋友，他會假裝生氣但偷偷開心
variations: 獅子座的自信是真的，玻璃心也是真的——兩個可以同時存在，而且通常一起爆發。

en.content:
A Leo isn't a show-off,
they just walk into any room already cast as the main character.

They look unshakably confident, but leave them on read for three hours and they've already performed a full one-act play titled 'Do They Not Love Me Anymore.'
en.editorNote: Send to the Leo who acts tough but secretly needs to be texted back instantly—they'll fake annoyance and quietly love it
variations: A Leo's confidence is real. So is the fragile ego. Both exist at once, and they usually go off together.

items.sourceNote: Scorpio — all-or-nothing intensity, no middle ground

zh-tw.content:
天蠍座的世界只有兩種模式：
全心全意，或是完全消失。

他們沒有「還好」這個選項——喜歡一個人可以喜歡到掏心掏肺，一旦決定放手，也能安靜到讓你以為從沒認識過他。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個對你忽冷忽熱、其實只是還在決定要不要全押的天蠍
variations: 天蠍座不記仇，他們只是把每一件事都記得很清楚而已——這兩個聽起來一樣，但天蠍會告訴你不一樣。

en.content:
A Scorpio's world runs on two settings only:
all in, or completely gone.

There's no 'meh' option—they'll love you with everything they've got, and the moment they decide to let go, they'll go so quiet you'll wonder if they ever knew you at all.
en.editorNote: Send to the Scorpio who runs hot and cold on you—really they're just still deciding whether to go all in
variations: A Scorpio doesn't hold grudges. They just remember everything with perfect clarity. Sounds the same—but a Scorpio will insist it isn't.

items.sourceNote: Libra — can't say no, too many mental tabs open, chronic indecision

zh-tw.content:
天秤座腦中永遠開著十二個分頁，
每一個都是「等等再決定」，然後就到了半夜。

你問他要吃什麼，他說「都可以」——這不是隨和，這是他真的已經想到當機了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠說「你決定就好」、但你決定了他又猶豫的天秤朋友
variations: 天秤座最難的不是做決定，是拒絕別人——他寧可自己委屈，也不想看到任何人不開心。

en.content:
A Libra always has twelve tabs open in their head,
every one of them labeled 'decide later,' and suddenly it's midnight.

Ask them where they want to eat and they say 'anywhere's fine'—that's not being easygoing, that's their brain genuinely crashing from too many options.
en.editorNote: Send to the Libra who always says 'you pick,' then hesitates the second you actually pick
variations: The hardest thing for a Libra isn't making a decision—it's saying no. They'd rather quietly suffer than watch anyone be unhappy.

items.sourceNote: Virgo — quietly fixes everything, perfectionist who won't ask for credit

zh-tw.content:
處女座從來不會說「我幫你弄好了」。

你只會發現：遙控器回到桌角，充電線繞成一圈，杯子把手全部朝右。

他挑剔的對象其實是那個「明明可以更好卻沒有」的細節。
很不巧，那個細節通常住在你身上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴上碎念、手卻已經默默幫你收好桌面的處女朋友
variations: 處女座的愛藏在細節裡：記得你不吃香菜、幫你把充電線繞好、在你還沒發現之前就把問題解決掉。

en.content:
A Virgo will never say "I fixed it for you."

You'll just notice the remote back in its corner, the charging cable coiled, every mug handle pointing right.

What they're actually nitpicking is that one detail that could have been better and wasn't.
Unfortunately, that detail usually lives on you.
en.editorNote: Send to the Virgo who grumbles under their breath while already tidying your desk for you
variations: A Virgo's love hides in the details: remembering you hate cilantro, coiling your charging cable, fixing the problem before you even noticed it existed.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius — freedom-loving, spontaneous, allergic to being tied down

zh-tw.content:
射手座答應你「一定會去」的意思是：
如果那天沒有更好玩的事、沒有臨時想去的地方、心情剛好也對。

他不是不重視你——他只是把「自由」放在行事曆的每一格裡，包括本來要陪你的那一格。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠說走就走、卻總在最後一刻放你鴿子的射手朋友
variations: 射手座的人生規劃只有一句話：「先去了再說，回不來就當定居。」

en.content:
When a Sagittarius says 'I'll definitely be there,' what they mean is:
unless something more fun comes up, or they suddenly feel like going somewhere else, or the vibe just isn't right that day.

It's not that they don't care about you—they just penciled 'freedom' into every slot on the calendar, including the one that was supposed to be for you.
en.editorNote: Send to the Sagittarius who's always down for a spontaneous trip but bails on you at the last second
variations: A Sagittarius's entire life plan is one sentence: 'Just go first, and if I can't make it back, I guess I live there now.'

items.sourceNote: Capricorn — quietly ambitious, overthinks imaginary scenarios, plays the long game

zh-tw.content:
摩羯座表面上冷靜自律，
腦子裡其實正在為一件三年後、而且大概率不會發生的事煩惱。

他們不是悲觀——只是提前把所有最壞的可能都演練過一遍，這樣真的發生時就不用慌。通常都沒發生。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看起來最穩、其實半夜還在腦內開災難模擬會議的摩羯朋友
variations: 摩羯座不說「我做不到」，他只會默默把目標拆成一百個步驟，然後一個一個熬過去。

en.content:
A Capricorn looks calm and disciplined on the outside,
while inside they're stressing over something that's three years away and probably won't even happen.

They're not pessimists—they just rehearse every worst-case scenario in advance so they won't panic if it comes true. It usually doesn't.
en.editorNote: Send to the Capricorn who seems the most put-together but is secretly running disaster simulations at 2 a.m.
variations: A Capricorn never says 'I can't do it.' They just quietly break the goal into a hundred steps and grind through them one at a time.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius — independent thinker, values ideas over crowds, gets drained by too much socializing

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座可以跟你聊三小時的宇宙、AI 和人生意義，
然後回家後三天不想回任何訊息。

他們不是難搞——他們只是需要大量獨處來消化剛剛那些「太多人」的能量。跟你聊得來，跟人群聊不來，這兩件事同時成立。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個聊起來很投機、但已讀你三天才回的水瓶朋友，他不是不理你
variations: 水瓶座的社交電量只夠用一次，用完就要離線充電，而且充電時請勿打擾。

en.content:
An Aquarius can talk to you for three hours about the universe, AI, and the meaning of life,
then go home and ignore every message for three days.

They're not difficult—they just need a lot of alone time to process all that 'too many people' energy. Clicking with you and clicking with crowds are two completely separate things, and both can be true at once.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aquarius who's fascinating to talk to but leaves you on read for three days—it's not personal
variations: An Aquarius's social battery is single-use. Once it's dead, they go offline to recharge—and please do not disturb during charging.

items.sourceNote: Leo — natural spotlight, confident, secretly needs to be seen and appreciated

zh-tw.content:
獅子座走進任何一個場合，
不用開口，整個房間的重心就自動偏過去了。

他們的自信不是演出來的，是一種生活方式——但別被騙了，那顆看起來最強的心，其實最需要有人真心說一句「你很棒」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個看起來最不需要被誇、其實最吃這一套的獅子朋友
variations: 獅子座可以自己撐起全場的氣氛，但回到家還是會偷偷希望，有一個人記得問他今天累不累。

en.content:
A Leo walks into any room,
and without saying a word, the whole place quietly tilts toward them.

Their confidence isn't an act—it's a lifestyle. But don't be fooled: the heart that looks the strongest is the one that most needs someone to genuinely say, 'You're amazing.'
en.editorNote: Send to the Leo who seems like they need praise the least but secretly lives for it
variations: A Leo can carry the energy of an entire room, but back home they still quietly hope someone remembers to ask if they're tired.

items.sourceNote: Pisces — dreamy, emotionally deep, lives halfway between reality and imagination

zh-tw.content:
雙魚座的一天有一半活在現實，
另一半活在他自己編的劇情裡——通常那半比較精彩。

他們可以為一部電影哭到隔天，也能為一句無心的話難過一整週。不是玻璃心，是他們把每一種情緒都感受得比別人深一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個常常放空、其實正在腦內上映一整部電影的雙魚朋友
variations: 雙魚座記得的不是你說了什麼，是你說那句話的時候，讓他有什麼感覺。

en.content:
A Pisces spends half their day in reality,
and the other half in a storyline they've written themselves—usually the second half is more interesting.

They can cry over a movie until the next morning and stay sad for a week over one offhand comment. It's not that they're fragile—they just feel every emotion a little deeper than everyone else.
en.editorNote: Send to the Pisces who's always spacing out—really they're premiering a whole film in their head
variations: A Pisces doesn't remember what you said. They remember how you made them feel when you said it.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius — friendliest sign, will small-talk with anyone, freedom-loving extrovert

zh-tw.content:
射手座可以在便利商店排隊三分鐘，
就跟前面那個陌生人交換完人生故事、加了 IG、約好下次一起爬山。

他們不是自來熟——是真的覺得，世界上每一個人都可能是下一段冒險的入口。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個帶你出門一趟、回來多認識五個朋友的射手，他會覺得這很正常
variations: 射手座最怕的不是孤單，是被困住——你可以拿走他很多東西，但別拿走他隨時可以出發的自由。

en.content:
A Sagittarius can wait three minutes in a checkout line
and come out having swapped life stories with the stranger ahead, followed them on IG, and planned a hike together.

They're not overly familiar—they genuinely believe every person they meet could be the doorway to the next adventure.
en.editorNote: Send to the Sagittarius who takes you out once and comes home with five new friends—to them this is normal
variations: A Sagittarius doesn't fear being alone. They fear being stuck. Take a lot from them, but never take the freedom to leave whenever they want.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius — one of the most introverted signs, drained by too much socializing, needs alone time to recharge

zh-tw.content:
晚上九點的水瓶座：在派對中央笑到彎腰。

晚上十一點的水瓶座：在回家的車上，一句話都不想講。

社交電量已經到紅字，他需要一個人待著，才有辦法把剛剛消耗掉的自己慢慢充回來。
別急著問他怎麼了，明天他就會自己冒出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個聚會很嗨、隔天卻人間蒸發的水瓶朋友——他只是在充電，明天就回來了
variations: 水瓶座說「我想自己靜一靜」的時候，是進廠維修中，別急著把他從洞裡挖出來。

en.content:
An Aquarius at 9 p.m.: doubled over laughing in the middle of the party.

An Aquarius at 11 p.m.: not one word the entire ride home.

The social battery is flashing red, and they need to be alone to slowly refill whatever the night spent.
Don't rush to ask what's wrong — they'll resurface tomorrow on their own.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aquarius who's the life of the party and then vanishes the next day — they're recharging, back tomorrow
variations: When an Aquarius says 'I just need some time alone,' they're in the shop for maintenance. Don't dig them out of the cave too soon.

items.sourceNote: Capricorn — disciplined, quietly ambitious, plays the long game, blunt honesty

zh-tw.content:
摩羯座不會跟你說「加油你可以的」，
他會直接把問題拆成五個步驟，然後說：「先做第一個，剩下的做完再擔心。」

他們的浪漫是務實的——別人給你打氣，摩羯給你一個真的能走出去的計畫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個嘴上很冷、卻默默幫你把整件事都想好的摩羯朋友
variations: 摩羯座玩的是長線：現在看起來很無聊，五年後你會發現他早就贏在那些沒人看見的日子裡。

en.content:
A Capricorn won't tell you 'you've got this, keep going.'
They'll break your problem into five steps and say, 'Do the first one. Worry about the rest after it's done.'

Their kind of romance is practical—other people hand you a pep talk, a Capricorn hands you a plan that actually gets you out the door.
en.editorNote: Send to the Capricorn who sounds cold but has quietly mapped out your entire situation for you
variations: A Capricorn plays the long game. It looks boring now, but in five years you'll realize they already won on all the days nobody was watching.

items.sourceNote: Libra — indecisive, harmony-seeking, terrible poker face, hates conflict

zh-tw.content:
問天秤座想吃什麼，是全世界最殘忍的問題。

「都可以」不是敷衍——是他真的在腦內開了一場公聽會，把每一間店的優缺點都認真辯論過，最後累到說：算了你決定。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個點餐要想二十分鐘、最後跟你點一樣的天秤朋友
variations: 天秤座的臉是全宇宙最爛的撲克牌——他嘴上說沒事，但那個表情已經把「其實有事」寫在額頭上了。

en.content:
Asking a Libra what they want to eat is the cruelest question on earth.

'Anything's fine' isn't laziness—they genuinely held a full public hearing in their head, seriously debated the pros and cons of every restaurant, and finally got so tired they said, 'You know what, you decide.'
en.editorNote: Send to the Libra who takes twenty minutes to order and then just gets whatever you're having
variations: A Libra has the worst poker face in the universe—they'll say 'I'm fine,' but that expression already spelled out 'actually, not fine' across their forehead.

items.sourceNote: Scorpio — intense, private, remembers everything, all-or-nothing loyalty

zh-tw.content:
天蠍座對你好的時候，是把整顆心都壓上去的那種好；
但只要你越過那條線一次，他不會吵、不會鬧，只會安靜地把你歸檔，然後從此當作不認識。

他們記得每一件事——記得你對他的好，也記得你以為他沒發現的那次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個平常話不多、但你知道絕對不能背叛的天蠍朋友
variations: 天蠍座的愛沒有中間值：要嘛全部給你，要嘛一點都不剩。所謂的冷淡，其實是他曾經太認真過的證據。

en.editorNote: Send to the Scorpio who's quiet most of the time but you know you can never betray
variations: A Scorpio's love has no middle setting: all of it, or none of it. What looks like coldness is just proof of how seriously they once cared.

items.sourceNote: Aries apology style — direct, fast, wants to move on immediately

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座的道歉只有三秒：「對不起，我錯了，那我們晚餐吃什麼？」

不是不真心，是他真的覺得事情講開了就結束了。
你還在整理情緒，他已經在看外送菜單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個吵完架五分鐘就跑來找你聊天、好像什麼都沒發生的牡羊朋友
variations: 牡羊座不是不會道歉，是道歉完就想立刻翻頁。留在原地反覆討論這件事，對他來說比認錯還痛苦。

en.content:
An Aries apology lasts about three seconds: "I'm sorry, I was wrong, so what are we eating tonight?"

It's not insincere—they genuinely think the moment it's said out loud, it's over.
You're still processing. They're already scrolling the takeout menu.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aries who shows up five minutes after a fight acting like nothing happened
variations: Aries can absolutely apologize—they just want to turn the page the second they do. Sitting in the aftermath hurts them more than admitting fault.

items.sourceNote: Taurus travel habits — slow to get ready, chronic overpacker, comfort-first

zh-tw.content:
跟金牛座出去玩，行李箱裡一定有：三件根本不會穿到的外套、自己的枕頭套、還有「以防萬一」的泡麵。

他不是愛帶東西，他是無法接受「在外面過得比家裡差」這件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 旅行群組裡貼給那個永遠最晚打包好、但東西最齊全的金牛
variations: 金牛座出門前的準備時間，可以拿來看完一部電影。但真的少了什麼的時候，全隊都會回頭找他。

en.content:
Travel with a Taurus and their suitcase will contain: three jackets they'll never wear, their own pillowcase, and instant noodles "just in case."

They're not hoarders. They just refuse to accept living worse on the road than they do at home.
en.editorNote: Drop this in the group chat aimed at the Taurus who packs last but packs everything
variations: The time a Taurus spends getting ready to leave is roughly one feature film. But the second someone forgets something, the whole group turns to them.

items.sourceNote: Cancer — over-apologizes, people pleaser, apologizes to keep the peace

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座會為了一件不是他的錯的事道歉三次，
然後回家再自己重播一次現場，想說「那時候我是不是可以講得更好」。

他的「對不起」通常翻譯成：我不想讓這裡的氣氛壞掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 現在正是巨蟹座季節尾聲，傳給那個總是先低頭的巨蟹朋友，順便叫他別再自責
variations: 巨蟹座道歉的次數，跟他實際做錯的次數，從來就不成比例。

en.content:
A Cancer will apologize three times for something that wasn't their fault,
then go home and replay the whole scene wondering if they could've phrased it better.

Their "sorry" usually translates to: I just didn't want the mood in here to break.
en.editorNote: Cancer season is wrapping up—send this to the Cancer who always caves first, and tell them to stop blaming themselves
variations: The number of times a Cancer apologizes has never once matched the number of times they were actually wrong.

items.sourceNote: Gemini travel — curious, city-lover, indecisive planner, talks to everyone

zh-tw.content:
雙子座排行程可以排出五個版本，然後當天早上全部推翻，臨時跟著路邊看起來很好玩的人潮走。

他不是沒計畫，他是計畫太多，多到自己也選不出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在旅遊揪團的群組，配上那個一直改共筆行程表的雙子
variations: 跟雙子座去旅行，最好玩的部分永遠是行程表上沒寫的那幾個小時。

en.content:
A Gemini will build five versions of the itinerary, then scrap all of them that morning to follow a crowd that looked interesting down the street.

It's not that they didn't plan. They planned so much they couldn't pick one.
en.editorNote: Perfect for the trip-planning group chat, aimed at the Gemini who keeps editing the shared doc
variations: On a trip with a Gemini, the best part is always the few hours that were never on the schedule.

items.sourceNote: Pisces travel — impulsive, light packer, dreamy, last-minute plans

zh-tw.content:
雙魚座的旅行計畫是：買了機票，然後就沒有了。

行李隨便塞，住哪還沒訂，但他已經先在腦中演完整趟旅程——海邊的風、某個轉角的咖啡店、還有一段不知道會不會發生的偶遇。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是說走就走、卻每次都玩得比誰都盡興的雙魚朋友
variations: 雙魚座出發前什麼都沒準備，唯一準備好的是心情。而通常，那才是旅行真正需要的東西。

en.content:
A Pisces travel plan is: buy the ticket. That's the whole plan.

Bag thrown together, nowhere booked, but they've already lived the entire trip in their head—wind off the water, some café around a corner, and a chance encounter that may or may not happen.
en.editorNote: Send to the Pisces friend who books on a whim and somehow always has the best time
variations: A Pisces packs nothing but the right mood. Which, honestly, is the one thing a trip actually requires.

items.sourceNote: Aries competitiveness — turns everything into a contest, action-first, quick to rematch

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座可以把任何事都變成比賽——連排隊結帳，都要偷偷觀察隔壁那排移動的速度。

他不是好勝，他只是覺得「有輸有贏」的人生比較有精神。輸了也沒關係，反正下一場馬上就開始。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個連走路都要走贏你的牡羊朋友，他看完大概會說「哪有，只是剛好走比較快」
variations: 跟牡羊座玩任何遊戲，就算是抽鬼牌，他也會認真到像在打世界盃。

en.content:
An Aries can turn anything into a competition—even the grocery checkout, secretly clocking how fast the next lane is moving.

It's not that they need to win. They just think life has more energy when there's a score. And losing's fine—the next round starts right away.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aries who has to out-walk you on the sidewalk. They'll say, 'I'm not racing, I just walk fast.'
variations: Play any game with an Aries—even Go Fish—and they'll take it as seriously as a World Cup final.

items.sourceNote: Taurus spending contradiction — thrifty on small things, generous on comfort and food

zh-tw.content:
金牛座會為了一個十塊錢的運費猶豫半小時，然後眼睛都不眨地花五百塊吃一頓好的。

他不是小氣，也不是亂花——他只是很清楚什麼東西值得，什麼東西是浪費。而「讓自己舒服」，永遠在值得那一欄。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個為了湊免運買一堆用不到的東西、卻捨得對自己好的金牛朋友
variations: 金牛座的省錢哲學：能省的地方省到極致，該花的地方一毛都不手軟。

en.content:
A Taurus will agonize for half an hour over a $2 shipping fee, then drop fifty bucks on a good meal without blinking.

It's not stinginess, and it's not reckless—they just know exactly what's worth it and what's a waste. And 'being comfortable' is always in the worth-it column.
en.editorNote: For the Taurus who adds junk to the cart to hit free shipping, but never skimps on treating themselves
variations: A Taurus money rule: cut every corner that can be cut, spend freely on the ones that can't.

items.sourceNote: Libra conflict-avoidance — peacemaker who goes silent, politely passive-aggressive when hurt

zh-tw.content:
天秤座吵架的方式，是完全不吵。

他會笑笑地說「沒事」，然後把手機翻面、把情緒收好，安靜到你以為真的沒事——其實他只是不想讓場面難看，寧可自己憋著。

等你發現他在生氣，通常已經是三天後，從一句超級有禮貌的話裡聽出來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠在當和事佬、卻從來不說自己受傷的天秤朋友，記得順便問問他到底怎麼了
variations: 天秤座不是不會生氣，他只是把生氣包裝得太有禮貌，禮貌到你完全沒發現。

en.content:
The way a Libra argues is by not arguing at all.

They'll smile, say 'it's fine,' flip the phone face-down, tuck the feelings away—so calm you assume it really is fine. Really, they just don't want a scene, so they'd rather sit on it.

By the time you realize they're upset, it's usually three days later, decoded from one suspiciously polite sentence.
en.editorNote: Send to the Libra who's always the peacemaker but never admits they got hurt—then actually ask how they're doing
variations: A Libra isn't incapable of anger. They just wrap it so politely you never notice it's there.

items.sourceNote: Aries enthusiasm — starts many hobbies, sincere every time, moves on quickly

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座房間現況盤點：

吉他一把，買了三天，弦還是原廠的。
水彩一整組，未拆封，盒子上有灰。
健身滑輪一台，上禮拜信誓旦旦要天天用，目前用來掛外套。

而他每一次都真心以為這次會不一樣。那份真心，比堅持還珍貴一點點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個興趣多到自己都記不清、每個都只熱衷一陣子的牡羊朋友
variations: 牡羊座開始一件新的事，速度全宇宙最快；至於結束，通常是無聲無息地就換下一個了。

en.content:
Inventory of an Aries' room:

One guitar, three days old, factory strings still on.
One full watercolor set, unopened, dust on the box.
One ab roller, sworn last week to be used daily, currently holding a jacket.

And every single time, they genuinely believed this time would be different. That belief is worth a little more than persistence.
en.editorNote: For the Aries with more hobbies than they can keep track of, each one blazing hot for exactly one week
variations: No one in the universe starts a new thing faster than an Aries. As for finishing—they usually just quietly move on to the next one.

items.sourceNote: Zodiac signs when they're sick — each sign's illness behaviour, from Scorpio suffering silently to Leo needing an audience

zh-tw.content:
各星座生病的時候：

牡羊座：一開始說「小感冒而已不用管我」，硬撐半天後突然變成全世界最虛弱的人，需要有人隨時待命。

金牛座：直接請假，把自己包成一顆繭，備好熱湯、零食、遙控器，把生病過成一場精緻的休養。

處女座：早就量好體溫、記下症狀時間軸，Google 到一半開始懷疑自己得了三種病。

天蠍座：不告訴任何人，一個人安靜地扛，等你發現的時候他已經自己好了。

雙魚座：發燒的時候情緒特別澎湃，看個廣告都能哭，覺得全世界只剩自己一個人。

獅子座：生病也要有觀眾——「我快不行了」至少要說給三個人聽，然後被關心一下就好一半。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一生病就人間蒸發、硬要自己扛的天蠍朋友，讓他知道有人想關心他
variations: 最會照顧自己的病人是金牛（把休養變享受），最難照顧的是獅子——他需要的不是藥，是觀眾。

en.content:
Zodiac signs when they're sick:

Aries: Starts with 'it's just a cold, don't worry about me,' powers through for half a day, then suddenly becomes the most fragile person alive and needs someone on standby.

Taurus: Takes the day off immediately, wraps into a cocoon, stocks up on hot soup, snacks, and the remote. Turns being sick into a proper spa retreat.

Virgo: Already logged their temperature and a timeline of symptoms. Halfway through Googling, becomes convinced they have three different diseases.

Scorpio: Tells no one. Suffers quietly and alone. By the time you find out, they've already recovered.

Pisces: Runs an emotional fever alongside the real one — cries at a commercial, feels like the last person left on Earth.

Leo: Even being sick needs an audience — 'I don't think I'll make it' has to be announced to at least three people, and half the recovery is just being fussed over.
en.editorNote: Send to the Scorpio who vanishes the second they get sick and insists on toughing it out alone.
variations: Best patient: Taurus (turns recovery into a treat). Hardest patient: Leo — doesn't need medicine, needs an audience.

items.sourceNote: Zodiac signs behind the wheel — driving styles from Aries the gap-taker to Capricorn the on-time planner

zh-tw.content:
各星座開車的樣子：

牡羊座：油門就是拿來踩的，看到前面有空隙就切，導航還在算路線他已經到了。

金牛座：慢，穩，全程維持在最舒服的速度，後面按喇叭是後面的事。

雙子座：一邊開車一邊講話、一邊換歌、一邊評論路上每一台車，神奇的是都沒出事。

處女座：兩手固定在方向盤標準位置，變換車道一定打方向燈，看到別人亂開會念一整路。

射手座：不太確定要去哪，但覺得「開著開著就會到」，結果發現了一條沒人知道的秘境。

摩羯座：出發前查好路線、避開塞車時段、算準到達時間，準時到，一分不差。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳到家庭群組，讓大家對號入座——尤其是那個開車愛念別人的處女座
variations: 最讓乘客放心的是摩羯（準時又穩），最刺激的是牡羊——他覺得那不叫危險，叫效率。

en.content:
Zodiac signs behind the wheel:

Aries: The gas pedal exists to be pressed. Sees a gap, takes it. Arrives before the GPS finishes calculating the route.

Taurus: Slow, steady, locked at the most comfortable speed the whole way. The honking behind them is the honker's problem.

Gemini: Talks, changes the song, and reviews every car on the road — all while driving. Somehow never crashes.

Virgo: Hands at the textbook position, signals every lane change, and narrates other people's bad driving for the entire trip.

Sagittarius: Not entirely sure where they're going, but figures they'll 'get there eventually.' Ends up discovering a hidden spot no one knows about.

Capricorn: Checked the route, avoided rush hour, calculated the arrival time. Shows up exactly on schedule, to the minute.
en.editorNote: Drop it in the family group chat and watch everyone claim their spot — especially the Virgo who narrates everyone else's driving.
variations: Most reassuring driver: Capricorn (punctual and steady). Most thrilling: Aries — he doesn't call it dangerous, he calls it efficient.

items.sourceNote: Zodiac signs' first reaction to hearing 'we need to talk' — from Aries wanting it over with to Cancer tearing up before a word is said

zh-tw.content:
聽到「我們談談」這四個字，各星座的第一反應：

處女座：立刻在腦中回放過去兩週說過的每一句話，找出到底是哪裡出錯。

雙魚座：還沒開始談，已經先把整段關係在腦中演完、結束、又重來一遍。

牡羊座：「談就談，現在就講。」最怕的不是壞消息，是等待壞消息。

天蠍座：表面平靜地說「好啊」，內心已經同時準備好三種版本的回應。

摩羯座：先問「大概多久」，因為他等一下還有事，情緒可以晚點再處理。

巨蟹座：什麼都還沒聽，眼眶先紅了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一聽到「我們談談」就開始腦補最壞結局的雙魚或處女朋友
variations: 最想立刻攤牌的是牡羊（等待比壞消息更難受），最需要先做心理準備的是雙魚——他已經在腦中演完八百次了。

en.content:
Zodiac signs' first reaction to hearing 'we need to talk':

Virgo: Instantly replays every sentence from the past two weeks, hunting for exactly where it went wrong.

Pisces: Before the talk even starts, has already played out the entire relationship — the ending, and a redo — in their head.

Aries: 'Then let's talk. Right now.' Their worst fear isn't bad news — it's waiting for bad news.

Scorpio: Calmly says 'sure,' while internally prepping three different versions of a response.

Capricorn: First asks 'roughly how long?' — they've got something later, and emotions can be dealt with afterward.

Cancer: Hasn't heard a single word yet and their eyes are already welling up.
en.editorNote: Send to the Pisces or Virgo who spirals into worst-case scenarios the second they hear 'we need to talk.'
variations: Most eager to get it over with: Aries (the wait hurts more than the news). Most in need of prep time: Pisces — he's already rehearsed it 800 times in his head.

items.sourceNote: Zodiac signs when drunk — each sign's drunk archetype, from Taurus leaving early for food to Pisces blacking out

zh-tw.content:
各星座喝醉的樣子：

金牛座：喝到一半突然消失，去找宵夜了，回來手上一袋鹹酥雞，比酒清醒。

雙子座：跟一個五分鐘前才認識的人聊到天亮，隔天完全想不起對方是誰。

獅子座：開始跟全場的人乾杯，發了十七則限動，隔天醒來第一件事是刪限動。

天蠍座：不是滴酒不沾，就是喝到面不改色，中間值不存在。

射手座：一直說「再一攤！」，是全場最不想回家的那個。

雙魚座：喝一喝開始掉眼淚，抱著朋友說「你知道我多愛你嗎」，隔天斷片。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳到聚餐群組，開局前先對號入座，尤其是那個每次都喊「再一攤」的射手
variations: 最好照顧的醉漢是金牛（自己去買宵夜順便清醒），最需要有人顧的是雙魚——他不是喝醉，是進入了情緒的深海。

en.content:
Zodiac signs when drunk:

Taurus: Vanishes halfway through the night — gone on a food run. Comes back with a bag of fried snacks, somehow more sober than everyone.

Gemini: Has a heart-to-heart until sunrise with someone they met five minutes ago. Can't remember who it was the next day.

Leo: Starts toasting the entire room, posts seventeen stories, and wakes up with one mission: delete the stories.

Scorpio: Either stone-cold sober or absolutely wrecked. There is no in-between.

Sagittarius: Keeps yelling 'one more bar!' — the last person in the group who wants to go home.

Pisces: A couple of drinks in and the tears start, hugging a friend going 'do you know how much I love you.' Total blackout by morning.
en.editorNote: Drop it in the group chat before a night out and let everyone claim their type — especially the Sagittarius always shouting 'one more bar.'
variations: Easiest drunk to babysit: Taurus (sobers up on their own snack run). Hardest: Pisces — not drunk, just deep-diving into their feelings.

items.sourceNote: Zodiac signs online shopping — from Libra stuck in the cart to Capricorn waiting for the sale

zh-tw.content:
各星座網購的樣子：

天秤座：兩件顏色只差一點的東西，可以放在購物車裡比較三天，最後兩件都買。

處女座：把評論從最新看到最舊，篩掉業配、排除代購，研究到比賣家還懂這個商品。

射手座：滑到就下單，理由是「當下很想要」，收到的時候通常已經忘記自己買過。

摩羯座：加入購物車，設定降價提醒，等到打折那天才出手，一塊錢都不多花。

雙子座：同時開八個分頁比價，比到最後累了，關掉全部，什麼都沒買。

雙魚座：本來只想買一個東西，結帳時車裡多了七樣「順便」，其中三樣是給朋友的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個購物車永遠躺著幾十樣東西、就是不結帳的天秤或摩羯朋友
variations: 最省的是摩羯（等到骨折價才出手），最容易失守的是雙魚——他的購物車裡一半是為別人加的。

en.content:
Zodiac signs online shopping:

Libra: Two items in nearly identical colors sit in the cart for three days of comparison. Ends up buying both.

Virgo: Reads the reviews newest to oldest, filters out the sponsored ones, and ends up knowing the product better than the seller.

Sagittarius: Sees it, buys it — reason being 'I want it right now.' Usually forgets ordering it by the time it arrives.

Capricorn: Adds to cart, sets a price-drop alert, and only strikes on sale day. Not a cent over.

Gemini: Opens eight tabs to compare prices, gets tired of comparing, closes all of them, buys nothing.

Pisces: Meant to buy one thing; checks out with seven 'while I'm here' extras — three of them for friends.
en.editorNote: Send to the Libra or Capricorn whose cart is stacked with dozens of items that never quite make it to checkout.
variations: Thriftiest: Capricorn (only buys at rock-bottom prices). Most likely to cave: Pisces — half the cart is stuff they added for other people.

items.sourceNote: Zodiac signs trying to diet — from Aries the all-in-then-quits to Capricorn who actually sticks to it

zh-tw.content:
各星座減肥的樣子：

牡羊座：第一天就報名健身房、買齊裝備、狂運動三小時，第三天就再也沒去了。

金牛座：減肥永遠從「明天」開始，而今天，是最後一頓，吃好吃滿。

處女座：把每餐熱量算到小數點，某天多吃一塊餅乾，愧疚感罰自己多跑二十分鐘。

獅子座：辦了最貴的方案、拍了最帥的健身照，發完文之後就沒有然後了。

摩羯座：訂好目標、排好菜單、記錄每一天，然後真的瘦下來——因為他說到就做到。

雙魚座：心情好想吃，心情不好更想吃，減肥計畫通常敗給了一杯很療癒的珍奶。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次都說「明天開始減肥」的金牛，或那個已經辦卡三個月沒去的獅子
variations: 唯一真的會瘦的是摩羯（說到做到），最快放棄的是牡羊——他的熱情燃燒得快，肌肉還沒跟上。

en.content:
Zodiac signs trying to diet:

Aries: Day one — signs up for the gym, buys all the gear, trains for three hours straight. By day three, never seen again.

Taurus: The diet always starts 'tomorrow.' And today, being the last meal, must be enjoyed to the fullest.

Virgo: Counts every calorie to the decimal. Eats one extra cookie and punishes the guilt with twenty more minutes of running.

Leo: Buys the priciest membership, takes the best-looking gym selfie, posts it — and that's where the story ends.

Capricorn: Sets the goal, plans the menu, logs every day, and actually loses the weight — because when they say it, they do it.

Pisces: Eats when happy, eats more when sad. The whole plan usually surrenders to one very comforting bubble tea.
en.editorNote: Send to the Taurus who's been 'starting tomorrow' for months, or the Leo three months into a membership they've never used.
variations: Only one who actually slims down: Capricorn (says it, does it). First to quit: Aries — the enthusiasm burns out before the muscle catches up.

items.sourceNote: Zodiac signs receiving a gift they don't love — from Sagittarius blurting the truth to Cancer keeping it forever

zh-tw.content:
收到一個其實沒那麼喜歡的禮物，各星座的反應：

天秤座：笑容標準、語氣真誠，「哇這個好特別！」，完美到你完全看不出破綻。

射手座：藏不住，「欸這個我可能用不到耶」，說完自己也覺得好像太直了，但已經來不及。

巨蟹座：不管喜不喜歡，都會小心收好，因為讓他感動的從來不是禮物，是你有想到他。

處女座：當下說謝謝，回家默默查了原價，然後開始想「這個能不能拿去換更實用的」。

天蠍座：表情看不出任何情緒，你永遠不知道他到底喜不喜歡，連他自己可能都還沒決定。

雙魚座：不管收到什麼都會眼眶泛淚，「你怎麼會記得我說過⋯⋯」其實你根本沒說過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送禮前先看一下，尤其提醒那個嘴巴很誠實的射手——收到禮物先深呼吸再說話
variations: 最給面子的是天秤（演技滿分），最需要提醒的是射手——他不是不領情，是真心話跑得比腦子快。

en.content:
Zodiac signs receiving a gift they don't really love:

Libra: Textbook smile, sincere tone — 'Wow, this is so unique!' — so flawless you'd never catch the seam.

Sagittarius: Can't hide it. 'Oh... I'm not sure I'll use this.' Realizes mid-sentence that was too honest, but it's already out.

Cancer: Loves it or not, they'll keep it carefully — because what moves them was never the gift, it's that you thought of them.

Virgo: Says thanks in the moment, quietly looks up the retail price at home, then starts wondering 'can I exchange this for something more useful.'

Scorpio: Face gives away nothing. You'll never know if they like it — they might not have decided themselves yet.

Pisces: Tears up no matter what it is — 'you remembered I said...' — you never said anything.
en.editorNote: Worth a read before gift season — especially a heads-up for the brutally honest Sagittarius: take a breath before you speak.
variations: Best at saving face: Libra (Oscar-worthy). Most in need of a warning: Sagittarius — not ungrateful, the honesty just outruns the brain.

items.sourceNote: Leo season (Jul 23–Aug 22) birthday humor — the over-the-top birthday production trope, reframed around wanting people present rather than spectacle

zh-tw.content:
獅子座的生日不是一天，是一個檔期。

提前一個月開始暗示、當天的餐廳要有拍照的光、蛋糕出場最好還配一段音樂——他不是要排場，他是需要一個藉口，把所有他在乎的人塞進同一個房間裡。

然後假裝沒在數，其實偷偷看誰記得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 七月底開始是獅子座生日轟炸期，傳給那位早就開始倒數的壽星，他會說「才沒有」然後把它轉發出去
variations: 獅子座生日當天最怕的不是變老，是打開手機發現通知欄很安靜。所以拜託，早上第一則祝福，衝一下。

en.content:
A Leo's birthday isn't a day. It's a season.

The hints start a month out, the restaurant has to have good lighting, and ideally the cake arrives with a soundtrack. It's not about the spectacle — it's an excuse to get every person they love into the same room.

Then they pretend not to be counting, while quietly noting who remembered.
en.editorNote: Leo season kicks off in late July — send it to the Leo who's already counting down. They'll say 'that's not me' and repost it anyway.
variations: A Leo's real birthday fear isn't getting older. It's unlocking their phone to a very quiet notification screen. Be the first message of the day.

items.sourceNote: How each sign spends their OWN birthday — distinct from existing gift-giving and gift-receiving items

zh-tw.content:
各星座怎麼過自己的生日：

獅子座：上個月就開始倒數，當天要有蛋糕、要有照片、要有一句「今天你最大」。

金牛座：不辦派對，找一間喜歡的餐廳，點那道平常捨不得點的，這樣就很完美了。

處女座：自己訂位、自己排流程、自己確認誰不吃辣——連自己的生日都在照顧別人。

天蠍座：嘴上說「不用啦」，但你真的沒準備他會記住；準備了他又問你幹嘛這樣。

射手座：生日當天人在外地，慶祝方式是換一個沒去過的地方醒來。

巨蟹座：不要驚喜，只要那幾個從高中認識到現在的人剛好都有空。

水瓶座：完全忘記自己生日，被通知才想起來，然後覺得大家是不是有點太激動。
zh-tw.editorNote: 生日季必備，找到你朋友那一段直接傳給他，後面補一句「所以你今年想怎麼過」
variations: 最會給自己排場的：獅子座。最會被自己生日嚇到的：水瓶座。最會在自己生日那天還在照顧別人的：處女座。

en.content:
How each sign spends their own birthday:

Leo: The countdown starts a month early. There will be cake, there will be photos, and someone will say 'today is all about you.'

Taurus: No party. One favorite restaurant, one dish they never let themselves order. Perfect.

Virgo: Books the table, plans the timing, checks who can't eat spicy — still taking care of everyone at their own birthday.

Scorpio: Says 'don't make a fuss.' Will absolutely notice if you don't. Will also ask why you did.

Sagittarius: Out of town. Celebrating by waking up somewhere they've never been.

Cancer: Doesn't want a surprise. Wants the four people they've known since high school to all be free that night.

Aquarius: Forgets it's their own birthday until someone reminds them, then finds everyone's excitement slightly excessive.
en.editorNote: Birthday-season staple — send your friend their paragraph with 'so what are we doing this year?' attached
variations: Biggest production: Leo. Most startled by their own birthday: Aquarius. Most likely to still be hosting on their own birthday: Virgo.

items.sourceNote: Leo decans (Jul 23–Aug 22) reframed as three playful Leo sub-types — timely for Leo season

zh-tw.content:
同樣是獅子座，其實分三種：

七月底出生的（7/23–8/2）：氣場最直接，開心和不爽都寫在臉上，完全不用你猜。

八月上旬出生的（8/3–8/12）：面子做得最完整，出門前一定把狀態整理好，難過也要難過得有格調。

八月中後段出生的（8/13–8/22）：看起來最溫和的那種獅子，好像很好說話，直到你踩到底線的那一秒。

共通點只有一個：三種都受不了被當空氣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳到獅子座朋友群裡，看他們搶著認領自己是第幾段，然後開始互相鑑定
variations: 問獅子座是哪一段出生的，他會先反問你「你猜」——這題本身就是他今天最想聊的話題。

en.content:
Three kinds of Leo, all under the same sign:

Born late July (Jul 23–Aug 2): The most direct energy. Whatever they feel is already on their face — no guessing required.

Born early August (Aug 3–12): The most polished. Won't leave the house unassembled, and even the sad days get styled.

Born mid-to-late August (Aug 13–22): The mildest-looking Leo. Seems easygoing, right up until the second you cross the line.

One thing all three share: none of them can stand being treated like they're not there.
en.editorNote: Drop it in the group chat during Leo season and watch every Leo rush to claim their slot
variations: Ask a Leo which stretch of the season they were born in and they'll answer 'guess' — because now it's the topic they most want to talk about.

items.sourceNote: Summer behavior by sign — timely for late July, no existing summer-themed item in this file

zh-tw.content:
各星座過夏天的樣子：

獅子座：太陽越大他越有精神，海邊、烤肉、音樂祭，行程排到你光看就中暑。

金牛座：冷氣二十四度、西瓜切好、影集開著，一整個下午沒離開過沙發。

處女座：出門前防曬補三次，包包裡有濕紙巾、扇子、備用襪子，全隊的救命恩人。

天蠍座：討厭人多，挑最冷門的時段出門，去海邊也要選沒人的那一段。

射手座：收到「要不要去」三秒回好，行李在出發前一小時才開始收。

巨蟹座：最喜歡的夏天是家裡那種——一群人擠在客廳，冷氣、零食、聊到半夜。

水瓶座：整個夏天最期待的是晚上十一點的便利商店，涼、安靜、沒有人認識他。
zh-tw.editorNote: 揪團出遊前先丟到群組，順便看出誰是那個非冷氣不可的人
variations: 夏天最不怕熱的：獅子座、射手座。夏天最像人形冷氣房的：金牛座。夏天最該被感謝的：處女座（那罐防曬其實是幫你帶的）。

en.content:
Each sign in summer:

Leo: The hotter it gets, the more alive they are. Beach, barbecue, music festival — a schedule that gives you heatstroke just reading it.

Taurus: AC at 75, watermelon pre-sliced, one show running all afternoon, zero trips off the couch.

Virgo: Reapplies sunscreen three times before leaving. Bag holds wipes, a fan, spare socks. Saves the entire group.

Scorpio: Avoids crowds. Goes at the least popular hour, picks the empty end of the beach.

Sagittarius: Answers 'yes' three seconds after 'wanna go?' Starts packing one hour before departure.

Cancer: Their favorite summer is the indoor kind — everyone crammed into the living room with AC, snacks, and talking until 2am.

Aquarius: The highlight of their whole summer is the 11pm convenience store run. Cool, quiet, nobody knows them.
en.editorNote: Post it before planning a group trip — it exposes exactly who refuses to leave the AC
variations: Least bothered by heat: Leo and Sagittarius. Most human-shaped air conditioner: Taurus. Most deserving of thanks: Virgo — that sunscreen was packed for you.

items.sourceNote: Jupiter enters Leo in the second half of 2026 — treated as a playful permission slip, entertainment framing only

zh-tw.content:
2026下半年，木星走進獅子座——白話翻譯：全世界進入「大聲一點也沒關係」模式。

平常不敢舉手的人開始舉手，存在草稿裡一年的作品終於按下發布，連你朋友圈最低調的那一位都突然說想剪瀏海。

沒有要你相信星象，就當成一個藉口——反正那件事你本來就想做，現在只是剛好有人幫你數三、二、一。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友猶豫要不要開始某件事的時候傳過去，當作一個好笑又剛好有用的推坑理由
variations: 木星進獅子座的實際體感大概是：接下來這陣子，你身邊會多出一堆突然開始經營自媒體的朋友。請溫柔一點，順手按個讚。

en.content:
Second half of 2026: Jupiter moves into Leo. Plain translation — the whole world switches into 'it's okay to be a little loud' mode.

People who never raise their hand start raising it. The project that sat in drafts for a year finally gets posted. Even the quietest person in your group chat suddenly wants bangs.

You don't have to believe in any of it. Take it as an excuse — you wanted to do the thing anyway. Now something is counting you down from three.
en.editorNote: Send it to the friend who's been hovering over the publish button. A funny excuse that happens to work.
variations: What Jupiter in Leo actually feels like: for the next stretch, several friends will suddenly start posting content. Be kind. Hit like.

items.sourceNote: Zodiac signs' roles inside a group chat — fresh angle, no existing group-chat roundup in this file

zh-tw.content:
各星座在群組裡的角色：

牡羊座：丟了一個超炸的話題，炒熱三分鐘後人就消失，回來已是隔天。

雙子座：同時在跟八個人聊，訊息全部秒回，但你永遠不確定他有沒有真的看懂。

巨蟹座：群組裡的媽媽，誰心情不好第一個私訊關心的一定是他。

處女座：平常潛水，但一開口就是全場最好笑的那一句。

水瓶座：這個群組是他開的，然後他失蹤了五天。

魔羯座：只在需要「敲定時間地點」的時候出現，講完重點就下線。
zh-tw.editorNote: 丟到群組裡讓大家對號入座，順便看出誰是那個開了群又人間蒸發的水瓶
variations: 群組已讀不回冠軍：水瓶座（他還是創群的那個）。群組秒回但答非所問冠軍：雙子座。群組潛水但金句最多：處女座。

en.content:
Everyone's role in the group chat, by sign:

Aries: Drops a wild topic, keeps it alive for three minutes, then vanishes. Reappears the next day.

Gemini: Chatting with eight people at once, replies instantly to all of them — you're just never sure they actually read yours.

Cancer: The mom of the chat. If someone's having a rough day, Cancer is the first to slide into their DMs.

Virgo: Lurks silently, then delivers the single funniest line in the whole thread.

Aquarius: Started this group chat. Then disappeared for five days.

Capricorn: Only surfaces to lock down the time and place, states the point, logs off.
en.editorNote: Drop it in the chat and watch everyone tag themselves — especially the Aquarius who founded the group and then ghosted it
variations: Group chat left-on-read champion: Aquarius (who also created the group). Instant-but-irrelevant reply champion: Gemini. Silent lurker with the best one-liners: Virgo.

items.sourceNote: Relationship green flags by sign — reframed warmly as reasons to keep someone, entertainment framing

zh-tw.content:
如果你身邊有這幾種人，請好好珍惜：

金牛座：不會天天說愛你，但他說過一次，就是打算負責到底。

處女座：嘴上嫌你，行動上把你要用的東西全部默默準備好。

天蠍座：一旦決定信任你，就把整個人都押上去，不留退路。

雙魚座：你難過的時候不會急著給建議，只是安靜地陪著，讓你知道有人在。

這些不是浪漫台詞，是那種你出事的時候，會第一個出現的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給正在猶豫某段感情值不值得的朋友，幫他看清對方的好
variations: 感情裡最穩的綠燈：金牛座的「說到做到」、天蠍座的「認定就不換」、雙魚座的「你難過我就陪」。這些不上鏡，但最耐放。

en.content:
If you've got one of these people in your life, hold on to them:

Taurus: Won't say 'I love you' every day, but they said it once and they meant it for good.

Virgo: Complains about you out loud while quietly prepping every single thing you'll need.

Scorpio: The moment they decide to trust you, they go all in — no exit plan, no backup.

Pisces: When you're upset, they won't rush to fix it. They just stay quietly beside you so you know someone's there.

These aren't romantic lines. These are the people who show up first when your life falls apart.
en.editorNote: Send it to a friend questioning whether a relationship is worth it — it helps them see the good clearly
variations: Steadiest green flags in love: Taurus who says it once and means it, Scorpio who never trades you in, Pisces who just sits with you. None of it photographs well. All of it lasts.

items.sourceNote: Gemini texting style — multitasking across many chats, accidental ghosting; single-sign focus

zh-tw.content:
雙子座傳訊息的真相：
他不是不回你——是他同時開了六個對話框，你的那則被沖到最上面又被蓋掉了。

他可以在三個群組裡各講一個笑話、跟你聊到一半突然消失、隔天回一句「欸剛剛講到哪」，然後你居然還原諒他。

因為每次他終於回訊息，都好笑到讓你忘記自己已讀他三小時了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個總是「不小心」把你晾著的雙子朋友，看他怎麼狡辯
variations: 雙子座不是故意已讀你，他只是真心以為自己回了——在腦海裡。那則超完美的回覆，到現在還躺在他的想像裡沒送出。

en.content:
The truth about texting a Gemini:
They're not ignoring you — they've got six conversations open at once, and yours got buried under the other five.

They'll crack a joke in three group chats, vanish mid-conversation with you, resurface a day later with 'wait, where were we,' and somehow you forgive them.

Because every time they finally reply, it's funny enough to make you forget you left them on read for three hours first.
en.editorNote: Send it to the Gemini friend who keeps 'accidentally' leaving you hanging and watch them talk their way out of it
variations: A Gemini isn't ghosting you on purpose — they genuinely think they replied. That perfect response is still sitting in their imagination, un-sent.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius as the friendship-ruling sign who founds the group then withdraws — leans into the file's introvert/extrovert theme

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座的社交模式很矛盾：
他是最會揪人、最會開群組、最關心「大家」的那一個——然後他會突然消失一個禮拜，手機丟在旁邊，一則都不想回。

這不是他變冷淡了。
是他真的很在乎大家，但也真的需要一段沒有任何人找他的時間，才能把電充回來。

所以他回訊息了，不是敷衍——是他決定把難得回滿的電，分一點給你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個「揪團一把罩、平常卻很難找到人」的水瓶朋友，讓他知道你懂
variations: 水瓶座的愛：把你拉進群組、規劃好一切、然後神隱兩週。別擔心，他沒有不理你，他只是在幫全世界的電池找插座——包括自己那顆。

en.content:
Aquarius runs on a contradiction:
They're the one who organizes everyone, starts every group chat, genuinely cares about 'the whole crew' — and then they'll vanish for a week, phone face-down, not answering a single message.

It's not that they've gone cold.
They really do care about everyone. They also really need a stretch where nobody needs them, just to recharge.

So when they finally text back, it's not obligation — it's them deciding to spend some of that hard-won battery on you.
en.editorNote: Send it to the Aquarius who's incredible at rallying the group but impossible to reach in between — let them know you get it
variations: An Aquarius's love language: adding you to the group chat, planning everything, then going off-grid for two weeks. Don't worry, they didn't forget you — they're just out finding an outlet for the world's batteries, including their own.

items.sourceNote: Libra chronic indecisiveness — not from not knowing, but from weighing every outcome

zh-tw.content:
天秤座的選擇困難不是因為沒主見——
是因為他們一次看到了十種結果，還在心裡把每一種都演完了。

你問他要吃什麼，他不是不知道，
他是在同時計算：吃這家會不會後悔、你會不會覺得無聊、隔壁那家會不會其實更好。

所以最後他說「都可以」，真的不是敷衍——
是他的腦袋已經開了十個分頁，當機了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個問他吃什麼永遠回「都可以」的天秤朋友，附註「我知道你其實想很多」
variations: 天秤座點餐的內心戲：A看起來不錯，但B比較划算，可是C是我上次想吃沒吃到的⋯⋯欸不然你先點好了。

en.content:
A Libra's indecision isn't from not knowing what they want —
it's that they saw ten possible outcomes at once and mentally played out every single one.

When you ask where they want to eat, they're not clueless.
They're calculating: will I regret this place, will you get bored, is the spot next door secretly better?

So when they finally say 'anywhere's fine,' it's genuinely not a cop-out —
their brain just opened ten tabs and crashed.
en.editorNote: Send to the Libra who always answers 'I don't mind' — add 'I know you actually thought about it a lot'
variations: A Libra ordering food, internal monologue: A looks good, but B's better value, though C is the one I missed last time... you know what, you go first.

items.sourceNote: Libra people-pleaser — can't say no, overextends to keep everyone happy

zh-tw.content:
天秤座最累的地方，是他很難說「不」。

朋友找他幫忙，他明明累爆了還是說好；
聚會他明明想回家了，還是笑著陪到最後一個人走。

他不是沒有底線——
是他太怕讓別人失望，寧可自己撐著。

如果你身邊有這種天秤，偶爾幫他把「不用勉強」講出口，
因為他自己永遠說不出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個總是為別人著想、卻不太會拒絕的天秤，讓他知道偶爾拒絕也沒關係
variations: 天秤座的內心：我其實想拒絕，但我怕你難過，所以我就答應了，然後回家一個人難過。

en.content:
The most exhausting thing about being a Libra is how hard it is for them to say 'no.'

A friend asks for a favor — they're wiped out, but they say yes anyway.
They've wanted to leave the party for an hour, but they smile and stay till the last person walks out.

It's not that they have no limits —
it's that they're so scared of letting people down, they'd rather run themselves into the ground.

If you've got a Libra like this, say 'you don't have to' for them once in a while.
They'll never manage to say it themselves.
en.editorNote: Send to the Libra who's always looking out for everyone but never says no — remind them it's okay to decline
variations: A Libra's inner voice: I actually wanted to say no, but I was scared you'd be upset, so I said yes — then went home and got upset alone.

items.sourceNote: Aries as extrovert — turns everything into a debate but forgives instantly

zh-tw.content:
「所以你們剛剛在吵什麼？」
「他說滷肉飯一定要配湯，我說不用。」
「吵多久？」
「四十分鐘。」

五分鐘後，牡羊座轉頭問我：欸，等一下要不要去吃宵夜。
他對你大聲，通常代表他把你當自己人，才懶得裝。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個跟你吵完馬上又沒事、直來直往的牡羊朋友
variations: 牡羊座的記仇時間表：生氣30秒、大聲2分鐘、然後就忘了剛剛在氣什麼。

en.content:
"So what were you two arguing about?"
"He says rice bowls have to come with soup. I said they don't."
"How long?"
"Forty minutes."

Five minutes later the Aries turns around: hey, want to go get late-night food?
When an Aries raises their voice at you, it usually means you're family and they can't be bothered to perform.
en.editorNote: Send to the blunt Aries friend who argues with you one minute and is totally fine the next
variations: An Aries grudge timeline: mad for 30 seconds, loud for 2 minutes, then completely forgets what they were even mad about.

items.sourceNote: Taurus as ambivert — social when comfortable, but recharges through comfort and rest

zh-tw.content:
金牛座是那種：
跟熟人可以聊到店家打烊，跟不熟的人三句話就想回家的類型。

他的社交開關很簡單——
舒服就開，不舒服就關，沒有中間值。

所以別覺得金牛座難搞，
他只是把有限的電量，留給讓他覺得自在的人。
如果他願意跟你耗一整個下午，那就是最高等級的偏愛了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個只對熟人話很多、對外人很省話的金牛朋友
variations: 金牛座的社交電量分配：家人朋友100%、有點熟的30%、陌生人開機五秒就想關機。

en.content:
A Taurus is the type who'll
talk to close friends until the place closes, but wants to go home after three sentences with a stranger.

Their social switch is simple —
comfortable, it's on; uncomfortable, it's off. No in-between.

So don't think a Taurus is hard to deal with.
They just save their limited battery for the people who make them feel at ease.
If they're willing to spend a whole afternoon with you, that's their highest form of favoritism.
en.editorNote: Send to the Taurus who's chatty with close friends but goes quiet around everyone else
variations: How a Taurus rations social battery: family and close friends 100%, acquaintances 30%, strangers — powers on for five seconds, immediately wants to shut down.

items.sourceNote: Taurus stubbornness reframed — slow to decide but immovable once committed

zh-tw.content:
金牛座做決定很慢，慢到你以為他還沒開始想。

但一旦他決定了，就沒有任何人能拉得回來。
你講一百個道理，他點頭說「嗯嗯有道理」，然後照原本的做。

這不是聽不進去——
是他早在你開口之前，就在心裡默默算完所有帳了。

跟金牛座相處的訣竅：
別想改變他的決定，等他自己想通，比什麼都快。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個決定很慢、但一決定就九頭牛拉不回的金牛朋友
variations: 說服金牛座的正確方式：不是講贏他，是讓他覺得那是他自己想到的。

en.content:
A Taurus takes forever to decide — so long you'd swear they haven't even started thinking.

But once they've decided, nobody on earth can pull them back.
You can lay out a hundred reasons; they'll nod, say 'yeah, fair point,' and then do exactly what they were going to do anyway.

It's not that they're not listening —
it's that they quietly finished doing the math long before you opened your mouth.

The trick to dealing with a Taurus:
don't try to change their decision. Waiting for them to come around on their own is faster than anything else.
en.editorNote: Send to the Taurus who's slow to decide but utterly immovable once they have
variations: The right way to persuade a Taurus: don't win the argument — make them feel like it was their idea all along.

items.sourceNote: Aries often mistaken for extrovert but is a closet introvert who recharges alone

zh-tw.content:
大家都以為牡羊座是全場最E的那個——
講話大聲、動作又快、走到哪都能跟人聊起來。

但只有牡羊自己知道，那是「開機模式」。
回到家關上門，他可以三天不想跟任何人講話，
手機丟到一邊，享受那種終於不用當氣氛擔當的安靜。

牡羊不是假E——
是他的電量分兩種：對外用得快，對自己補得慢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個在外面超嗨、回家秒斷電的牡羊朋友
variations: 牡羊座的社交是短跑不是馬拉松——衝得比誰都快，也比誰都需要回終點線後直接躺平。

en.content:
Everyone assumes Aries is the most extroverted person in the room —
loud, fast, striking up a conversation wherever they go.

But only an Aries knows that's just 'boot-up mode.'
Close the door at home and they can go three days not wanting to talk to a single soul,
phone tossed aside, savoring the quiet of finally not having to be the group's hype person.

Aries isn't faking the extroversion —
their battery just comes in two kinds: drains fast in public, recharges slow in private.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aries who's a total live wire out there but powers down the second they get home
variations: Aries socializing is a sprint, not a marathon — they go harder than anyone, and need to collapse at the finish line harder than anyone too.

items.sourceNote: Aries never forgets how you made them feel, good or bad, even if they forget the details

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座可能記不住你的生日，也記不住你上禮拜說過什麼，
但他一定記得你「當時讓他有什麼感覺」。

對他好過的人，他會用十倍還回來；
讓他寒過心的人，他嘴上說算了，心裡那一格早就默默關燈。

牡羊的記憶體很小，但存的都是感覺，不是細節。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個大而化之、卻對「別人怎麼對他」記得超清楚的牡羊
variations: 跟牡羊座相處的重點不是你做了什麼，是你讓他覺得怎麼樣——他忘得掉事，忘不掉感覺。

en.content:
An Aries might forget your birthday, and forget what you said last week,
but they will never forget how you made them feel in that moment.

Anyone who's been good to them gets it back tenfold;
anyone who's left them cold — they'll say 'it's fine,' but that little light inside quietly went off ages ago.

An Aries has tiny storage, but what it saves is feelings, not details.
en.editorNote: Send to the easygoing Aries who somehow remembers exactly how everyone has treated them
variations: The thing about an Aries isn't what you did — it's how you made them feel. They'll forget the event; they won't forget the feeling.

items.sourceNote: Aries is a natural leader who resents being told what to do — needs ownership

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座天生就是那個會第一個跳出來說「這件事我來扛」的人。

但你千萬別反過來命令他做什麼——
同一件事，他自願做叫熱血，你叫他做就變「憑什麼」。

他不是不合作，
是他需要那個「我自己決定要做」的感覺。

想推動牡羊很簡單：別下指令，讓他以為是他先想到的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個很願意帶頭、卻最討厭被人指揮的牡羊主管或朋友
variations: 牡羊座可以為團隊拼命，但前提是——那面旗子得是他自己想扛起來的。

en.content:
An Aries is born to be the first one to jump up and say, 'I've got this.'

But whatever you do, don't turn around and order them to do it —
the exact same task is 'passion' when they choose it, and 'says who?' when you assign it.

It's not that they won't cooperate.
They just need that feeling of 'I decided to do this myself.'

The trick to moving an Aries: don't give orders — let them think it was their idea first.
en.editorNote: Send to the Aries who's happy to lead the charge but hates being bossed around
variations: An Aries will run themselves ragged for the team — as long as it's a flag they chose to carry.

items.sourceNote: Aries is refreshingly direct — no mind games, what they say is what they mean

zh-tw.content:
跟牡羊座相處最輕鬆的地方是：你完全不用猜。

他喜歡你就直接說喜歡，不爽了臉上馬上寫出來，
沒有那種「我沒事」其實有事、「隨便」其實有底線的劇情。

對想太多的人來說，牡羊是一種救贖——
因為他嘴上說的，就是他心裡想的，一個字都不用翻譯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個有話直說、從不玩心機的牡羊，也適合安慰那個被暗示搞瘋的朋友
variations: 牡羊座的可愛在於——他生氣你會知道，他開心你也會知道，他從不讓你活在猜謎遊戲裡。

en.content:
The easiest thing about an Aries is that you never have to guess.

If they like you, they say so; if they're annoyed, it's written all over their face.
None of that 'I'm fine' when they're clearly not, or 'whatever' when there's absolutely a line.

For overthinkers, an Aries is a kind of salvation —
because what comes out of their mouth is exactly what's in their head, no translation required.
en.editorNote: Send to the say-it-straight Aries who never plays games — or to comfort the friend being driven mad by mixed signals
variations: The lovable thing about an Aries: you'll know when they're mad, you'll know when they're happy, and they'll never leave you playing a guessing game.

items.sourceNote: Leo season Jul 23-Aug 22 2026 — warm, generous, magnetic; angle flips the usual spotlight trope to Leo hyping others up

zh-tw.content:
獅子座最被低估的技能，不是發光，是幫別人打光。

你隨口說一句「我做的這個還好啦」，
他會很認真地反駁你三分鐘，
把你講到自己都信了。

他不是在客套——
獅子座真心覺得，自己在乎的人就該被看見。

所以下次他又在幫你吹的時候，記得回敬一句「你也很棒」。
他嘴上會說「這還用你說」，然後偷偷開心一整天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 獅子月（7/23–8/22）適合傳給那個一直在誇你、卻很少被誇的獅子朋友
variations: 獅子座的聚光燈其實有兩盞：一盞打自己，一盞轉過去打他最在乎的那個人。

en.content:
A Leo's most underrated talent isn't shining — it's aiming the spotlight at you.

Say 'eh, the thing I made isn't that great' and they'll argue with you for three solid minutes,
until you actually start believing them.

They're not just being polite.
A Leo genuinely believes the people they care about deserve to be seen.

So next time they're hyping you up, hype them back.
They'll say 'obviously,' then quietly glow about it all day.
en.editorNote: Send during Leo season (Jul 23–Aug 22) to the Leo who's always hyping everyone else and rarely gets it back
variations: A Leo carries two spotlights: one aimed at themselves, one aimed straight at whoever they love most.

items.sourceNote: Taurus dislikes sudden change and unplanned situations — surprise-party angle not yet covered in file

zh-tw.content:
幫金牛座辦驚喜派對之前，請先想清楚。

你想像的是他感動到說不出話，
實際發生的是他站在門口愣三秒，
第一個念頭是：「我今天穿這樣？」

金牛座不是不領情——
他只是需要一點時間，把一件事從「意外」那一格，搬到「好，我準備好了」那一格。

想讓金牛開心，最有效的驚喜是提前三天預告過的那種。
zh-tw.editorNote: 想幫金牛座慶生又怕踩雷時，先傳給主辦人看一眼
variations: 金牛座喜歡的驚喜只有一種：知道會發生，只是不知道細節的那種。

en.content:
Before you throw a Taurus a surprise party, think it through.

You're picturing them speechless with joy.
What actually happens: they freeze in the doorway for three seconds,
and their first thought is, 'I'm wearing THIS?'

It's not that they're ungrateful.
They just need a minute to move an event out of the 'unexpected' column and into the 'okay, I'm ready' column.

The most effective surprise for a Taurus is the one you announced three days ago.
en.editorNote: Send to whoever's planning the Taurus's birthday, ideally before they buy the confetti cannon
variations: There's exactly one surprise a Taurus enjoys: the kind where they know it's coming and only the details are a mystery.

items.sourceNote: Libra ruled by Venus — aesthetic sensitivity and need for visual harmony; deliberately avoids the file's saturated indecision angle

zh-tw.content:
天秤座可以原諒你遲到半小時，
但沒辦法原諒那張合照裡歪掉的地平線。

餐廳好不好吃是其次，燈光要對；
訊息內容其實沒問題，但那個句號放在那裡就是不太好看。

他不是挑剔，
他是真的會被醜到，而且是身體反應。

天秤座追求的從來不是完美，是「順眼」——那是他讓自己安心下來的方式。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個修圖修到半夜、還說「我只是調一下」的天秤朋友
variations: 天秤座的房間可以亂，但亂也要亂得有構圖。

en.content:
A Libra will forgive you for showing up thirty minutes late.
What they cannot forgive is the crooked horizon in that group photo.

Whether the food is good comes second — the lighting has to work.
The message reads fine, but that period sitting right there just looks wrong.

They're not being picky.
Ugly things affect them physically.

A Libra was never chasing perfect. They're chasing 'this feels right to look at' — that's how they get their nervous system to settle.
en.editorNote: For the Libra still retouching everyone's photos at 1am and calling it 'a quick edit'
variations: A Libra's room is allowed to be messy — but the mess has to have decent composition.

items.sourceNote: Classic Capricorn 'ages in reverse' trope — Saturn's early burden then later lightness; not yet in file

zh-tw.content:
摩羯座是唯一一個把人生順序倒過來活的星座。

二十歲的時候像四十歲：講話老成、認真存錢、擔心十年後的事。
四十歲的時候突然像二十歲：跑去學衝浪、把頭髮染了、半夜揪人去吃燒烤。

他不是變了個人，
是他終於把自認該扛的都扛完了，才敢開始玩。

如果你身邊的摩羯最近突然變得很幼稚，請替他開心——那是他終於鬆了一口氣的聲音。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個年輕時老成、現在越活越開的摩羯朋友
variations: 摩羯座的青春不是沒有，只是被排在待辦清單比較後面的位置。

en.content:
Capricorn is the one sign that lives its life in reverse.

At 20 they act 40: sensible, saving money, worrying about a decade from now.
At 40 they act 20: taking up surfing, dyeing their hair, dragging friends out for midnight barbecue.

They didn't become a different person.
They just finally finished carrying everything they decided was theirs to carry, so now they get to play.

If your Capricorn friend has gotten weirdly goofy lately, be happy for them — that's the sound of someone exhaling.
en.editorNote: Send to the Capricorn who was basically born middle-aged and is finally getting younger
variations: A Capricorn's youth isn't missing — it just got scheduled near the bottom of the to-do list.

items.sourceNote: Pisces trait — compassionate, hard to say no, but quietly withdraws for good once done; distinct from the file's dreamer/daydream angles

zh-tw.content:
雙魚座很難說不。

你開口他就答應，明明自己也累爆了；你道歉他就原諒，明明心裡還在痛。
所以大家常常誤會，以為雙魚沒有底線。

底線是有的，只是它長在很裡面。
某天他會很安靜、很溫柔地退開，不吵不鬧，也不解釋——那天之前，他已經自己吞過很多次了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個什麼都說好、卻很少被問「你還好嗎」的雙魚朋友
variations: 雙魚座不會跟你翻臉，他只會在某一天，安靜地把你從心裡那個位置移開。

en.content:
A Pisces has a genuinely hard time saying no.

You ask, they agree, even running on empty; you apologize, they forgive, even while it still stings.
So people assume a Pisces has no limit.

The limit exists. It just sits very deep.
One day they'll step back quietly and gently, no scene, no explanation — and long before that day, they'd already swallowed it many times alone.
en.editorNote: For the Pisces friend who says yes to everything and never gets asked how they're holding up
variations: A Pisces won't blow up at you. They'll just quietly move you out of the spot you used to have.

items.sourceNote: Aries trait roundup (hands-on, impatient with process) — reframed onto assembling furniture / skipping tutorials, a surface not used elsewhere in this file

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座組東西不看說明書。

盒子一開，直覺告訴他這個應該插這裡、那個應該轉那邊，
十五分鐘搞定，效率驚人——
桌上剩三顆螺絲，他決定那是備品。

玩遊戲也一樣，教學關直接跳過，
邊玩邊猜按鈕，猜錯就重來一次。

他不是不學，
是他真心覺得「動手」本身就是最快的學習法。

而且老實說，成功的次數比你想像中多。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個永遠先動手再研究的牡羊朋友，或貼在自己剛組好、看起來還算穩的椅子旁邊
variations: 牡羊座的說明書用途只有一個：拆封後拿去墊桌腳。
牡羊座學東西的方式是先弄壞一次，弄壞完就記住了。

en.content:
An Aries does not read the instructions.

Box open, gut says this piece goes here and that one twists there.
Done in fifteen minutes, genuinely impressive —
with three leftover screws on the table that he has decided are spares.

Same with games: skip the tutorial, guess the buttons,
guess wrong, start the level over.

It's not that he refuses to learn.
He honestly believes doing it IS the fastest way to learn.

And to be fair? It works more often than you'd expect.
en.editorNote: For the Aries friend who always starts before reading — or to caption the chair you just built that seems fine, probably
variations: An Aries has exactly one use for the manual: leveling the wobbly table leg.
An Aries learns things by breaking them once. Then it sticks.

items.sourceNote: Taurus resistance-to-change trait — moved onto app redesigns / postponed software updates, a digital surface the file's other Taurus items (sofa, food, money) don't touch

zh-tw.content:
毀掉金牛座一整天最快的方法：把他天天在用的 App 改版。

按鈕明明在右下角，現在跑到左上角；
那個他住了三年的介面，一夜之間變成別人家。

他不是不會用新版，
是他得重新練一整套肌肉記憶，而那對他來說真的很累。

所以他手機上那則「有新版本可用」，
已經被他按了兩年的「稍後再說」。

金牛座不怕新東西，
他只是不能接受「舊的那個明明就很好」這件事被否認。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個到現在還在用舊版介面、死不更新的金牛朋友
variations: 金牛座最討厭的四個字：介面優化。
金牛座的手機上有一個永遠不會消失的紅點，那是他的底線。

en.content:
Fastest way to ruin a Taurus's entire day: redesign an app they use every day.

The button was in the bottom right. Now it's in the top left.
The interface they'd been living in for three years became someone else's house overnight.

It's not that they can't handle the new version.
It's that they have to rebuild a whole set of muscle memory, and that is genuinely exhausting for them.

Which is why the 'Update available' notice on their phone
has been getting 'Remind me later' for two straight years.

A Taurus isn't afraid of new things.
They just can't accept the implication that the old one wasn't already fine.
en.editorNote: For the Taurus friend still running the old interface and refusing every update prompt
variations: Two words a Taurus never wants to hear: refreshed layout.
There's a notification dot on a Taurus's phone that will outlive us all.

items.sourceNote: Cancer nurturing trait — expressed as the you-can't-leave-empty-handed doorway scene, distinct from the file's existing 'did you eat' / shell / memory-keeper angles

zh-tw.content:
去巨蟹座家，你不可能空手離開。

你說吃過了，他還是端一碗出來；
你說真的吃不下，他就開始裝袋——
兩顆水果、一包餅乾、還有他今天煮太多的那一鍋。

你在門口推來推去五分鐘，最後還是提著兩袋回家。

那不是客套。
讓你身上帶著他家的東西出門，是巨蟹座把「我在乎你」講出口的方式，
這樣他才能安心一點——
至少他知道你今天晚上不會餓著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個每次都硬塞東西讓你帶走的巨蟹朋友或家人，配一張門口那兩袋的照片更好
variations: 巨蟹座的愛大概兩公斤重，裝在一個塑膠袋裡。
跟巨蟹座說「真的不用了」是沒用的，他已經在找袋子了。

en.content:
You cannot leave a Cancer's place empty-handed.

You say you already ate. A bowl appears anyway.
You say you really can't, and they start bagging things up:
two pieces of fruit, a pack of cookies, and whatever they accidentally made too much of today.

Five minutes of polite back-and-forth at the door, and you still walk home holding two bags.

That's not just good hosting.
Sending you off carrying something from their kitchen is how a Cancer says the words out loud,
because then they can relax a little —
at least they know you won't go hungry tonight.
en.editorNote: For the Cancer friend or relative who loads you up every single time you visit — pairs well with a photo of the bags
variations: A Cancer's love weighs about four pounds and comes in a plastic bag.
Telling a Cancer 'no really, I'm fine' does nothing. They're already looking for a bag.

items.sourceNote: Virgo perfectionism — framed as the proofreading-a-friend's-draft scene, distinct from the file's existing nitpick / crooked-detail / message-proofreading angles

zh-tw.content:
處女座說「我隨便幫你看一下」的時候，先深呼吸。

你以為會收到一句「還不錯啊」，
結果拿回來的是改了十四個地方的版本，
最後還附一句：「這幾段我先照我的想法動了，你不喜歡再改回去。」

他不是覺得你寫得爛——
是他沒辦法看著一個明明可以更好的東西，就這樣放著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友把你的簡報改到面目全非、而你也不得不承認真的變好看之後傳給他
variations: 處女座的「一點小建議」通常有三頁。
請處女座看一眼，等於送去審一輪。好處是，他真的看得出來哪裡怪。

en.content:
When a Virgo says 'sure, I'll take a quick look,' brace yourself.

You were expecting 'yeah, looks fine.'
What comes back is a version with fourteen things changed,
plus a note: 'I rewrote these bits my way — switch them back if you hate it.'

It's not that they think your work is bad.
They just can't look at something that could obviously be better and leave it alone.
en.editorNote: For the friend who redlined your slide deck beyond recognition and, annoyingly, made it better
variations: A Virgo's 'one small suggestion' runs about three pages.
Asking a Virgo to glance at your draft is submitting it for review. Upside: they actually catch what's off.

items.sourceNote: Libra conflict-avoidance — expressed through the never-returns-a-purchase scene, avoiding the file's saturated what-to-eat and decision-paralysis angles

zh-tw.content:
天秤座買錯尺寸的衣服，通常不會拿去退。

不是懶——是他光想像那個畫面就先累了：
走進店裡、解釋原因、看到店員臉上那零點五秒的表情，
然後還要當場決定要換一件還是退錢。

所以那件衣服會在衣櫃裡掛一年，
偶爾被他瞄到，心裡說一句「早知道那天就去退了」，
然後繼續掛著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個衣櫃裡有一整區「吊牌還在」的天秤朋友，他會安靜很久
variations: 天秤座的衣櫃分三區：常穿的、偶爾穿的、還有吊牌都還沒剪的。
對天秤座來說，退貨要付出的成本不是運費，是社交電量。

en.content:
A Libra will not return the shirt that came in the wrong size.

Not laziness — just picturing it is exhausting:
walking in, explaining, catching that half-second look on the clerk's face,
then deciding on the spot between an exchange and a refund.

So the shirt hangs in the closet for a year.
Every few months they spot it, think 'should've just taken it back,'
and leave it hanging.
en.editorNote: For the Libra friend whose closet has an entire tags-still-on section
variations: A Libra's closet has three zones: worn often, worn sometimes, and tag still attached.
For a Libra, the real cost of a return isn't shipping. It's social battery.

items.sourceNote: Pisces imagination — reframed as no sense of direction but total sensory recall, distinct from the file's daydream / inner-movie items

zh-tw.content:
雙魚座可以走過同一條路十次，第十一次還是走錯。

但他記得那條巷子第三家門口有一隻橘貓，
記得轉角那間店冬天會放某一首歌，
記得那天走過去的時候，天空是那種快下雨的顏色。

方向感是真的沒有，
畫面感倒是滿到會溢出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個五分鐘的路也要開導航、卻能把一段散步講得像一部電影的雙魚朋友
variations: 問雙魚座路怎麼走，他會先跟你描述沿路的氣氛。
雙魚座記不住街名，但記得那條街聞起來像什麼。

en.content:
A Pisces can walk the same route ten times and still take a wrong turn on the eleventh.

But they remember the orange cat that sits outside the third door down that alley,
remember the shop on the corner that plays one specific song every winter,
remember that the sky that afternoon was the color it turns right before rain.

The sense of direction genuinely isn't there.
The sense of atmosphere is overflowing.
en.editorNote: For the Pisces friend who needs GPS for a five-minute walk but can narrate that walk like a short film
variations: Ask a Pisces for directions and they'll start with the mood of the street.
A Pisces can't hold on to street names, but remembers what the street smelled like.

items.sourceNote: Leo season (Jul 23–Aug 22) generosity trait — rewritten as the grabbing-the-check scene; file's existing Leo birthday item covers the birthday-month angle only

zh-tw.content:
獅子座這個月生日，結果買單的還是他。

帳單一放到桌上，他的手比誰都快，
你說「這次讓我付」，他說「別鬧了」，
然後把卡壓在帳單上，笑得像剛贏了什麼比賽。

其實他這個月也在偷看戶頭。
但在那張桌子上，他就是想當那個說「沒問題，我來」的人。

所以下次別跟他搶。
你只要回一句「謝啦，下次換我」——
獅子座要的從來不是那筆錢，是被記得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 獅子座季節（7/23–8/22）限定，適合丟到那個每次都被獅子朋友請客的群組裡
variations: 跟獅子座吃飯，最難的不是決定吃什麼，是搶贏那張帳單。
獅子座請客換到的那份快樂，比那頓飯本身貴多了。

en.content:
It's a Leo's birthday month and somehow they're still the one paying.

The check hits the table and their hand moves faster than anyone else's.
You say 'let me get this one.' They say 'don't be ridiculous,'
put their card down on top of it, and grin like they just won something.

They're checking their bank balance this month too.
But at that table, they want to be the one who says 'I got it.'

So stop wrestling them for it.
Just say 'thanks — next one's on me.'
It was never about the money. It's about being remembered.
en.editorNote: Leo season (Jul 23–Aug 22) special — drop it in the group chat where the Leo always grabs the check
variations: The hardest part of dinner with a Leo isn't picking the place. It's winning the check.
Whatever a Leo spends on the tab, the feeling they get costs more than the meal.

items.sourceNote: Gemini short-lived enthusiasm — staged as the abandoned-hobby shelf, distinct from the file's stress-response and two-personalities items

zh-tw.content:
雙子座家裡都有一區「熱情遺跡」。

翻到第三課就停住的韓文課本、
買回來用過兩次的手沖壺、
那台說要記錄生活、後來只拍過十二張照片的相機。

但你說他三分鐘熱度也不太對——
那三分鐘裡，他是真的整個人跳進去，查資料查到半夜、跟每個朋友宣傳。

雙子座上癮的不是那件事，
是「開始一件新事情」的那個瞬間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個上個月說要學調酒、這個月改成學攝影的雙子朋友
variations: 雙子座的興趣不會消失，只會排隊等下一次被想起來。
問雙子座最近在幹嘛，要問得夠快，不然答案已經換了。

en.content:
Every Gemini has a shelf of abandoned enthusiasm.

The language textbook with a bookmark stuck on lesson three,
the pour-over kettle used exactly twice,
the camera bought to document their life that has twelve photos on it.

But 'short attention span' isn't quite fair —
for those three weeks they were all the way in: reading about it until 2 a.m., telling every friend.

What a Gemini is hooked on isn't the hobby.
It's the moment of starting something new.
en.editorNote: For the Gemini friend who was learning cocktails last month and photography this month
variations: A Gemini's hobbies never die. They just queue up for the next time they're remembered.
Ask a Gemini what they're into right now, and ask fast — the answer already changed.

items.sourceNote: Aries texting style (fires off messages faster than they think) — reframed onto the voice-note scene; file's existing Aries texting items cover rapid-fire typing and message order, not voice memos

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座傳語音訊息不是因為懶。

是他的嘴巴追不上腦袋，手指又追不上嘴巴。

一則四十七秒的語音，前八秒是「欸那個」跟一聲吸氣，
中間講到一半自己先笑出來，
最後五秒補一句「啊我剛剛講到哪」。

你回他兩行字，他語音又來三則。

他不是要你全部聽完——
是他真的很想現在、立刻、馬上讓你知道這件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個從來不打字、只丟一串語音的牡羊朋友，然後回他一句「我在捷運上」
variations: 牡羊座的語音訊息，通常比他要講的那件事長三倍。
叫牡羊座打字，等於叫他把一整團火塞進一個一個方格裡。

en.content:
An Aries doesn't send voice notes because they're lazy.

It's that their mouth can't keep up with their brain, and their thumbs can't keep up with their mouth.

A forty-seven-second voice note where the first eight seconds are 'okay so' and one deep inhale,
they crack themselves up halfway through,
and the last five seconds are 'wait, what was I saying.'

You reply with two lines of text. Three more voice notes arrive.

They don't need you to hear all of it —
they needed you to know, right now, immediately.
en.editorNote: For the Aries who has never typed a full sentence in their life — reply 'I'm on the train' and watch them keep going
variations: An Aries voice note is usually three times longer than the thing they're telling you.
Asking an Aries to type is asking them to squeeze a whole fire into one letter at a time.

items.sourceNote: Venus-ruled Taurus sensory pleasure trait — staged as the touches-every-fabric shopping scene; file's Taurus money and comfort items cover spending logic and couch inertia, not tactile standards

zh-tw.content:
跟金牛座逛街要有心理準備：他每經過一件衣服都要伸手摸一下。

摸完領口摸袖口，翻到背面看一下車線，然後說：「這個手感不行。」——他連價錢都還沒看。

金牛座對「舒服」的標準高到有點誇張：枕頭要那個高度、杯子要那個重量、毛巾要洗過三次之後的那種軟。

別笑他挑，他很早就發現，日子就是靠這些小地方撐起來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個買東西一定要先摸過、被說龜毛還理直氣壯的金牛朋友
variations: 金牛座買不下手的原因，八成是摸起來不對，跟價錢沒什麼關係。
金牛座的購物車裡沒有「將就」這個選項。

en.content:
Shopping with a Taurus takes preparation: they have to touch every garment they walk past.

Collar, then cuff, flip it over to check the stitching, then the verdict: "the hand-feel is wrong." They haven't even looked at the price.

A Taurus holds absurdly high standards for comfort: the pillow at that exact height, the mug at that exact weight, the towel soft the way it only gets after three washes.

Don't laugh at how picky they are — they figured out early that daily life is held up by exactly these small things.
en.editorNote: For the Taurus friend who has to feel the fabric before buying anything and is completely unapologetic about it
variations: When a Taurus can't commit to a purchase, it's almost always the hand-feel, and rarely the price.
There is no 'good enough' option in a Taurus's cart.

items.sourceNote: Cancer shell trait shown as gradual withdrawal after being hurt — distinct from the file's self-isolation, over-apologizing and emotional-memory items; ends warm rather than as a cutoff

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座不會跟你翻臉。

他只會從某一天開始，講的話少一點。

以前他會跟你講今天公司多荒謬、他媽媽又說了什麼、還有那個他偷偷在想的計畫；
現在他還是會回訊息，還是會笑，還是會問你吃飽沒——
只是那些他自己的事，慢慢就不講了。

那不是生氣，是他把殼關起來了。

想把他找回來，不用很大聲的道歉。
持續問、持續在、不催他——
巨蟹座的殼從來不是鎖著的，只是要有人願意在外面多待一下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個最近突然變安靜的巨蟹朋友，也適合提醒自己別把他的沉默當成沒事
variations: 巨蟹座受傷的樣子是話變少，不是聲音變大。
巨蟹座沒有把你踢出去，他只是先把自己收起來。

en.content:
A Cancer won't blow up at you.

They'll just start saying a little less, one day at a time.

They used to tell you how absurd work was, what their mom said again, the plan they'd been quietly turning over in their head.
They still reply. They still laugh. They still ask if you've eaten —
they just stop bringing up their own stuff.

That isn't anger. That's the shell closing.

Getting them back doesn't take a loud apology.
Keep asking, keep showing up, don't rush them.
A Cancer's shell was never locked. It just needs someone willing to stay outside it a little longer.
en.editorNote: For the Cancer friend who's gone quiet lately — or a reminder not to read their silence as 'everything's fine'
variations: A hurt Cancer gets quieter, not louder.
A Cancer didn't shut you out. They packed themselves away first.

items.sourceNote: Libra diplomacy trait — expressed as the cushioned-feedback scene at work; file's Libra items cover indecision, can't-say-no and conflict avoidance, not how they deliver criticism

zh-tw.content:
天秤座沒辦法直接說「這個不行」。

他會先說：「我覺得你這個方向很不錯欸。」
再說：「尤其是配色，看得出來有想過。」
然後停半秒：「就是……如果標題再想一下下，可能會更好？」

翻譯：標題要重寫。

跟天秤座共事久了你會學會一件事——
真正要改的地方，永遠藏在那句「就是……」的後面。

不過也別嫌他繞。
他繞那一圈，是為了讓你聽完之後，還想繼續做下去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個講話一定先鋪三層墊子的天秤同事，也適合今天要給別人回饋的你
variations: 天秤座說「可能會更好」，意思是「請重做」。
天秤座不是不敢講重話，他只是不想讓你當場沒力。

en.content:
A Libra physically cannot say 'this doesn't work.'

First: 'I really like the direction you're going with this.'
Then: 'The color choices especially — you can tell they were considered.'
Then a half-second pause: 'It's just… maybe if the headline got one more pass, it could be even stronger?'

Translation: rewrite the headline.

Work with a Libra long enough and you learn one thing —
the actual note is always hiding right after the 'it's just…'

But don't hold the detour against them.
They take the long way around so that you still want to keep working after you've heard it.
en.editorNote: For the Libra coworker who cushions every note three times — and for anyone who has to give feedback today
variations: When a Libra says 'it could be even stronger,' they mean 'please do it again.'
A Libra isn't afraid to give a hard note. They just don't want to flatten you with it.

items.sourceNote: Rising sign as the outward mask vs sun sign as the inner self — the file has no 上升星座 item at all; framed as the doorway metaphor rather than a chart explainer

zh-tw.content:
「你不太像天蠍座欸。」

因為你遇到的是他的上升星座。

太陽星座是他關起門來的樣子，
上升星座是他推開門走出去的樣子。

所以那個笑得很燦爛的處女座、那個安靜到不行的射手座，
他們沒有騙你——你只是先認識了門口那一個。

認識一個人的順序永遠是上升在前、太陽在後。
這件事急不得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個一直說「我完全不像我的星座」的朋友，也適合查完星盤之後拿來當自我介紹
variations: 「你不像你的星座」通常的意思是：我還沒認識到那麼裡面。
上升是你出門穿的那件外套，太陽是外套底下的你。

en.content:
'You don't really seem like a Scorpio.'

That's because you've met their rising sign.

Your sun sign is who you are with the door closed.
Your rising sign is who walks through it.

So the Virgo who's weirdly sunny, the Sagittarius who barely talks —
they're not faking anything. You just met the doorway first.

You always meet the rising before the sun.
That part can't be rushed.
en.editorNote: For the friend who keeps insisting they're nothing like their sign — or as a caption after finally reading your birth chart
variations: 'You don't act like your sign' usually means: I haven't gotten that far in yet.
Your rising is the jacket you wear out. Your sun is who's underneath it.

items.sourceNote: Moon sign as the emotional processing layer — new placement vocabulary for this file; staged as the 2 a.m. version of yourself instead of a per-sign list

zh-tw.content:
太陽星座決定你想成為什麼樣的人，
月亮星座決定你半夜兩點的樣子。

白天那個有邏輯、講道理、情緒管理很好的你，是太陽。

被一句話戳到之後躲進房間、把同一段對話翻來覆去看、訊息打完又刪掉的那個你——那是月亮。

所以別再問「我明明是水瓶座，為什麼會這麼在意」。

你的太陽在裝沒事，你的月亮沒有在裝。
情緒不需要跟人設一致。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個白天很堅強、晚上很想哭的朋友，也適合半夜想不通自己的時候自己看一次
variations: 你的太陽是自我介紹，你的月亮是凌晨三點。
太陽在別人面前，月亮在棉被裡面。

en.content:
Your sun sign decides who you're trying to be.
Your moon sign decides who you are at 2 a.m.

Daytime you — logical, fair, weirdly good at handling things — that's the sun.

The you who goes quiet after one comment, rereads the same thread eleven times, types a message and deletes it — that's the moon.

So stop asking why you're an Aquarius who somehow cares this much.

Your sun is doing a great impression of fine. Your moon isn't performing.
Your feelings don't owe your personality any consistency.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's strong all day and falls apart at night — or for yourself at 3 a.m. when you can't explain your own reaction
variations: Your sun is the introduction. Your moon is 3 a.m.
The sun is who you are in the room. The moon is who you are under the blanket.

items.sourceNote: Leo season (Jul 23–Aug 22) loyalty angle — deliberately avoids the file's saturated spotlight/attention framing; scene is the friend who gets angry on your behalf

zh-tw.content:
獅子座季節到了，先幫你複習一件事。

獅子座朋友最可怕的不是他多愛面子，
是你被虧待的時候，他氣得比你還快。

你只是輕描淡寫講一句「算了啦沒關係」，
他下一句就是：「哪裡沒關係？誰講的？」
三分鐘後你發現他已經在幫你想要怎麼回。

他不是愛管事，
他只是沒辦法接受「自己人」被當成可有可無。

被獅子座放進名單裡的人，是有保固的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 獅子座季節（7/23–8/22）限定，適合傳給那個每次都比你還氣的獅子朋友
variations: 獅子座對外很威風，對自己人是完全沒有理性的那種護。
跟獅子座抱怨要小心：你只是想吐苦水，他已經準備出門了。

en.content:
It's Leo season, so here's your reminder.

The scariest thing about a Leo friend isn't their pride.
It's how fast they get angry on your behalf.

You mention it casually — 'it's fine, whatever' —
and they're already going: 'How is that fine? Who said that?'
Three minutes later you notice they're drafting your reply for you.

They're not being nosy.
They just cannot accept one of their own people being treated as optional.

Being on a Leo's list comes with a warranty.
en.editorNote: Leo season (Jul 23–Aug 22) special — for the Leo friend who is always more offended on your behalf than you are
variations: A Leo is dignified in public and completely irrational about their own people.
