Careful venting to a Leo. You wanted to complain; they're already getting their shoes on.

items.sourceNote: Post-Mercury-retrograde beat — the file's only retrograde item (zq-041) is a per-sign list during the transit; this one is about the days after, when the excuse expires

zh-tw.content:
水逆結束的那幾天其實最尷尬。

因為訊息還是傳錯人、東西還是找不到、話還是講太快，
但已經沒有東西可以怪了。

水逆最大的功能從來不是搞你，
是給那陣子的混亂一個名字，讓你有地方可以放。

名字收回去之後你才看清楚：
會弄丟東西是因為太累，會講錯話是因為沒睡好，
會一直點開那則已讀，是因為你其實很在意。

星象只負責指出來，剩下的還是要你自己收。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合水逆一結束、發現「原來問題不是水逆」的那幾天貼在限動
variations: 水逆結束的意思不是問題消失，是藉口消失。
你怪水逆的那些事，水逆通常只做了三成。

en.content:
The most awkward days are the ones right after Mercury retrograde ends.

You still text the wrong person, still can't find your keys, still say the thing too fast —
except now there's nothing to blame.

Retrograde was never actually out to get you.
It just gave the mess a name so you'd have somewhere to put it.

Once the name's gone, you can see it clearly:
you lose things because you're exhausted, you misspeak because you didn't sleep,
you keep reopening that read receipt because you actually care.

The sky only points at it. You're still the one who cleans it up.
en.editorNote: For the week after retrograde ends and you realize the problem was never the retrograde
variations: Retrograde ending doesn't mean the problem left. It means the excuse did.
Mercury was responsible for maybe thirty percent of what you blamed on it.

items.sourceNote: Aries traits — loud temper that burns out fast, easy to soothe

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座氣起來聲音很大，但其實超好哄。

你什麼都不用解釋，遞一杯他愛喝的過去就好——
他會邊喝邊繼續唸，只是音量已經小一半了。

再喝兩口，他就開始講別的事了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個一生氣就很兇、但十分鐘後自己就沒事的牡羊朋友
variations: 跟牡羊座和好不用準備道歉信，準備一杯冰的就好。
牡羊座的火不是被道理澆熄的，是被一個願意陪他罵完那三分鐘的人熄掉的。

en.content:
An Aries gets loud when they're mad — and folds embarrassingly fast.

You don't have to explain anything. Just hand them their favorite drink.
They'll keep complaining between sips, at half the volume.

Two sips later, they're already talking about something else.
en.editorNote: For the Aries who yells for ten minutes and then acts like nothing happened
variations: Making up with an Aries doesn't take an apology speech. It takes a cold drink.
An Aries doesn't cool off because you made a good point. They cool off because someone stood there and let them finish ranting.

items.sourceNote: Taurus traits — keeping backups of everything as a security ritual

zh-tw.content:
金牛座家裡永遠多一包衛生紙、多一瓶洗髮精、多一包泡麵。

他不是在囤東西，
他只是無法接受「剛好用完」這件事發生在自己身上。

只要櫃子裡還有備用的，今天就算過得不錯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個買東西一定買兩份的金牛朋友，他大概只會回你「不然咧」
variations: 金牛座的安全感不在存摺裡，在櫃子最下層那袋還沒拆的備品。
問金牛座為什麼又買一組，他會說「以後一定用得到」——他是對的，只是那個以後可能在三年後。

en.content:
A Taurus always has one extra pack of tissues, one extra bottle of shampoo, one extra box of instant noodles.

They're not hoarding.
They just refuse to let "we're out of it" happen on their watch.

As long as there's a backup in the cabinet, today counts as a good day.
en.editorNote: Send to the Taurus who buys everything in twos — they'll just reply 'obviously'
variations: A Taurus keeps their sense of security on the bottom shelf, in the unopened backup nobody else knew about.
Ask a Taurus why they bought another one and they'll say 'we'll need it eventually.' They're right. Eventually might be three years out.

items.sourceNote: Capricorn traits — handling hard things alone and only reporting the ending

zh-tw.content:
說摩羯座「報喜不報憂」其實太客氣了——
他們常常連喜都懶得報。

事情發生的時候你不會知道，
他自己想辦法、自己收尾，
等你聽說的時候已經是結局了。

你問「怎麼不早點講」，
他會說：「講了你也只是跟著擔心。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個永遠等事情解決完才順口提一句的摩羯朋友，順便跟他說下次可以早點講
variations: 摩羯座不是不需要人幫，是他算過了——開口求助要花的時間，比他自己做完還久。
想關心摩羯座不要問「有沒有事」，要問「你現在在處理哪一件」，這樣他才答得出來。

en.content:
Saying a Capricorn "only shares the good news" is generous —
half the time they don't share that either.

You won't hear about it while it's happening.
They handle it, they clean it up,
and by the time you find out, it's already over.

You ask why they didn't say something sooner.
They say: "Telling you would've just given you something to worry about."
en.editorNote: For the Capricorn who mentions the crisis only after it's resolved — tell them next time is fine too
variations: A Capricorn isn't refusing help. They did the math: explaining the problem takes longer than solving it.
Don't ask a Capricorn 'are you okay.' Ask 'which thing are you dealing with right now.' That one they can actually answer.

items.sourceNote: Libra traits — fairness instinct showing up when splitting a group bill

zh-tw.content:
一群人吃完飯，最後拿出手機算錢的一定是天秤座。

他不是計較——
他是真的沒辦法接受有人多付了三十塊卻沒人發現。

算完他還會說：「不然這樣，飲料我請。」
然後把自己剛剛算得太精準的那份，又默默補了回去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 丟進聚餐群組，那個每次負責分帳的天秤會馬上出來認領
variations: 天秤座可以自己吃虧，但不能忍受別人被虧到——這兩件事在他腦裡是完全不同的兩件事。
天秤座算得那麼細不是為了錢，是為了讓大家下次還願意一起吃飯。

en.content:
When the group dinner ends, the one pulling out their phone to do the math is a Libra.

It's not about the money —
they genuinely cannot sit with the idea that someone overpaid by a dollar and nobody noticed.

Then, after all that math, they'll say: "Actually, drinks are on me."
Quietly undoing the split they just calculated so precisely.
en.editorNote: Drop this in the group chat — the Libra who always handles the bill will claim it immediately
variations: A Libra can absorb the loss themselves. What they can't handle is watching someone else get shortchanged. In their head those are two completely different things.
A Libra isn't splitting the bill down to the cent over money. They're doing it so everyone still wants to eat together next time.

items.sourceNote: Virgo detail-orientation redirected into caretaking — the pre-trip reminder checklist; the file's Virgo items are all nitpick/proofread/tidy angles, none about packing spares for other people

zh-tw.content:
跟處女座出去玩，出發前一天你一定會收到一則訊息。

不是問你興不興奮，
是一張清單：證件、充電線、健保卡、早上會下雨記得帶傘。

你回一句「好啦知道了」，
隔天四樣裡面帶了兩樣，
另外兩樣他包包裡剛好有多的。

他不是把你當小孩，
他只是已經在腦袋裡把明天會出錯的地方全部跑過一遍了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次出門前都幫全團想好的處女座朋友，順便說聲謝謝
variations: 處女座的關心不長在嘴巴上，長在他包包裡那份「多帶的」上面。
跟處女座出門最安心的地方是：你會忘記的東西，他已經先幫你記好了。

en.content:
The day before a trip with a Virgo, a message will arrive.

Not "are you excited" —
a checklist: ID, charging cable, insurance card, rain in the morning so bring an umbrella.

You reply "yeah yeah, got it,"
show up with two of the four,
and the other two are already in their bag. Spares.

They're not treating you like a child.
They've just already run tomorrow in their head and patched every place it could go wrong.
en.editorNote: Send it to the Virgo friend who quietly preps for the whole group, and say thanks while you're at it
variations: A Virgo's affection doesn't live in what they say. It lives in the spare one they packed for you.
The best part of traveling with a Virgo: the thing you forget is the thing they already remembered.

items.sourceNote: Aquarius resistance to unexamined convention — the 'because everyone does it' trigger; file's Aquarius items are all detachment / social battery / weird-interests angles, none about needing a reason

zh-tw.content:
讓水瓶座當場當機的一句話：「因為大家都這樣做啊。」

他不是想找碴。
他是真的會停下來想三秒——所以呢？誰決定的？當初為什麼要這樣？

你只要給他一個說得通的理由，他比誰都好配合；
給不出理由，他就會用一個你講不贏的角度，把整件事從頭問一遍。

跟水瓶座相處的訣竅其實很簡單——
不要跟他說「規定就是這樣」，跟他說為什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 丟給那個開會時總是問「所以我們為什麼要這樣做」的水瓶座同事
variations: 水瓶座不是反骨，他只是沒辦法把「大家都這樣」當成一個理由。
說服水瓶座最快的方式不是搬出規定，是把邏輯攤開給他看。

en.content:
The fastest way to short-circuit an Aquarius: "because that's just how everyone does it."

They're not being difficult.
They genuinely stop and think about it — okay, and? Who decided that? What was it for?

Give them a reason that holds up and nobody cooperates faster.
Give them no reason and they'll reopen the entire question from an angle you cannot win.

The trick with an Aquarius is simple:
don't tell them it's the rule. Tell them why it's the rule.
en.editorNote: For the Aquarius coworker who always asks "but why are we doing it this way" in meetings
variations: An Aquarius isn't contrarian. They just can't accept "everyone does it" as an actual reason.
You don't win an Aquarius over with policy. You win them over with logic.

items.sourceNote: Sagittarius long-goodbye scene — announcing they're leaving and then staying another twenty minutes; new angle for a sign whose items skew toward travel, bluntness and flakiness

zh-tw.content:
射手座說完「那我先走囉」之後，通常還會待二十分鐘。

站起來宣布一次，
穿外套穿到一半想到一件超好笑的事，講完；
走到門口又想起剛剛沒問完的那個，再聊五分鐘；
終於出去了，門開一半還要回頭補一句。

他不是捨不得走，
是他每次一準備離開，腦袋就會順手再遞給他三個話題。
zh-tw.editorNote: 聚會散場後丟到群組，那個最後一個走的射手會自己對號入座
variations: 射手座的「我先走了」是一個開場白，不是結論。
跟射手座約幾點結束沒有意義，要約的是他幾點開始說要走。

en.content:
When a Sagittarius says "okay, I'm heading out," budget another twenty minutes.

They stand up and announce it.
Halfway into their jacket they remember something hilarious. That's five minutes.
At the door they think of the thing they forgot to ask you. Five more.
They finally step outside, then hold the door open for one last comment.

It's not that they can't leave.
It's that the moment they try to, their brain hands them three more topics.
en.editorNote: Drop it in the group chat after a hangout — the Sagittarius who left last will claim it instantly
variations: For a Sagittarius, "I should get going" is an opening line, not a conclusion.
Don't ask a Sagittarius what time they're leaving. Ask what time they'll start saying they're leaving.

items.sourceNote: Saturn return (~28-30) explainer — the file has sun/moon/rising and Mercury retrograde items but zero Saturn content; framed as comfort for a friend in the wobble, with an explicit not-a-prophecy line

zh-tw.content:
如果你身邊有人快三十歲，整個人生突然開始搖——
換工作、搬家、分手、莫名其妙開始問「我到底在幹嘛」——
占星那邊有個現成的名字：土星回歸。

土星繞一圈大約二十九年半，
所以差不多在二十八到三十歲之間，它會走回你出生那天的位置。

有人形容那像宇宙寄來一張對帳單：
之前隨便撐過去的事，那幾年會一次跟你算清楚。

這當然只是一個看事情的角度，不是預言。
但如果你剛好在那個年紀覺得特別重——
至少你現在知道，不是只有你這樣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給快三十歲、最近人生一直在震盪的朋友，比一句「加油」好用
variations: 土星回歸最麻煩的不是壞事發生，是你會突然看清楚哪些東西其實一直都不適合你。
二十八到三十歲那段特別亂，占星圈叫它土星回歸，不看星座的人叫它長大。

en.content:
If someone near you is turning thirty and their whole life just started wobbling —
new job, new apartment, breakup, a sudden "wait, what am I even doing" —
astrology already has a name for it: the Saturn return.

Saturn takes roughly twenty-nine and a half years to come back around,
so somewhere between twenty-eight and thirty it lands where it sat the day you were born.

People describe it as the universe mailing you an itemized bill:
everything you'd been getting by on comes due at once.

It's a lens, not a prophecy.
But if you're that age and everything feels heavier than it should —
at least now you know it isn't only you.
en.editorNote: Send it to the almost-thirty friend whose life keeps shaking. It lands better than "hang in there"
variations: The hard part of a Saturn return isn't that bad things happen. It's that you suddenly see which things never fit you.
Astrology calls the twenty-eight-to-thirty mess a Saturn return. Everyone else just calls it growing up.

items.sourceNote: 2026年8月運勢概述提到本月中的日食落在獅子座區間；檔案內既有水逆、土星回歸，但日食／月食關鍵字為 0，補一則天象科普＋自嘲，明講不是預言

zh-tw.content:
這個月最大的天象，是台灣時間十三號凌晨的日食，位置剛好在獅子座。

獅子座管的是「你想被看見的那一面」——
舞台、作品、名字被念出來的那一秒。

占星圈習慣說日食是重新洗牌。
倒不是會有什麼壞事發生，
比較像是有件你拖了很久沒決定的事，會突然被推到桌面上。

說清楚：天上發生什麼，跟你要不要按下那個送出鍵，沒有因果關係。
但如果你最近一直在想那件事——
這個月至少給了你一個很好的藉口，把它想完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月中的天象小知識，適合丟進群組或限動當話題開場，也可以自嘲用
variations: 日食不會幫你做決定，它只會讓你比較難繼續假裝沒這件事。
獅子座的日食大概是：宇宙把燈打開，然後問你要不要上台。

en.content:
The big sky event this month is a solar eclipse mid-August, and it lands in Leo.

Leo is the part of you that wants to be seen —
the stage, the work with your name on it, the moment someone reads that name out loud.

Astrology people like to call an eclipse a reshuffle.
Not "something bad is coming."
More like: the thing you've been putting off deciding gets pushed onto the table.

To be clear, nothing happening in the sky causes you to hit send.
But if you've been circling that one decision for months —
this month at least hands you a decent excuse to finish the thought.
en.editorNote: A mid-August sky fact that works as a group-chat opener or a self-deprecating story post
variations: An eclipse won't make the decision for you. It just makes it harder to keep pretending there isn't one.
A Leo eclipse is basically the universe turning the lights on and asking if you'd like to come up.

items.sourceNote: 星座性格排行文章為靈感，情境完全原創；檔案內「團購」關鍵字 0 筆，改寫成台灣辦公室下午茶團購群組的四種角色

zh-tw.content:
辦公室的下午茶團購群組，其實看得出來每個人是什麼星座。

牡羊座是發起的那個。
午餐還沒吃完就把表單丟出來，說「十分鐘後截止喔」，
十分鐘後再補一句「好啦再等一下」。

處女座在留言區把品項、金額、備註排成對齊的三行，
順便幫別人把打錯的字改掉。

雙魚座填完就開始後悔，但不好意思說要退，
只能默默希望這團湊不成。

天秤座是最後一個填的。
他不是不想喝，他是在兩種口味之間認真研究了四十分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 轉進公司或社團的團購群組，通常三秒內就有人出來對號入座
variations: 團購最可怕的不是花錢，是主揪說「再一個人就成團」的時候，剛好看著你。
截止前五分鐘才填表單的那個人通常不是忙，是還在選。

en.content:
You can read everyone's sign off the office group order thread.

Aries starts it.
The form goes out before lunch is even finished — "closing in ten minutes" —
and ten minutes later, "okay fine, a little longer."

Virgo posts the items, prices and notes in three perfectly aligned lines,
and quietly fixes someone else's typo on the way through.

Pisces fills it in, immediately regrets it,
is too polite to back out, and just silently hopes the order falls through.

Libra is last.
Not because they don't want anything — because they spent forty minutes researching two flavors.
en.editorNote: Drop it in the work chat when a group order is running. Someone always claims a line as their own
variations: The scary part of a group order isn't the money. It's the organizer saying "we just need one more" while looking directly at you.
The person who fills in the form five minutes before it closes usually isn't busy. They're still choosing.

items.sourceNote: 四元素性格分類的常見寫法為靈感，情境原創；檔案內「密碼」關鍵字 0 筆，四元素也還沒被用成一則獨立內容

zh-tw.content:
同一個畫面：「密碼錯誤，還剩兩次機會。」

火象星座直接再打一次一模一樣的，堅信剛剛是手滑。
土象星座打開那本寫了七年的筆記本，翻到第三頁，發現上面那組也是舊的。
風象星座開始回想自己當初是用什麼心情取的，然後試了三個前任的生日。
水象星座直接按「忘記密碼」，重設一組全新的，下次還是會忘。

十二個星座，一個結局：
新密碼跟舊密碼只差一個驚嘆號。
zh-tw.editorNote: 帳號被鎖在外面的時候發給同事，比單純抱怨系統爛好笑一點
variations: 重設密碼的頁面寫「不能與前六組相同」，那一刻你才發現自己這輩子只想得出一個字。
按下「忘記密碼」的那零點五秒，全部星座都是同一個星座。

en.content:
Same screen for everybody: "Incorrect password. Two attempts remaining."

Fire signs retype the exact same thing, fully convinced it was a typo.
Earth signs open the notebook they've kept for seven years, find page three, and discover that one's outdated too.
Air signs try to remember what mood they were in when they picked it, then test three exes' birthdays.
Water signs go straight to "forgot password," set a brand new one, and will forget that one too.

Twelve signs, one ending:
the new password is the old password with an exclamation mark.
en.editorNote: Send it to a coworker who just got locked out. Funnier than complaining about the login system
variations: "Cannot match your previous six passwords" is how you learn you've only ever thought of one word.
For the half second after you click "forgot password," every sign is the same sign.

items.sourceNote: 星座熱情／續航力主題文為靈感，情境原創；檔案內「盆栽／澆水／植物」關鍵字皆為 0，牡羊座是現有標籤中則數最少的星座之一

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座買盆栽的那天，是真心的。

回家先查學名、查光照、查澆水頻率，
還幫它取了名字，拍照傳給你看：「這是小綠。」

前三天澆得非常認真，認真到有點過頭。
第四天有別的事。第五天忘了。
第十四天想起來的時候，小綠已經有一點意見。

然後牡羊座會做一件很牡羊座的事：
不是道歉，是再買一盆。這次一定可以。
zh-tw.editorNote: 送給那個家裡植物換過三輪、但熱情永遠是全新的朋友
variations: 牡羊座不是不會照顧植物，是他的專注力比植物的耐渴期短一點點。
想知道牡羊座還喜不喜歡一件事，看他記不記得自己幫它取的名字。

en.content:
The day an Aries buys a plant, they mean it.

They look up the species, the light requirements, the watering schedule.
They name it. They send you a photo: "This is Kevin."

For three days the watering is diligent. Arguably too diligent.
Day four, something comes up. Day five, they forget.
By day fourteen, Kevin has opinions.

Then the Aries does the most Aries thing available:
not apologize — buy another one. This time for sure.
en.editorNote: For the friend on their third houseplant whose enthusiasm is somehow always brand new
variations: It's not that an Aries can't keep a plant alive. Their attention span is just slightly shorter than the plant's.
To find out if an Aries still likes something, ask whether they remember the name they gave it.

items.sourceNote: 巴納姆效應／確認偏誤的科普文為靈感，寫成閱讀行為的自嘲；檔案內「只看自己」「長文」「滑過去」關鍵字皆為 0，現有內容全是星座特質描寫，沒有一則在講「讀星座文的方式」本身

zh-tw.content:
那種「各星座在某某場合的樣子」的長文，真正的閱讀方式是這樣的：

滑、滑、滑，停。
讀完自己那一段，點頭，小聲說一句「有夠準」。
然後再往下滑三段，找到那個人的星座，讀得比自己那段還仔細。
剩下的十段，眼睛有經過，大腦沒有。

我們從來不是在看十二個星座。
是在看一個自己，和一個很在意的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每次都只截自己那段的朋友，截圖邊緣還會不小心切到別人半行
variations: 判斷一篇星座文寫得好不好，不是看它寫了幾個星座，是看你有沒有多讀一段別人的。
十二段裡面最誠實的一段，是你滑過去又滑回來看第二次的那一段。

en.content:
"Twelve signs at a party" posts have exactly one real reading method.

Scroll, scroll, scroll, stop.
Read your own paragraph. Nod. Mutter "okay, that's accurate."
Then scroll three more, find that one person's sign, and read it closer than you read your own.
The other ten: eyes yes, brain no.

Nobody is reading twelve signs.
You're reading yourself, and someone you think about too much.
en.editorNote: For the friend who only ever screenshots their own paragraph and always clips half a line of somebody else's
variations: Horoscope posts aren't good because they cover twelve signs. They're good if you read a second one.
The most honest paragraph of the twelve is the one you scrolled back up for.

items.sourceNote: 太陽／上升／月亮星座差異的科普文為靈感，改寫成「不準就往下一層退」的自嘲階梯；檔案內只有 zq-357 用過上升星座，且是單句設定不是這個結構

zh-tw.content:
星座這套系統最厲害的地方，是它永遠有下一層可以解釋。

寫得很準的時候：「對，這就是我，太陽星座。」
寫得不準的時候：「喔，因為我上升不是這個。」
上升也不像：「那應該是月亮的關係。」
月亮也不像：「我出生時間本來就記得不太清楚。」

一路退到最後你會發現，
你要的其實不是一個準的答案，
是有人願意再多解釋你一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友傳一張運勢截圖問你「這準不準」的時候回這則，比直接說「那個不能信啦」溫柔很多
variations: 沒有人會因為星座說不準就不看，只會換一個欄位繼續看下去。
「我出生時間問我媽她也不太確定」是這整套系統裡最好用的萬用結尾。

en.content:
Astrology's best feature is that there is always one more layer to explain with.

Description fits: "Yes. That's me. Sun sign."
Description misses: "Ah, my rising is different."
Rising misses too: "Must be the moon, then."
Moon misses too: "Honestly, nobody's sure what time I was born."

Follow it all the way down and you notice
you were never after an accurate answer.
You wanted someone willing to explain you one more time.
en.editorNote: Reply with this when a friend sends a horoscope screenshot asking whether it's accurate. Lands softer than "that stuff isn't real"
variations: Nobody quits horoscopes for being wrong. They just move down to a different field on the chart.
"My mom isn't sure what time I was born either" is the most useful sentence in the whole system.

items.sourceNote: 星座描述之所以「很準」的心理學科普為靈感，改寫成初次見面互背特質的場景；檔案內「問你什麼星座」「破冰」關鍵字皆為 0，社交場景的既有內容都是寫某個星座的行為，不是寫這個互動本身

zh-tw.content:
你只說了「我天秤座」四個字，對方就自動接下去背：

「喔你選擇困難齁，很怕得罪人，
然後其實超在意別人怎麼想你，對吧？」

你點頭。一半是因為真的有像，
一半是他講得太順，你來不及反駁。

然後換他報自己的星座，
你也是三秒就開始背。

我們不是真的懂彼此，
只是都很願意被這樣認識一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 認識新朋友的那頓飯，聊到第三個問題就會變成這樣——先傳給那個每次都搶著背的朋友
variations: 星座最實用的功能，是讓兩個剛認識的人在三十秒內有話可以講。
被背中的時候不用急著否認，那個「對欸」的表情就是最好的回應。

en.content:
"Libra" is all you said. The other person just kept going:

"Oh, so you can't make a decision, you hate upsetting anyone,
and you care way too much what people think of you. Right?"

You nod. Half because it fits.
Half because they said it so smoothly you couldn't get a word in.

Then they say their sign,
and you're reciting theirs in three seconds flat.

We don't actually understand each other.
We're just both willing to be known that fast, once.
en.editorNote: For the dinner where you meet new people and question three always turns into this. Send it to whoever recites fastest
variations: Astrology's most practical function is giving two strangers thirty seconds of something to say.
Don't rush to deny it. The "huh, yeah" face is the whole response.

items.sourceNote: 「為何星座總是準得發慌」的巴納姆效應報導為靈感，翻成「被說中缺點反而開心」的自嘲；檔案內 13 筆提到缺點都是寫某星座的缺點，沒有一則寫這個接受度落差

zh-tw.content:
星座是這世界上唯一一種「被說中缺點還會很開心」的東西。

同事說你拖延，你可以解釋三分鐘。
朋友說你想太多，你會說「我哪有」。
星座說你拖延又想太多，
你截圖、存檔、傳到群組，
再補一句：「這也太準。」

差別不在誰講得對，
在於星座講的時候順便告訴你——
有十二分之一的人，跟你一模一樣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被主管講完之後心情很悶的那段下班路上，這則通常會讓人笑一下
variations: 我們不是討厭被說中，是討厭被單獨說中。
同一個缺點，加上一句「你星座就這樣」，殺傷力大概只剩三成。

en.content:
Astrology is the only thing on earth where being called out feels good.

A coworker says you procrastinate — you defend yourself for three minutes.
A friend says you overthink — you say no you don't.
A horoscope says you procrastinate and overthink —
you screenshot it, save it, send it to the group chat,
captioned "okay this is too accurate."

The difference isn't who's right.
It's that the horoscope quietly adds:
one twelfth of everyone is exactly like this too.
en.editorNote: For the walk home after a rough one-on-one with your manager. Usually gets a laugh out of people
variations: We don't mind being called out. We mind being called out alone.
Same flaw, plus "that's just your sign," and about seventy percent of the sting is gone.

items.sourceNote: 2026 年八月星象整理（8/23 太陽進入處女座）為時間依據，內容改寫成「季節交棒」的生活化說法；檔案內既有星座季文章只寫過金牛季，沒有寫過獅子→處女的轉場

zh-tw.content:
獅子座季只剩最後兩個禮拜。

八月二十三號，太陽走進處女座，
空氣裡的那股力量會換一種：
從「先做再說，大聲一點也沒關係」，
變成「回頭把桌上那堆收乾淨」。

所以那件你想了很久、一直沒按下去的事，
這兩週是它最順的一段風。

過了那天你不會突然變得比較不勇敢，
你只是會突然很想整理抽屜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月中丟到群組剛好，特別適合推那個檔案存了半年還不敢按發布的朋友
variations: 處女座季不是來管你的，它只是來幫你把上半場的爛攤子分類。
八月底突然很想大掃除，不是你變無聊，是換季了。

en.content:
Leo season has about two weeks left.

On August 23 the sun moves into Virgo,
and the whole mood swaps out:
from "just go, and louder is fine,"
to "okay, now clean up that pile on your desk."

So that thing you keep almost doing —
these two weeks are the last stretch of tailwind it gets.

After that you don't suddenly get less brave.
You just suddenly want to organize a drawer.
en.editorNote: Good mid-August group chat drop, especially for the friend whose draft has been sitting there since February
variations: Virgo season isn't here to judge you. It's here to sort the mess Leo season made.
The late-August urge to reorganize everything isn't boredom. It's a season change.

items.sourceNote: 以摩羯座「務實、重規劃、看長期」的通用描述為靈感，翻成「每次成本」的消費算法；檔案內金錢類寫過金牛算運費、天蠍存錢、射手換體驗，沒有寫過摩羯的攤提邏輯

zh-tw.content:
摩羯座買一件五千塊的外套，不會說「好貴」。

他會先在心裡算：
穿五年，一年大概穿六十次，
一次不到二十塊，比一杯飲料便宜。
算完，才安心刷下去。

可是同一個人，
會為了一個「用一次就丟」的東西站在架子前面猶豫到店要打烊。

不是捨不得那幾十塊，
是他沒辦法接受一樣東西只值得被用一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個買東西前會先開試算表的摩羯朋友，附一句「你的單位不是錢對吧」
variations: 摩羯座衡量貴不貴，單位從來不是錢，是次數。
他不是省，他是在幫每一樣東西算它的服役年限。

en.content:
A Capricorn looking at a $150 coat never says "that's expensive."

They do the math first:
five years, about sixty wears a year,
under fifty cents a wear, cheaper than a coffee.
Math checks out, card comes out.

And yet the same person
will stand in front of a use-it-once item until the store closes.

It's not the money.
It's that they can't accept something being worth only one use.
en.editorNote: Send it to the Capricorn who opens a spreadsheet before buying anything, with "your unit isn't dollars, is it"
variations: For a Capricorn, the unit of price was never money. It was uses.
They're not cheap. They're calculating each object's expected service life.

items.sourceNote: 以各星座性格特質總表為底，自行延伸到「剪頭髮」這個檔案內從未出現過的場景（檔案內已有點餐、開車、網購、旅遊、生病，沒有髮廊）

zh-tw.content:
各星座去剪頭髮的樣子：

金牛座：同一個設計師剪了八年。設計師換店，他也跟著換店。

處女座：帶三張參考照，其中一張還畫了箭頭，寫「這邊短兩公分就好」。

牡羊座：「你看著剪。」剪完當場說超好看，回家照鏡子才開始有意見。

雙魚座：本來想剪短，被問一句「真的要剪嗎」就動搖了，最後只修了瀏海。

射手座：出國前一天臨時決定換髮色，理由是「反正那邊也沒人認識我」。

天蠍座：全程說好、說謝謝、還給了小費，然後那家店再也沒有他的預約紀錄。
zh-tw.editorNote: 剛從髮廊出來、還在猶豫這頭髮能不能見人的時候，最適合丟到群組討拍
variations: 天秤座：剪之前問了六個人的意見，剪完還是傳照片問「這樣可以嗎」。
巨蟹座：其實不喜歡，但看到設計師那麼認真，回家才偷偷自己修。

en.content:
Getting a haircut, by sign:

Taurus: same stylist for eight years. Stylist changes salons, so does Taurus.

Virgo: brings three reference photos, one with an arrow drawn on it and the note "just an inch shorter here."

Aries: "Do whatever you think." Loves it in the chair, starts having opinions in their own mirror at home.

Pisces: wanted it short, got asked "are you sure?" once, walked out with a bang trim.

Sagittarius: decides on a new hair color the night before a trip, reasoning: "nobody there knows me anyway."

Scorpio: says it's great, says thank you, leaves a tip, and never books that salon again.
en.editorNote: Perfect group chat post for the walk out of the salon, while you're still deciding if this is fine
variations: Libra: polls six people beforehand, then texts a photo afterward asking if it's okay.
Cancer: doesn't love it, but the stylist tried so hard — fixes it quietly at home.

items.sourceNote: 以水瓶座「理性、不擅長情感表達、重視理念分享」的通用描述為靈感，翻成「用丟連結代替問候」的具體行為；檔案內水瓶條目多寫消失、聊外星人、反問為什麼，沒有寫過這個

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座不會問你「你還好嗎」。

他會在半夜傳一個連結過來。
一篇文章、一支十四分鐘的影片、一個你根本沒聽過的冷知識，
沒有前言，也沒有後語。

你點開，才發現那正好是你這禮拜卡住的那件事。

那則一個字都沒有的訊息，翻譯過來是：
剛剛想到你。

他不會講出口，
但他把你放在「會想到」的那一區。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合回覆那個總是無預警丟連結給你的水瓶朋友，比說謝謝更打中他
variations: 水瓶座的關心不長得像關心，它長得像一個網址。
他不問你怎麼了，他直接把答案丟過來，然後假裝只是剛好看到。

en.content:
An Aquarius will not ask if you're okay.

They'll send you a link at 1am.
An article, a fourteen-minute video, some fact you've never heard of.
No intro. No follow-up message.

You open it and realize it's exactly the thing you've been stuck on all week.

That message with zero words in it translates to:
I thought about you just now.

They won't say it out loud.
But they keep you in the part of their head that things remind them of.
en.editorNote: Send it back to the Aquarius who drops links on you unprompted — it lands harder than thanks
variations: Aquarius care doesn't look like care. It looks like a URL.
They don't ask what's wrong. They just send the answer and pretend they happened to find it.

items.sourceNote: 月運勢文章都會附「幸運色、幸運數字」欄位，反推成「整篇只有幸運色會被真的執行」的自嘲；檔案內的 meta 條目寫的是解釋機制與被說中缺點，沒寫過每日運勢的閱讀順序

zh-tw.content:
每天早上那則運勢，真正的閱讀順序是這樣的：

工作那段跳過、感情那段跳過、健康那段假裝有看，
手指一路滑到最下面那行——
「幸運色：綠色」。

然後你打開衣櫃，
把那件其實沒有很想穿的綠色 T 恤翻出來。

不是因為你信。
是因為那是整篇裡唯一一件你做得到的事。

星座沒有改變你的一天，
它只是幫你決定了今天穿哪一件。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合轉給每天都會點開運勢、但只認真執行幸運色那一項的朋友
variations: 十二段運勢我一句都沒記住，但我記得今天要穿綠色。
運勢最實用的欄位在最下面那一行，其他都是氣氛。

en.content:
Here's how anyone actually reads their daily horoscope:

Skip the work part. Skip the love part. Pretend to read the health part.
Scroll all the way down to the last line —
"Lucky color: green."

Then you open your closet
and dig out the green shirt you weren't planning to wear.

Not because you believe it.
Because it's the only instruction in there you can actually follow.

The horoscope didn't change your day.
It just picked your outfit.
en.editorNote: Send it to the friend who checks their horoscope every morning and only ever acts on the lucky color
variations: I remembered zero percent of the forecast and one hundred percent of the color.
The only useful line is the last one. The rest is atmosphere.

items.sourceNote: 以各星座在群體場合分工的迷因為靈感，換成台灣的 KTV 包廂場景；檔案內的清單條目寫過聚會、剪頭髮、下午茶團購，沒寫過唱歌場合

zh-tw.content:
一群人去 KTV，包廂裡的分工其實很固定：

獅子座：第一首就是他，而且是那種需要先暖嗓的歌。唱完問一句「還可以吧」，但他心裡有答案。

雙子座：麥克風從來不在他手上，他全程在講評。誰上一首走音、下一首是誰點的，他比機器還清楚。

金牛座：坐最角落，兩小時只點兩首，但水果盤是他分的、飲料是他倒的。

處女座：偷偷把待唱清單重排過，快歌慢歌交錯，還幫某個人卡了一首他一定會唱的。

天秤座：整晚都在問「還有誰沒唱」。

唱兩個小時，什麼都藏不住。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合揪 KTV 之前先丟到群組，看誰第一個跳出來認領自己那一段
variations: KTV 包廂是最誠實的星座測驗，兩小時就現形。
每個包廂都需要一個搶麥的、一個排歌的，跟一個負責切水果的。

en.content:
Take a group to karaoke and the roles sort themselves out fast:

Leo: takes the first song, and it's the kind that needs a warm-up. Asks "was that okay?" already knowing.

Gemini: never holds the mic, commentates the entire night. Knows who went flat and who queued what, better than the machine does.

Taurus: corner seat, two songs in two hours, but they're the one refilling everybody's drink.

Virgo: quietly reorders the queue so fast and slow songs alternate, and slips in one song they know someone can nail.

Libra: spends the night asking who hasn't had a turn yet.

Two hours in a small room and nobody hides anything.
en.editorNote: Drop it in the group chat before a karaoke night and see who claims their line first
variations: Karaoke is the most honest personality test there is.
Every room needs a mic hog, a queue manager, and someone handing out the fruit plate.

items.sourceNote: 以「星座被拿來當人格標籤」的迷因為靈感，改寫成台灣職場到職第一天的破冰場景；檔案內只有 zq-375 寫過報星座被自動接話，沒有寫過職場歸因

zh-tw.content:
到職第一天，隔壁同事問你是什麼星座。

那不是閒聊，那是在幫你開一個資料夾。

從那天起——
你會議記錄做得太細，是因為你那個星座；
你午餐吃很久，是因為你那個星座；
你堅持檔名一定要照日期開頭，也是因為你那個星座。

好消息是，你以後犯錯都有現成的理由。
壞消息是，你以後做對什麼，功勞也不算你的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在新人報到那週的閒聊群組，或轉給那個一認識就先問你星座的同事
variations: 同事問我星座的那一天，我就被歸檔了。
在辦公室，星座是最快的自我介紹，也是最難撕掉的那張標籤。

en.content:
First day at the new job, someone asks what your sign is.

That's not small talk. That's them opening a file on you.

From then on —
your meeting notes are too detailed because of your sign,
your lunch break runs long because of your sign,
you insist every filename starts with the date because of your sign.

Good news: every mistake you make from here comes pre-explained.
Bad news: so does everything you get right.
en.editorNote: Good for the group chat during someone's first week, or for the coworker who asks your sign before your name
variations: The day a coworker asked my sign, I got filed.
At work, your sign is the fastest introduction and the hardest label to peel off.

items.sourceNote: 以「星座解釋是事後才拿出來用的」這類迷因為靈感，寫成半夜偷查合盤的自嘲；避開真的斷言誰跟誰合不合，重點放在人的行為

zh-tw.content:
沒有人是先查完再交往的。

都是在一起三個月之後，某天半夜睡不著，
才偷偷把兩個人的生日打進去，按下那顆「開始分析」。

畫面跳出來一段話：你們的溝通方式很不一樣，容易在同一個地方卡住。

你看完，關掉網頁，
第二天照常跟他一起吃早餐。

那份分析從此只有一個用途——
吵架吵到一半的時候，
心裡默默冒出一句：「唉，早就有人講過了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個半夜偷查過、隔天假裝沒查過的朋友
variations: 查合盤不是拿來做決定的，是拿來吵架時嘆氣用的。
沒有人因為那段分析改變什麼，只是多了一句台詞。

en.content:
Nobody checks the chart before they start dating.

It's always three months in, some night you can't sleep,
and you quietly type both birthdays in and hit analyze.

Up comes a paragraph: you two communicate very differently and tend to get stuck in the same spot.

You read it, close the tab,
and have breakfast with them the next morning like nothing happened.

From then on that reading has exactly one use —
mid-argument, a small voice in your head goes,
"yeah, somebody did warn me."
en.editorNote: For the friend who looked it up at 2am and pretended the next day that they hadn't
variations: You don't read the chart to decide anything. You read it so you have something to sigh about later.
Nobody changed a thing because of that paragraph. They just got a new line to say.

items.sourceNote: 以「I don't really believe in astrology, but…」這個網路上常被拿來笑的開場白為靈感，改寫成台灣朋友聊天現場；檔案內「我沒有很信」0 筆，既有 meta 條目寫的是解釋機制（zq-374）與被說中缺點（zq-376），沒有寫過這句免責開場白

zh-tw.content:
「我沒有很信星座啦，但——」

這句話後面一定會接一段長達半小時的分析。

包括他自己的、他前同事的、他表妹男朋友的，
還有那個他只見過一次面、但一聽星座就整個人都懂了的傢伙。

講到一半他還會再補一次：「我真的沒有很信喔。」

那句話從來不是在講星座。
是在講他自己——
先幫自己留一條退路，萬一你笑他。

你點頭說「我懂」，
他就會把剩下的二十五分鐘也講完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個每次開口聊星座都要先聲明一次的朋友，或貼在剛好聊到一半的群組裡
variations: 「我沒有很信」是星座話題的開場白，不是結論。
說自己沒有很信的那個人，通常記得最多細節。
那句免責聲明不是講給你聽的，是講給他自己聽的。

en.content:
"I don't really believe in astrology, but —"

That sentence is always followed by thirty minutes of analysis.

His own sign, his old coworker's, his cousin's boyfriend's,
and the guy he met exactly once and understood completely the second he heard the sign.

Halfway through he says it again: "I really don't believe in it though."

That line was never about astrology.
It's about him —
leaving himself an exit in case you laugh.

You nod and say you get it,
and he finishes the other twenty-five minutes.
en.editorNote: For the friend who opens every astrology conversation with a disclaimer, or a group chat already halfway into one
variations: "I don't really believe in it" is the opening line, not the conclusion.
The ones who don't believe in it remember the most details.
That disclaimer wasn't for you. It was for him.

items.sourceNote: 以「born on the cusp」科普文（占星上沒有兩個太陽星座，但流行文化很吃這套）為靈感，改寫成交界生日的人怎麼用這件事；檔案內「交界」0 筆，zq-324 是把獅子座按出生日期分三段的特質描寫，切角不同

zh-tw.content:
生日剛好壓在兩個星座交接的那兩三天，是一種特權。

心情好的時候，他是前面那個：講話大聲、做事很快、揪團第一個舉手。
心情不好的時候，他是後面那個：需要獨處、想很多、你今天別吵他。

優點兩邊都認領，
缺點一律推給隔壁那一個。

「那部分不是我，那是旁邊那個星座的。」

其實每個人心裡都想要這種彈性，
只是他的生日剛好幫他發了一張通行證。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個生日卡在月底、每次被問星座都要先解釋三分鐘的朋友
variations: 交界出生的人不是有兩個星座，是有兩套說法。
「我算前面那個」——這句話通常代表他今天心情不錯。
同一個人，同一個生日，兩種版本輪流上班。

en.content:
Born in the handoff — those two or three days where one sign becomes the next. That's a privilege.

Good mood: he's the sign in front. Loud, fast, first hand up when someone suggests a plan.
Bad mood: he's the one behind. Needs space, overthinks, do not poke him today.

Both sets of strengths get claimed.
Every flaw gets pushed next door.

"That part isn't me, that's the one beside it."

Everyone wants that kind of flexibility.
His birthday just happened to issue him the permit.
en.editorNote: For the friend born at the tail end of a month who needs three minutes to answer "what's your sign"
variations: Cusp people don't have two signs. They have two explanations.
"I count as the earlier one" usually means today is going fine.
Same person, same birthday, two versions taking turns on shift.

items.sourceNote: 以「十年前見面問血型，現在問 MBTI」的東亞人格分類趨勢報導為靈感，改寫成三套系統疊在同一個人身上的自嘲；檔案內「血型」0 筆，MBTI 只出現在 I人/E人 的特質描寫，沒有一則寫過分類系統本身的世代更替

zh-tw.content:
每隔幾年就會冒出一套新的分類法。

以前長輩見面問血型，
後來大家改問星座，
現在自我介紹前先報四個英文字母。

奇怪的是，沒有一套會下架。

同一個人身上現在同時掛著三種說法，
三種都不太準，
三種他都背得出來。

因為大家真正想問的從來不是「你是哪一型」，
是「我這樣算不算正常」。

只要有人回一句「這很正常啊，你們這型都這樣」，
那天就好過多了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在群組被問「所以你 MBTI 是什麼」的時候接著丟，或貼在有長輩也有年輕人的家族群組
variations: 血型、星座、四個英文字母——問法一直換，想知道的事沒變。
沒有一套系統真的準，但三套加起來剛好夠聊一個晚上。
人不是想被分類，是想聽到「你這樣沒問題」。

en.content:
Every few years a new sorting system shows up.

Older relatives used to ask your blood type.
Then everyone asked your sign.
Now people lead with four letters before they say their name.

The strange part: none of them ever retire.

One person now carries three explanations,
none of them accurate,
all three memorized.

Because the real question was never "which type are you."
It's "am I normal like this."

Someone answers "oh that's normal, your type is all like that,"
and the day gets easier.
en.editorNote: Good reply when the group chat asks for your MBTI, or for a family thread with three generations in it
variations: Blood type, star sign, four letters. The question changes shape. It never changes.
No system is accurate. Three of them together will fill an evening.
Nobody wants to be sorted. They want to hear "that's fine, you're fine."

items.sourceNote: 以星座迷因裡「what's your sign / guess」的互動段子為靈感，改寫成不肯直說、要你先猜的那種人；檔案內「猜猜」1 筆（zq-146 是待辦清單的反問），沒有一則寫過被問星座反問回去的社交行為

zh-tw.content:
有一種人，被問星座不會直接回答。

他會說：「你猜猜看。」

然後往椅背一靠，等你開始。

你說天蠍，他挑眉；你說射手，他笑了一下；
你說處女，他馬上問「為什麼？」——問得比前面兩個都認真。

那句「你猜猜看」不是在考你。
是他難得有機會，聽別人講一次自己在對方眼裡長什麼樣子。

所以你猜錯，他很開心。
你一次就猜中，他反而有點失落——
原來我這麼好懂。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個每次都不肯直說、一定要你先猜的朋友，或轉給剛猜錯三次的那個人
variations: 「你猜猜看」的重點從來不是答案，是你猜的那三十秒。
有人問星座是想分類你，有人不肯講是想聽你怎麼看他。
他要的不是被猜中，是被形容。

en.content:
Some people won't just answer "what's your sign."

They say: "guess."

Then they lean back and wait.

You say Scorpio, an eyebrow goes up. You say Sagittarius, a small laugh.
You say Virgo and they immediately ask why — more seriously than the first two.

"Guess" isn't a test.
It's a rare chance to hear someone describe you back to you.

So guess wrong and they're delighted.
Guess right on the first try and something quietly deflates —
oh. I'm that easy to read.
en.editorNote: For the friend who never answers straight, or the person who just guessed wrong three times in a row
variations: "Guess" was never about the answer. It's about the thirty seconds you spend guessing.
Some people ask your sign to sort you. Some withhold it to hear how you see them.
They don't want to be guessed. They want to be described.

items.sourceNote: 以交友軟體把星座做成 badge 與篩選條件（Bumble 有近八成用戶掛星座、Tinder 推 Astrology Mode）的報導為靈感，改寫成「篩選有效期只到你開始在乎為止」；檔案內「交友軟體」0 筆，既有星座配對條目寫的是合盤分析（zq-384），沒有寫過用星座排除人

zh-tw.content:
交友軟體的個人資料裡有一格是星座。

大部分人都填了。有些人還順手設定了不想被推薦到哪幾個。

被排除掉的人不會收到通知，
他們只是永遠沒有出現在你的畫面上。

真正好笑的在後面——
聊得起來之後，那一格就沒有人再提了。

你開始幫他找理由：他不是不回，是最近真的很忙；
他不是冷淡，是他講話方式本來就這樣。

那一格擋得掉陌生人，
擋不掉一個你已經在意的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給正在認真設定星座篩選的朋友，或剛被人用星座婉拒的那一個
variations: 星座篩選只在你還不在乎對方的時候有效。
那一格擋的是還沒認識的人，不是已經喜歡上的人。
排除了三個星座，最後還是栽在其中一個手上。

en.content:
Dating profiles have a slot for your sign.

Most people fill it in. Some go further and quietly set which signs they'd rather not be shown.

The ones you filtered out never get a notice.
They just never show up on your screen.

Here's the funny part —
once an actual conversation gets going, nobody mentions that slot again.

You start making excuses for him instead: he's not ignoring you, work is brutal right now;
he's not cold, that's just how he talks.

That little slot filters out strangers.
It has never once filtered out someone you already care about.
en.editorNote: For the friend still fine-tuning their zodiac filter, or anyone who just got turned down for being the wrong sign
variations: Sign filters only work while you don't care yet.
The filter screens strangers. It does nothing about someone you already like.
Blocked three signs. Fell for one of them anyway.

items.sourceNote: 以「十二星座對同一件事的反應」這種迷因格式為靈感，換到婚訊場景；檔案內「婚禮」「紅包」皆 0 筆，既有清單式條目寫的是點餐、群組、剪頭髮等日常，沒有寫過喜訊

zh-tw.content:
朋友在群組宣布要結婚，第一句回覆通常很誠實：

牡羊座：「哪一天？我要去。」還沒問對象是誰。

處女座：「日期先給我，我要排假。」接著問場地、停車、要不要幫忙訂車。

天秤座：先想的是自己要穿什麼，然後打開衣櫃，開始懷疑人生。

金牛座：關心菜色。「這種等級的，會上龍蝦嗎？」

巨蟹座：眼眶先熱了，然後開始煩惱紅包要包多少才不失禮。

天蠍座：群組裡只回一張貼圖，真正想問的那句留在私訊：「你確定嗎？」

獅子座：已經在腦中排練敬酒時要講的那一段。

沒有兩個人的反應一樣，但每一個都是真心的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友宣布婚訊的群組裡接著丟，或轉給正在發喜帖的那位
variations: 喜訊丟出來的那一刻，群組裡每個人的星座都現形了。
同一則好消息，十二種擔心的方式。
最先問日期的那個，通常是最後才到的那個。

en.content:
Someone announces their engagement in the group chat. The first replies are very honest:

Aries: "What date? I'm there." Hasn't asked who the partner is.

Virgo: "Send me the date, I need to book time off." Then asks about the venue, the parking, and whether you need help with transport.

Libra: immediately thinking about what to wear, opens the closet, has a small crisis.

Taurus: concerned about the food. "Is this a lobster kind of wedding?"

Cancer: tears up first, then starts agonizing over how much cash goes in the envelope.

Scorpio: sends one sticker to the group. Saves the real question for the private message: "are you sure?"

Leo: already rehearsing the toast.

No two reactions match. Every one of them is sincere.
en.editorNote: Drop it in the chat right after someone announces a wedding, or send it to whoever is mailing out the invitations
variations: Nothing exposes a group chat's star signs like a wedding announcement.
One piece of good news, twelve kinds of worry.
The first one to ask for the date is usually the last one to arrive.

items.sourceNote: 以星座 app 評測裡「原本免費的合盤現在要訂閱才看得到、推播愈來愈像促銷」的用戶抱怨為靈感，改寫成付費牆前的自我對話；檔案內「訂閱」0 筆，zq-381 寫的是幸運色，沒有寫過付費解鎖

zh-tw.content:
免費的運勢每天給你三行。

工作那行寫得很安全，健康那行像是講給所有人聽的，
只有你真正想看的那一段——「這段關係接下來會怎樣」——
底下壓著一顆按鈕：解鎖完整內容。

你點了。跳出價格。
你退出來，再點一次，希望它換一種說法。
它沒有。

你關掉，跟自己說反正也不準。
但你沒有把那個 app 從手機裡刪掉。

它賣的從來不是答案，
是「後面還有一段」這件事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個天天看運勢、又堅持自己沒在信的朋友，或剛被推播騙進去點開的那個人
variations: 最準的那一段，永遠在付費牆後面。
我們付的不是準不準，是想再多聽一句。
沒刪掉，就代表明天還會再點一次。

en.content:
The free horoscope gives you three lines a day.

The work line is safely vague. The health line could be about anyone.
The only part you opened it for — what happens next with this person —
sits under a button: unlock full reading.

You tap it. A price appears.
You back out and tap again, hoping it words things differently.
It doesn't.

You close the app and tell yourself it isn't accurate anyway.
You don't delete it.

What it sells was never the answer.
It's the feeling that there's more of it just past the button.
en.editorNote: For the friend who checks their horoscope daily and insists they don't believe in it, or anyone who just got baited in by a push notification
variations: The most accurate part is always behind the paywall.
You're not paying for accuracy. You're paying for one more sentence.
You didn't delete it, so you'll tap it again tomorrow.

items.sourceNote: 以網路上常見「幫寵物排星座」的玩法為靈感，寫成一段對白；檔案內「寵物」0 筆、「貓」只出現在比喻裡，沒有一則是純對白結構

zh-tw.content:
「你家的貓幾月的？」

「七月底啊，怎樣。」

「難怪，獅子座。」

「牠是一隻貓。」

「一隻走進客廳會先確認有沒有人在看牠的貓。」

沒有人真的相信貓有星座。
只是講到牠的時候，你會希望這個話題可以再長一點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個手機裡九成照片都是寵物的朋友，或剛認真幫貓查完生日的自己
variations: 幫貓排星座的人，通常只是想多講一點自己的貓。
「牠是天蠍座」的意思是：牠記仇，而我覺得這樣很可愛。
貓沒有星座，但養貓的人一定會幫牠選一個。

en.content:
"When's your cat's birthday?"

"End of July. Why?"

"That explains it. Leo."

"He's a cat."

"He's a cat who checks whether anyone is watching before he walks into the room."

Nobody actually believes cats have signs.
It's just that when the subject is your cat, you want the conversation to run a little longer.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose camera roll is ninety percent pet photos, or for yourself after seriously looking up your cat's birthday
variations: People who assign their cat a sign mostly want an excuse to keep talking about the cat.
"She's a Scorpio" means: she holds grudges, and I find that adorable.
Cats don't have signs. Owners pick one for them anyway.

items.sourceNote: Dcard 星座板長期討論：大家翻星座書時最先查的其實不是自己

zh-tw.content:
在書店翻星座書，先翻自己那頁，看兩行就闔起來。
再翻前任那頁，一個字都沒漏。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給剛從書店空手走出來的朋友
variations: 自己那頁看兩行，別人那頁看到店員來關燈。
星座書最好看的，從來不是你自己那一頁。

en.content:
Astrology book in a bookstore: your page, two lines, shut it.
Your ex's page, every single word.
en.editorNote: For the friend who just walked out of a bookstore empty-handed.
variations: Two lines on your own page. The whole chapter on somebody else's.
The best page in an astrology book is never yours.

items.sourceNote: 星座日期速查文的季節性流量；分班名單一出就有人開始對日期

zh-tw.content:
開學前一週，新班級群組先成立了。
名字都還沒記熟，星座已經問過一輪。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在剛成立的新班級群組
variations: 名字還沒背起來，標籤已經發完了。
新班級的第一種分類，永遠不是照座號。

en.content:
The class group chat forms a week before school starts.
Nobody has the names down yet, but everyone's sign has already been asked.
en.editorNote: Post it in a brand-new class group chat.
variations: Names come later. Labels come first.
The first sorting in a new class is never by seat number.

items.sourceNote: 免費合盤／配對工具在節日前後被大量轉貼

zh-tw.content:
七夕前一週，配對表在群組裡飛來飛去。
你們那一組被寫成：需要多一點耐心。

他看完只說：「那我多一點耐心。」
然後把最後一顆水餃夾給你。

表格寫什麼其實沒差。
差別在有沒有人願意照著做。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合七夕前傳給那個會認真看配對表的人
variations: 配對表準不準不重要，重要的是誰願意照著上面那句去做。
被寫成需要耐心，就真的有人拿出耐心。

en.content:
The week before Qixi, compatibility charts fly around the group chat.
Yours comes back as: this pairing needs extra patience.

He reads it and says, "Fine. Extra patience."
Then hands you the last dumpling.

What the chart says barely matters.
What matters is whether anyone bothers to act on it.
en.editorNote: For the person who actually reads the compatibility chart before a holiday.
variations: A compatibility chart is only worth whatever someone does with it.
Told they'd need patience, he just went ahead and had some.

items.sourceNote: 星座迷因圖的傳播模式：讀者先找自己那一格，再拿別人那格轉發

zh-tw.content:
網路上那種「十二星座之最」的圖，一天可以在群組裡飄過三次。

你一定先找自己那一格。看完覺得寫得很爛。
再去找朋友那一格。看完覺得寫得超準，還順手轉給他。

同一個作者，同一張圖。
差別只在那一格是不是在講你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合接在剛有人丟排行圖的群組後面
variations: 自己那格永遠不準，朋友那格永遠很準。
同一張圖，看到自己就開始挑毛病。

en.content:
Those "most ___ of the twelve signs" charts drift through the group chat three times a day.

You look up your own box first. Badly written, obviously.
Then you look up a friend's box. Scarily accurate, and you forward it to them.

Same author. Same chart.
The only variable is whether that box is about you.
en.editorNote: Drop it right after someone posts one of those ranking charts.
variations: Your own box is never accurate. Your friend's box always is.
Same chart. The critic only shows up on your own square.

items.sourceNote: 星座板長期熱議「哪個星座最愛傳語音」；本則抓的是語音訊息不能搜尋、關鍵資訊藏在中段的實際痛點，檔案內「地址」「重聽」皆 0 筆，zq-353 寫的是語音的情緒衝動而非找資訊

zh-tw.content:
射手座傳語音報路。
地址在第二則的第四十秒，你重聽了三次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個永遠用語音講重要資訊的朋友，或剛在路口重聽第四遍的自己
variations: 語音訊息最大的問題不是長，是不能搜尋。
他覺得講比較快，你花了六分鐘找那五個字。
重點永遠在中間，前面三十秒是「欸那個」。

en.content:
A Sagittarius sends directions as a voice memo.
The address is forty seconds into message two, and you replayed it three times.
en.editorNote: For the friend who delivers every important detail by voice memo, or for yourself standing at an intersection on replay four
variations: The problem with voice memos isn't the length. It's that you can't search them.
Faster for him to say it. Six minutes for you to find it.
The useful part is always in the middle. The first thirty seconds are just "so anyway."

items.sourceNote: 星座迷因常拿已讀不回當梗，多半解讀成冷處理或在想怎麼回；本則換成把訊息當待辦事項排隊的解讀，檔案內魔羯的已讀多寫成情緒切斷（zq-078），沒有寫過排程視角

zh-tw.content:
魔羯座已讀不回，不是不理你。
是你的訊息被排進待辦，第七項。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個被已讀三天、開始亂想的朋友
variations: 他沒有在冷處理你，他在跑清單。
排到你的時候，通常會一次回得很完整。
在他的世界裡，回訊息也算一件要安排時間的事。

en.content:
A Capricorn leaving you on read isn't ignoring you.
Your message got filed into the to-do list, seventh from the top.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's been on read for three days and is starting to spiral
variations: He's not freezing you out. He's working the list.
When your turn comes up, the reply is usually thorough.
In his head, answering you is a task that needs a time slot.

items.sourceNote: 「一次傳很多則」的梗檔案內寫過發訊者視角（zq-020、zq-079），本則改成收訊者被通知連環轟炸的視角，檔案內「拆成」未用於訊息、通知只出現 3 筆且非此情境

zh-tw.content:
手機連跳七下，以為出事了。
點開是雙子座把一句話拆成七則。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個習慣一句話分七次講的朋友，或剛被通知嚇一跳的自己
variations: 七則加起來，是一個完整的句子。
他不是話多，他是想到哪就送出到哪。
看到七則未讀先深呼吸，通常沒什麼事。

en.content:
Your phone buzzes seven times and you assume something's wrong.
It's a Gemini splitting one sentence into seven messages.
en.editorNote: For the friend who sends one thought across seven bubbles, or for yourself after a false-alarm notification stack
variations: All seven, stacked together, make one complete sentence.
He isn't chatty. He just hits send wherever the thought stops.
Seven unread from him means nothing happened. Breathe.

items.sourceNote: 網路長青抱怨「只傳在嗎不說事情」；檔案內「在嗎」僅出現在 zq-019 的 E 人連珠炮裡，沒有單獨寫過懸空訊息造成的腦補

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座傳一句「在嗎」，然後就沒了。
你腦內已經排練完三種壞消息。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個習慣先探路再講事情的朋友
variations: 他只是想先確認你有空，你已經想到最壞的版本。
「在嗎」後面那三分鐘，比正事本身還累。
有事直接說，你的心臟會很感謝他。

en.content:
A Cancer sends "you around?" and then nothing else.
By the time they follow up, you've rehearsed three different bad news scenarios.
en.editorNote: For the friend who always scouts ahead before saying the actual thing
variations: He's checking if you're free. You're already picturing the worst version.
The three minutes after "you around?" are worse than the actual news.
Just lead with the thing. Your friend's heart will thank you.

items.sourceNote: I人/E人在演唱會的反差是英文迷因常見題材；本檔 396 篇沒有寫過演唱會或安可場景（『站起來』僅見於 zq-263、zq-367 的其他情境）

zh-tw.content:
演唱會唱到安可的那幾分鐘，看台上一定會有兩種人。

一種是燈一暗就先站起來的，手舉得比全場都高，副歌整段用喊的，破音了也不在意。
另一種從頭到尾坐著，只有最後那句大合唱，嘴巴很小聲地跟著動。

走出場館，兩個人的眼睛都是紅的。
一個馬上開始講剛剛哪一段最猛，
另一個一路上沒說幾句，回家把手機裡那段拍歪的影片又看了三次。

同一場，同一首歌。
有人把感動當場喊掉，有人把它整個帶回家。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個跟你一起去看演唱會、但反應完全不一樣的朋友
variations: E 人的感動當場有出口，I 人的感動要回家慢慢化開，兩種都是真的在乎。
安可那一刻站起來的人很吵，坐著的那個在心裡也吵得很兇。
問 I 人好不好看，他說「還不錯」；打開他的相簿，才知道他有多喜歡。

en.content:
During the encore, the crowd always splits into two kinds of people.

One stands the second the lights drop, hand higher than anyone else's, screaming the chorus until their voice cracks and not caring.
The other stays seated all night, mouthing along only on the last singalong line.

Walking out, both of them have red eyes.
One immediately starts breaking down which song hit hardest.
The other barely says anything, then watches that one shaky phone video three more times at home.

Same show, same song. One let the feeling out on the spot. The other carried the whole thing home.
en.editorNote: For the friend you go to concerts with who reacts nothing like you do
variations: Extroverts get to release it right there. Introverts have to unpack it later. Both are real.
The one standing at the encore is loud. The one sitting down is just as loud on the inside.
Ask an introvert how the show was and you get 'pretty good.' Open their camera roll and you get the truth.

items.sourceNote: 群組成員退出的瞬間反應；本檔『退出』僅在 zq-391 講付費解鎖，沒有寫過退群這一秒的三種個性

zh-tw.content:
群組裡跳出一行「某某某已退出」，接下來三分鐘固定會發生三件事。

雙子座第一個丟出「誰啊？」，丟完自己往上滑，比任何人都快找到答案。
處女座默默點進成員名單，確認少的是一個還是兩個。
天蠍座一個字都沒發，但他早就知道是誰，也大概猜得到原因。

三分鐘後話題就接回去了，好像那行字沒出現過。
只是那天晚上，有三個人各自記住了不一樣的東西。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合貼在那種每次有人退群、就會安靜三秒的群組裡
variations: 退群那行字最誠實的地方，是它讓每個人的個性同時現形。
有人在意的是誰，有人在意的是人數，有人在意的是為什麼。
話題接得回去，那三分鐘接不回去。

en.content:
"So-and-so has left the group." Three things happen in the next three minutes, every time.

The Gemini fires off "wait, who?" — then scrolls up and finds the answer faster than anyone.
The Virgo quietly opens the member list to check whether it's one person missing or two.
The Scorpio types nothing at all, already knows who it was, and has a decent guess why.

Three minutes later the chat picks up where it left off, like that line never appeared. Except three people each walked away remembering a different part of it.
en.editorNote: For the group chat that goes quiet for three seconds every time someone leaves
variations: That one system line is oddly honest — it makes everyone's personality show at once.
One of them notices who. One notices the count. One notices the reason.
The conversation recovers. Those three minutes don't.

items.sourceNote: 以聲音為錨的金牛座情緒處理；本檔沒有『砧板／切菜／腳步聲』相關寫法，zq-284 寫的是延遲爆發、zq-347 寫的是巨蟹送食物，角度不同

zh-tw.content:
廚房開始有聲音的那一刻，你就知道金牛座今天心裡卡了什麼。

先是冰箱門，再來是刀子碰到砧板。
一開始的節奏很亂，快一下停一下；
過幾分鐘，那個聲音會慢慢變成一個很穩的拍子。

聲音停下來，代表他想完了。

他不會告訴你剛剛在心裡跟誰吵、吵了幾輪，
他只會從門邊探出頭來說一句：吃飯了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個難過時不出聲、只會默默弄東西給你吃的人
variations: 金牛座的情緒不走嘴巴，走手。
他那頓飯裡面，有他沒講出口的那一段。
聽出節奏什麼時候變穩，你就知道他好了。

en.content:
The moment you hear the kitchen start up, you know something's sitting on a Taurus today.

First the fridge door. Then a knife meeting the cutting board. The rhythm starts uneven — quick, pause, quick. A few minutes in, it settles into a steady beat.

When the sound stops, it means they've finished thinking it through.

They won't tell you who they were arguing with in their head, or how many rounds it went. They'll just lean out from the doorway and say: food's ready.
en.editorNote: For the person who goes silent when they're hurting and cooks for you instead
variations: A Taurus doesn't process feelings with their mouth. They process with their hands.
Whatever they didn't say out loud is somewhere in that meal.
When the chopping evens out, they're okay again.

items.sourceNote: I人/E人在聚會尾聲的拉扯；本檔沒有出現過『續攤』或『第二攤』的場景

zh-tw.content:
每次聚會快結束，一定有人會問：「欸，要不要續攤？」

問的那個人，講出口之前就已經站在門口了。
E 人問這句，是因為他還沒玩夠。
I 人回一句「好啊」，同時在腦袋裡把最後一班車的時間重算了一次。

真正懂的人會在這時候補一句：
「不想去就直說，我不會怎樣。」

這句比續攤本身重要多了。
因為 I 人聽到會鬆一口氣，然後說：
「那……我陪你走到路口好了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個每次都硬撐著陪你續攤的 I 人朋友
variations: 「好啊」跟「我陪你走到路口」，其實是同一種喜歡。
問的人想要的是繼續，答應的人想要的是不掃你的興。
先給對方一條退路，他反而會多陪你走一段。

en.content:
Every time a night winds down, someone asks: "Hey — round two?"

The person asking is already standing by the door. The extrovert asks because they aren't done yet. The introvert says "sure," while silently recalculating the time of the last train home.

The friend who actually gets it adds one more line: "Say no if you don't want to. I won't take it personally."

That line matters more than round two ever did. Because the introvert exhales, and then says: "Okay… I'll at least walk you to the corner."
en.editorNote: For the introvert friend who keeps saying yes to round two out of pure loyalty
variations: "Sure" and "I'll walk you to the corner" are the same kind of affection.
One of them wants the night to keep going. The other just doesn't want to ruin it.
Give someone an easy way out and they'll usually stay a little longer.

items.sourceNote: 原創觀察：辦公大樓電梯的擋門／關門瞬間；本檔 400 篇未出現過『電梯』場景

zh-tw.content:
電梯門快關上的時候，遠遠有人小跑步過來。

E 人的手會先伸出去擋門，順便問一句「你今天怎麼這麼早」。
I 人的手也動了，指尖在關門鍵上方停了兩公分，最後改去按自己的樓層。

那十二層樓他一句話都沒講，出電梯前還是側過身，讓對方先走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在辦公室電梯尷尬三秒之後，默默傳給同一部電梯裡的同事
variations: 擋門的那三秒，是 E 人一天裡最自然的社交。
同一部電梯，一個用嘴巴打招呼，一個用肩膀。
I 人的禮貌都藏在動作裡，只是沒有配音。

en.content:
The elevator doors are closing, and someone comes jogging down the hall.

The extrovert's hand shoots out to hold the door, plus a quick "you're in early today."
The introvert's hand moves too — hovers two inches over the close button, then goes and picks their own floor instead.

Twelve floors, not one word. And at the top they still step aside so the other person can walk out first.
en.editorNote: For the coworker who goes silent in elevators but always lets you out first
variations: Holding the door is the most natural three seconds of an extrovert's day.
Same elevator: one says hello with their mouth, the other with their shoulder.
An introvert's manners are all in the body language, just with the audio off.

items.sourceNote: 擬人化物件視角（雨傘自述）＋雙子座一心多用的老梗；本檔未出現過雨傘或擬人化敘事者

zh-tw.content:
我是一把傘，跟過三個主人，現在住在一家早餐店門口的傘桶裡。

第一個主人下公車的時候把我留在椅背後面，第二個等雨一停就順手把我掛在路邊欄杆上。
第三個是雙子座，他撐著我走了三條街，中間接了一通電話，講到第七分鐘我就自己滑到地上了。

他到現在還跟每個人說，那天出門他根本沒有帶傘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 午後雷陣雨的季節，傳給那個雨傘陣亡率最高的雙子朋友
variations: 雙子座的傘，平均壽命是一個雨季，或一通電話。
全台灣早餐店的傘桶裡，都住著幾把雙子座的傘。
他沒有弄丟你，他只是同時在做四件事。

en.content:
I'm an umbrella. I've had three owners, and these days I live in a bucket outside a breakfast shop.

Owner one left me tucked behind a bus seat. Owner two hung me on a railing the second the rain stopped.
Owner three was a Gemini. He carried me three blocks, took a phone call, and by minute seven I had slid quietly onto the sidewalk.

He still tells people he never brought an umbrella that day.
en.editorNote: Rainy season pick — send it to the Gemini with the highest umbrella casualty rate
variations: A Gemini umbrella has a life expectancy of one rainy season, or one phone call.
Every lost-and-found bin has a few Gemini umbrellas in it.
He didn't lose you. He was just doing four things at once.

items.sourceNote: 八月台灣颱風季；停班停課宣布當晚的群組對話往返。本檔未出現過颱風假場景

zh-tw.content:
晚上八點半，停班停課的消息一出來，群組在三秒內就亮了。

射手座第一個丟出「那明天要去哪」，後面還自己補了三個地點。
巨蟹座回一句「外面風很大欸」，然後開始盤算家裡的存糧夠不夠撐一整天。

隔天雨真的很大，射手座傳來一張海邊的照片，巨蟹座把它存進相簿，回了四個字：「你小心一點。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 颱風假宣布的那晚丟到群組，看誰先開始揪出門、誰先開始查超市營業時間
variations: 同一個颱風假，有人看到的是一整天可以出去，有人看到的是一整天不用出去。
「你小心一點」是巨蟹座最接近「我也想去」的說法。
射手座的行程表裡，沒有下雨這一欄。

en.content:
8:30 p.m., the city calls off work and school for tomorrow, and the group chat lights up within three seconds.

The Sagittarius fires off "so where are we going tomorrow," then adds three destinations before anyone replies.
The Cancer answers "it's really windy out there," and starts doing math on whether there's enough food in the house for a full day.

Next morning it pours. The Sagittarius sends a photo from the beach. The Cancer saves it to their album and texts back four words: "please be careful, okay."
en.editorNote: Drop it in the group chat the night a storm day gets announced
variations: Same day off: one person sees a whole day out, the other sees a whole day in.
"Be careful" is the closest a Cancer gets to "I wish I'd come along."
There is no rain column in a Sagittarius itinerary.

items.sourceNote: 摩羯座『話少但真的會出現』的可靠感，用搬家日的誤會後翻轉呈現；本檔未寫過搬家幫忙場景

zh-tw.content:
找摩羯座幫忙搬家，他只回你兩個字：「幾點。」

你有點心虛，覺得他大概是被你硬拖來的，還先想好了要用哪一頓飯還他。
當天他提早四十分鐘到，手上多帶了一捲膠帶、一副手套，還有他自己家那台推車。

東西搬完他也沒多留，只在門口丟下一句：「你那個床架我順手鎖緊了，晚上睡看看。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個話很少、但每次都真的會出現的摩羯朋友
variations: 摩羯座的「幾點」，翻譯過來就是「我會到」。
他不會問你需不需要幫忙，他直接問幾點。
那天話最少的那個，通常也是做最多的那個。

en.content:
Ask a Capricorn to help you move and the entire reply is: "What time."

You feel a little guilty, assume you strong-armed them into it, and start planning which dinner will pay them back.
They turn up forty minutes early with packing tape, a pair of gloves, and the hand truck from their own place.

When the last box is in, they don't linger. From the doorway: "I tightened your bed frame while I was down there. See how it sleeps tonight."
en.editorNote: For the Capricorn friend who barely texts and shows up every single time
variations: "What time" is Capricorn for "I'll be there."
They don't ask whether you need help. They ask when.
The one who said the least usually carried the most.

items.sourceNote: 以每月運勢專欄的閱讀行為為靈感，對照台灣廟宇抽籤文化；本檔未出現過抽籤／擲筊

zh-tw.content:
在廟裡抽到一張中下籤，很多人的第一個動作是把它放回去，再擲一次筊。

回家滑手機，看到今天的運勢寫著諸事不宜，第一個動作是換一個 app 再看一次。
兩邊問的其實是同一件事，只是一個要跪著問，一個躺著就能問。

籤詩、塔羅、星座，做的都是同一份工作——把「再試一次」講得比較好聽。
zh-tw.editorNote: 群組裡有人喊「我今天運勢超爛」的時候接這則，笑完就過去了
variations: 沒有人只看一次運勢，大家都是看到滿意為止。
換一個 app，等於換一種說法。
重抽的那一下，其實已經替你回答了。

en.content:
Draw a bad fortune slip at the temple and most people's first move is to put it back and try again.

Get home, open the horoscope app, read "a rough day ahead," and the first move is to open a different app for a second opinion.
Both are the same question. One just has to be asked kneeling, and the other can be asked lying down.

Fortune slips, tarot, horoscopes — same job, every time. They make "try again" sound a little nicer.
en.editorNote: A good comeback when someone in the chat announces their horoscope is terrible today
variations: Nobody checks their horoscope once. They check until they like it.
A new app is just a second opinion with better fonts.
The moment you draw again, you've already answered yourself.

items.sourceNote: 取材自八月下旬水星進入處女座、主題轉向整理整頓與細節；本檔未寫過清冰箱場景

zh-tw.content:
下週水星走進處女座，第一個有感覺的地方通常是冰箱。

同一個晚上會發生三件事：過期的優格被排成一排、調味料照高矮站好、最裡面那包不明凍物終於被打開。

處女座朋友收工會拍一張照傳給你，附上兩個字：你看。
你回一個讚，他就有力氣再撐兩個月。
zh-tw.editorNote: 換季大掃除、或有人在群組喊要整理冰箱的時候丟這則
variations: 整理冰箱，是處女座季節的開場儀式。
調味料照高矮站好的那一刻，這個月才正式開始。

en.content:
Mercury moves into Virgo next week, and the fridge is usually the first place you notice.

Three things happen in one evening: the expired yogurt gets lined up in a row, the condiments get sorted by height, and that mystery bag in the back finally gets opened.

Your Virgo friend will photograph the finished shelf and send it to you with two words attached.
You hit the thumbs up, and that buys him another two months of order.
en.editorNote: Drop this when someone in the group chat announces a fridge cleanout
variations: Cleaning the fridge is Virgo season's opening ceremony.
The month doesn't officially start until the condiments are in height order.

items.sourceNote: 以射手座「先出發再說」的特質欄位為素材重寫成一年前後的對照；露營裝備場景本檔未出現過

zh-tw.content:
去年八月，射手座在群組宣布要買齊露營裝備，說以後每個月都要出去一次。

今年同一個禮拜，那頂帳篷還在陽台的紙箱裡，吊牌沒拆。

這一年他倒是去了六個地方，全部都是當天決定、到車站才買票、睡在別人家的沙發。
帳篷還在等一個計畫，而他每次都先出門了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友又臨時揪你出門的時候丟這則剛好
variations: 裝備買齊的那天，通常就是計畫結束的那天。
他走的路線，從來沒有寫在紙上過。

en.content:
Last August my Sagittarius friend announced he was buying a full camping setup and going out once a month.

Same week this year, the tent is still in its box on the balcony with the tag on.

He did make it to six different places, every one decided that morning, ticket bought at the station, couch borrowed from a friend.
The tent is still waiting for a plan, and he keeps leaving before one shows up.
en.editorNote: Perfect for the friend who invites you somewhere three hours before the train leaves
variations: The gear arrives and the plan leaves.
He never wrote the itinerary down, and he never needed to.

items.sourceNote: 改寫自金牛座「重視耐用與安全感」的性格條目，換成舊手機的誤會與翻盤；本檔未寫過換手機

zh-tw.content:
金牛座那支手機用了六年，邊角磨白，螢幕右上角有一條裂痕。

你以為他捨不得花錢，還熱心幫他查了幾支便宜又好用的。

後來才知道，抽屜裡那支新的已經放了三個月，盒子連封膜都還在。
他說再用一陣子，等到哪天真的開不了機，那才叫換。
zh-tw.editorNote: 身邊有人手機摔到快解體還在用的時候可以丟這則
variations: 新的早就買好了，只是還沒輪到它上場。
對他來說，東西壞掉那天才算真的結束。

en.content:
My Taurus friend has had the same phone for six years, corners worn pale, a crack in the top right of the screen.

I assumed he was being cheap about it and even sent him a few solid budget options.

Turns out the replacement has been sitting in his drawer for three months, still shrink wrapped.
He says he'll keep going a while longer, and the day it won't turn on is the day it counts as replaced.
en.editorNote: For the friend still using a phone that clearly survived something
variations: The new one is already bought. It just hasn't been called up yet.
For him, nothing is over until it stops turning on.

items.sourceNote: 取巨蟹座「照顧人卻不明講」的年度摘要角度，改寫成廚房場景並用第二人稱指令句；本檔未寫過煮飯招待

zh-tw.content:
巨蟹座說「隨便煮一下」的時候，先別客氣說你吃過了。

先看一眼流理台，三個鍋子都在用，湯已經滾第二輪。

他從中午就在想你今天大概又沒好好吃飯，從頭到尾都沒問出口。
你坐下、吃完、再多添一碗，這頓飯就完成它的任務了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 有人堅持要餵飽你的時候轉給他看
variations: 三個鍋子同時在用，那句「隨便」就不成立了。
多添一碗，比講謝謝有用。

en.content:
When your Cancer friend says he's just throwing something together, don't be polite and claim you already ate.

Look at the counter first: three pots going, and the soup is on its second boil.

He's been thinking since noon that you probably skipped a real meal again, he just never asked.
Sit down, finish it, go back for a second bowl, and the dinner has done its job.
en.editorNote: Send it to whoever keeps insisting on feeding you
variations: Three pots going means the word "simple" was never true.
A second bowl says thank you better than thank you does.

items.sourceNote: 取摩羯座「自律到讓旁人有壓力」的性格條目，改寫成家電使用說明口吻；本檔 zq-345 只提過『不看說明書』，未寫過整篇說明書體，也未寫過休假日場景

zh-tw.content:
摩羯座的休假日附有一份沒人翻開過的使用說明。

第一頁寫著：本機出廠即預設「行程表」模式，長按放鬆鍵不會有反應，需連續休滿三天以上才會生效。

若本機在無人要求的情況下自行整理陽台、重排書櫃、把冰箱裡的醬料按開封日排好，屬於正常散熱。
請避免在此時問他累不累，該問句會讓系統直接跳回工作模式。
zh-tw.editorNote: 轉給那個放假第一天就在大掃除的人
variations: 長按放鬆鍵不會有反應，這點請見諒。
問他累不累，等於幫他一鍵重開回上班狀態。

en.content:
A Capricorn's day off ships with a manual nobody has ever opened.

Page one: the unit arrives with Schedule Mode preset, and holding the Relax button does nothing until day three of actual time off.

If the unit starts reorganizing the balcony, resorting the bookshelf, and lining up the fridge sauces by opening date with nobody asking, that is normal heat dissipation.
Avoid asking whether he's tired, because that question drops the system straight back into work mode.
en.editorNote: For the friend who deep cleans on day one of vacation
variations: Holding the Relax button does nothing. Sorry about that.
Asking if he's tired reboots him back into work mode.

items.sourceNote: 取水瓶座「思維跳脫、愛講抽象理論」的特質欄位，改寫成飯桌上被打斷的半句話；本檔未寫過『話講到一半被中斷』的收尾方式

zh-tw.content:
水瓶座聊天有一個固定的轉彎，講到第三句就會偏進一個沒人問過的題目。

他昨天吃到一半放下筷子，說要是把捷運班距換算成人的呼吸頻率，整座城市看起來就像一隻正在

「你的湯要冷了。」

他點點頭，把那句話收回去，先喝湯。
那隻不知道是什麼的東西，整晚沒有人再提起。
zh-tw.editorNote: 身邊有人講話會突然分岔的時候可以貼
variations: 那隻東西到底是什麼，到現在還是沒有答案。
湯比理論急，這一點他也同意。

en.content:
Aquarius conversations come with a standard swerve, and by the third sentence you're somewhere nobody asked about.

Halfway through dinner he set his chopsticks down and said that converting subway headways into human breathing rates makes the whole city look like one enormous

"Your soup is getting cold."

He nodded, put the thought away, and drank the soup.
The enormous whatever-it-was never came up again all night.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose sentences keep forking mid-meal
variations: What that thing was, we still have no idea.
Soup beats theory on urgency, and he agrees.

items.sourceNote: 取雙魚座「敘事發散、鋪陳長」的年度描述，改寫成一則明知無效的認真建議；本檔未寫過『請對方講重點』的場景

zh-tw.content:
想請雙魚座三句話講完一件事，最有效的做法是開口前先幫他把重點指出來。

他會很配合地點頭，然後從當天的天氣、路上遇到的那隻貓、還有一封五年前的訊息開始鋪陳。

二十分鐘後他抵達重點，重點確實只有三句，前面那些是為了讓這三句聽得懂。
下次你還是會提醒他講重點，他也還是會照樣點頭。
zh-tw.editorNote: 朋友講故事要先鋪十分鐘背景的時候用
variations: 他一定會講到重點，路線比較長而已。
前面那二十分鐘，是最後三句的地基。

en.content:
Getting a Pisces to sum something up in three sentences works best when you point out the point for him first.

He'll nod, fully on board, and then open with the weather that day, a cat he passed on the sidewalk, and a text message from five years ago.

Twenty minutes later he lands on it, and the point really is three sentences, with all that setup there so those three land.
Next time you'll point out the point again, and he'll nod again.
en.editorNote: For the friend who front-loads ten minutes of backstory
variations: He always gets to the point. The route is just scenic.
Those twenty minutes are the foundation the last three sentences stand on.

items.sourceNote: 取天秤座「風象、重視和諧與人際平衡」的分類說明，改寫成靠環境細節推進的降溫場景；刻意避開本檔已過度使用的『中午吃什麼／選擇困難』母題

zh-tw.content:
聚會撐到十一點，客廳的空氣開始有點緊。

沙發兩端各坐一個人，中間那盤餅乾沒人再伸手，牆上時鐘的秒針聽得特別清楚。

天秤座整晚幾乎沒動，中間起身把音樂轉小一格，幫左邊那位倒了水，回座位前順手把窗戶推開一點。
十分鐘後兩個人重新開始講話，沒有人記得剛剛是誰先軟下來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 聚會吵起來又莫名和好之後可以貼
variations: 音樂小一格，窗戶開一點，事情就沒那麼硬了。
全場沒有人出面調解，溫度自己就降下來了。

en.content:
By eleven the living room air had gone tight.

One person at each end of the couch, nobody reaching for the cookie plate anymore, the second hand on the wall clock suddenly very loud.

The Libra barely moved all night, got up once to turn the music down a notch, poured water for the guy on the left, and nudged the window open on the way back to his seat.
Ten minutes later the two of them were talking again, and nobody could say who softened first.
en.editorNote: For the group chat that blew up and then quietly cooled off
variations: Music down a notch, window cracked open, and the room stops being hard.
Nobody stepped in to mediate, and the temperature dropped anyway.

items.sourceNote: 台灣媒體整理「最放不下面子星座」，天蠍座在意卻不肯開口的特質；改寫成量販店打烊前的自嘲場景

zh-tw.content:
打烊前十分鐘，我還站在調味料那一排前面沒有移動。

巡場的人第三次從我身後經過，順手把旁邊的特價牌轉正，大概以為我在比價。

要拿哪一罐我進門就決定好了，站這麼久只是想弄清楚下午那句「你自己看著辦」到底是什麼語氣。
天蠍座的購物車裡總有一樣東西是意氣買的，推到結帳台，它照樣得刷過條碼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在自己又為了一句話反覆想了一整晚、隔天還若無其事的時候發
variations: 那罐醬油我早就決定了，站在架子前面十分鐘，是在把一句話拆開來重聽。
意氣可以推進購物車，但到了結帳台，它一樣要照價付。

en.content:
Ten minutes to closing and I was still parked in front of the sauce aisle.

A staffer walked past me for the third time and straightened the sale tag next to me, probably figuring I was comparing prices.

I'd picked the jar before I walked in — I was standing there trying to decode the exact tone of something someone said to me that afternoon.
A Scorpio's cart always holds one item bought out of pride, and it still has to get scanned like everything else.
en.editorNote: For the night you replayed one sentence for four hours and acted fine the next day
variations: I chose the jar before I walked in. The ten minutes were for the sentence.
Pride fits in a shopping cart. It still has to go through checkout.

items.sourceNote: 台灣創作平台整理獅子座重面子、當眾不肯示弱的特質；改寫成公司茶水間的兩人對話

zh-tw.content:
獅子座：早上那份簡報，主管講成是整個組一起做的。
同事：你當場沒說話？
獅子座：我笑得很大方，還補一句對啊大家一起。
同事：所以你在這裡洗同一個馬克杯，洗了十五分鐘。
獅子座：這個杯子有茶垢。
同事：那份簡報是你做的。
獅子座：⋯⋯你講小聲一點，隔壁在裝水。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那位在會議上笑得最大方、散會後最安靜的同事
variations: 獅子座不會當眾爭功勞，他會去洗一個已經很乾淨的杯子。
他要的只是有人小聲說一句那是你做的，然後他會叫你不要那麼大聲。

en.content:
Leo: This morning my manager called the deck a team effort.
Coworker: And you said nothing?
Leo: I smiled big and said yes, all of us together.
Coworker: Which is why you've been washing the same mug for fifteen minutes.
Leo: It has tea stains.
Coworker: You made that deck.
Leo: ...Say it quieter, someone's at the water cooler.
en.editorNote: Send to the coworker who claps loudest in the meeting and goes quiet after
variations: A Leo won't fight for credit in the room. He'll go wash an already clean mug.
All he needed was one person saying it quietly. Then he'll tell you to keep it down.

items.sourceNote: 台灣占星網站整理牡羊座急性子、粗心、細節容易留到後面處理的特質；改寫成機車行等修車時的訊息版本

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座在機車行的塑膠椅上，手機裡排了四個版本：
版本一：你上次講的那個異音，我今天來看了。
版本二：師傅說鏈條早該換，我知道，我都知道。
版本三：小問題啦，修一修就好，你不用擔心。
版本四：欸，你那時候到底是怎麼聽出來的？
最後送出去的是：在機車行，晚點回你。
最後留在手機裡的是：下次你叫我去檢查，我當天就去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在自己終於承認別人早就提醒過、又講不出口的時候發
variations: 牡羊座願意當天騎去修，只是很難當天承認自己拖了三個月。
四個版本裡最誠實的那個，通常是最後沒送出去的那一個。

en.content:
An Aries in the plastic chair at the scooter shop, four versions queued on his phone:
Version 1: That noise you mentioned — I finally got it looked at.
Version 2: Mechanic says the chain was overdue. I know. I know.
Version 3: Small thing, quick fix, don't worry about it.
Version 4: Hey, how did you even hear that?
What actually got sent: At the shop, text you later.
What stayed on the phone: Next time you tell me to get it checked, I'll go that day.
en.editorNote: For when someone was right months ago and you still can't say it out loud
variations: An Aries will ride there the same day. Admitting he waited three months takes longer.
The honest version is usually the one that never gets sent.

items.sourceNote: 台灣媒體整理處女座以碎念表達關心的特質；改寫成客運轉運站送人之後的獨白

zh-tw.content:
你上車以後我沒有馬上走，站在原地看那班車繞出月台才轉身。

你的票我印了兩份，一份塞在你外套右邊口袋，另一份夾在行李內袋，這件事我沒有講。

我知道你要的只是一句路上小心，可是我這個處女座一開口，就會變成充電線帶了沒、證件放哪一層、幾點要換車。
下次我試著只說前面那四個字，剩下的還是會印，印完就自己收著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在送完人、話都沒講到重點的那個回程路上發
variations: 處女座的關心通常先變成一份清單，才輪到那句話。
剩下的我還是會印，只是這次印完就放進自己的口袋。

en.content:
After you boarded I didn't leave right away — I stood there until the bus swung out of the bay.

I printed your ticket twice, one in your right coat pocket, one tucked into the bag lining, and I never mentioned it.

I know all you wanted was a safe trip, but a Virgo opens his mouth and it comes out as charger, ID, transfer time.
Next time I'll try to stop after the first three words, print the rest anyway, and keep it in my own pocket.
en.editorNote: For the ride home after a goodbye where you said everything except the point
variations: A Virgo's worry turns into a checklist first. The sentence comes second.
I'll still print the backup copy. I'll just keep it to myself this time.

items.sourceNote: 處暑（2026/8/23）節氣說明與晝熱夜涼特性，作為季節背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「明天就拔營了，鍋子隨便沖一下就好。」

處暑當天的山上，入夜之後風真的轉涼，炊事區只剩最裡面那盞燈還亮著。
他把三個鍋子照大小疊成一落，鍋柄轉向同一邊，瀝水籃的濾網拆下來沖過再扣回去。
關燈前他又回頭看一眼，確認的是明天最早起床的那個人不會找不到東西。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給露營時默默留在炊事區收尾的處女座朋友，或處暑當天的貼文
variations: 他多花的那二十分鐘，是留給明天早上第一個醒來的人。
鍋柄朝同一邊這件事，只有他自己知道為什麼重要。

en.content:
"We're packing up tomorrow. Just rinse the pots and leave them."

It's the night summer officially clocks out, the mountain air has turned, and one bulb is still on at the far end of the camp kitchen.
He stacks three pots by size, turns every handle the same way, pops the strainer out of the rack, rinses it, clicks it back.
Before killing the light he looks back once, checking that whoever wakes up first tomorrow won't have to hunt for anything.
en.editorNote: For the Virgo friend who quietly closes down the camp kitchen after everyone leaves
variations: Those extra twenty minutes are a gift to whoever wakes up first.
Only he knows why all the handles have to face the same way.

items.sourceNote: 農業部處暑節氣說明，作為換季修繕情境背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「買最便宜那支就好，反正一年用不到三次。」

他沒接話，把同款不同價的兩支拿在手上掂了掂，問老闆哪一支的頭比較不會滑。
結帳他挑中間那個價位，發票折好收進皮夾夾層，和保固單放在同一格。
六年後你家窗簾軌道鬆掉，來救場的還是那支，摩羯座連要轉幾圈都記得。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合用在朋友嫌你買東西太挑、卻每次都借你工具的時候
variations: 摩羯座的貴，是用年數除下去之後才看得懂的。
那支起子比你們認識的時間還久。

en.content:
"Just grab the cheapest one, you'll use it twice a year."

He doesn't answer. He weighs two versions of the same tool in his hands and asks the owner which tip is less likely to slip.
He buys the mid-priced one, folds the receipt into the flap of his wallet, and files it with the warranty card.
Six years later your curtain rail comes loose, that same screwdriver saves the day, and the Capricorn still remembers how many turns it takes.
en.editorNote: For the friend who calls you fussy about purchases and then borrows your tools
variations: A Capricorn's expensive only makes sense after you divide it by the years.
That screwdriver has known you longer than most of your friends have.

items.sourceNote: 處暑日期與「暑氣至此而止」的節氣定義，改寫成播報體；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
處暑星座特報，明日零時生效：

暑氣自明天起收工，白天仍熱，入夜轉涼，日夜溫差擴大
獅子座季風減弱，全區音量預計下修兩格
處女座進場，開始出現重排抽屜、把充電線一條一條收好的自發性活動
射手座不受影響，維持全年短袖
巨蟹座熱湯需求上升，本週會有人問你要不要留下來吃
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合處暑當天發，或天氣一轉涼就想找人講話的時候
variations: 補充特報：天秤座衣櫃將出現長達兩週的季節交接。
以上為區域概況，個別體感請以身邊那位處女座為準。

en.content:
End-of-Heat zodiac bulletin, effective midnight:

Summer clocks out tomorrow; hot by day, cool after dark, wider gaps between the two
Leo winds easing, volume across the region expected to drop two notches
Virgo moving in, expect spontaneous drawer reordering and cable coiling
Sagittarius unaffected, short sleeves year-round as usual
Cancer soup demand rising; someone will ask you to stay for dinner this week
en.editorNote: Post it on the day the heat breaks, or whenever cool air makes you want company
variations: Addendum: Libra closets entering a two-week transitional period.
Regional outlook only. For local conditions, consult the nearest Virgo.

items.sourceNote: 2026 處暑轉涼、適合戶外活動的季節背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
牡羊座．社區羽球場．成就一覽

【開場即全開】熱身第三球就開始扣殺，達成
【誤傷友軍】對面是第一次拿拍的同事，發球依然全力，達成
【自我修正】連續八球出界後改成輕輕吊網前，達成
【隱藏成就】休息時把自己那瓶水遞過去，說「你剛那顆接得很好」，達成
【續約】收拍前先約好下禮拜同一時間，達成
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個約你運動、然後打到你放棄的牡羊座朋友
variations: 牡羊座沒有熱身這個階段，他的熱身就是第一局。
隱藏成就通常出現在他氣喘吁吁、講不出長句子的時候。

en.content:
Aries · neighborhood badminton court · achievements unlocked

[Full Send] Started smashing on warm-up shot three — unlocked
[Friendly Fire] Opponent has never held a racket; served at full power anyway — unlocked
[Self-Correction] After eight shots out of bounds, switched to soft net drops — unlocked
[Hidden Achievement] Handed over his own water bottle at the break, said "nice return back there" — unlocked
[Renewal] Booked the same slot next week before packing up — unlocked
en.editorNote: For the Aries friend who invites you to play and then plays you into the ground
variations: Aries doesn't warm up. Game one is the warm-up.
The hidden achievement shows up when he's too winded for long sentences.

items.sourceNote: 115 學年度 8/31 前後開學（各縣市微調）的季節背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
開學前一週，操場跑道每天傍晚都有人在走，你走最外圈，離所有人最遠。

你說你只是來散步，可是你記得誰跑到第四圈開始撐、誰的鞋帶鬆了一路都沒發現。
第三天你把一瓶水放在看台第二階，剛好是那個人每次停下來喘氣的位置，放完你就繼續往前走，沒有回頭。

你以為那樣就不會被看見，天蠍座——這封信就是那個看見的人寫的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在開學前傳給那個總是走最外圈、卻什麼都注意到的天蠍座朋友
variations: 你把水放下之後刻意走快了兩步，那兩步比什麼都明顯。
你最擅長的是照顧人，最不擅長的是被人抓到你在照顧人。

en.content:
The week before school starts, people walk the track at dusk, and you take the outermost lane, as far from everyone as the paint allows.

You say you're only there for the exercise, yet you know who starts struggling on lap four and whose shoelace has been loose the whole way around.
On day three you left a bottle of water on the second step of the bleachers, exactly where that person stops to catch their breath, then kept walking without turning around.

You assumed nobody caught it, Scorpio — this letter is from the one person who did.
en.editorNote: For the Scorpio who walks the outside lane and still notices everything
variations: You sped up for two steps right after you set the bottle down. Those two steps gave you away.
Looking after people is your best skill. Being caught at it is your worst nightmare.

items.sourceNote: 台灣觀眾看片尾字幕與散場習慣的討論作為場景背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
我是散場走道地板上那排小燈，一天亮四次，只要我一亮，整排座位九十秒內就會清空。

昨天最後一場，第七排靠走道那個位子沒有動，工作人員拿著垃圾袋在門邊等，也沒有出聲催。
他等到字幕跑完、連版權年份都消失了才站起來，經過我的時候低著頭，用手背在眼睛下面按了兩下。

我照亮過幾千雙鞋，只有走得特別慢的那種，我會多亮一會兒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個要坐到燈全亮、字幕跑完才肯離場的雙魚座
variations: 他從來不會說哪一段戳到他，只會說「你先走沒關係」。
散場走道很誠實，走得快的跟走得慢的，中間隔的是同一部電影。

en.content:
I'm the strip of little floor lights along the exit aisle, and I come on four times a day; the second I glow, the whole row empties in ninety seconds.

Last night's final showing, the aisle seat in row seven never moved, and the staffer by the door just stood there with a trash bag and said nothing.
He waited until the credits ran out and even the copyright year was gone, then stood up, kept his head down, and pressed the back of his hand under each eye twice on his way past me.

I've lit up thousands of shoes, and the slow ones are the only ones I stay on a little longer for.
en.editorNote: For the Pisces who refuses to leave until the house lights are all the way up
variations: He'll never tell you which scene got him. He'll just say, go ahead, I'll catch up.
The exit aisle is honest: the fast walkers and the slow walkers watched the same movie.

items.sourceNote: 12 星座性格特質分類（風象星座重視關係與協調）作為側寫參考；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
一個人要練習多久，才能把「你先去吃飯，我在這裡等就好」講得像沒事一樣？

醫院走廊那張長椅上，天秤座把兩件外套都疊在自己腿上，手裡的號碼牌翻來翻去看了六次，抬頭催看板的次數是零。
陪的人出來，他先問餓不餓，再說剛剛那位護理師人很好，自己在那裡坐了多久，一個字都沒提。

那換成他坐在那張長椅上等的時候，他會打給誰？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個永遠在陪別人等、自己的事都排最後面的天秤座
variations: 他把外套抱在腿上，理由是等一下站起來才不用花時間找。
天秤座這輩子最難的選擇題，是有人回頭問他「那你呢」。

en.content:
How long does someone have to practice before "go eat, I'll just wait here" comes out sounding like nothing at all?

On the bench in the hospital corridor, the Libra keeps both jackets folded on his lap and turns the number tag over six times, glancing up to hurry the board along exactly zero times.
When his friend finally comes out, he asks about lunch first, adds that the nurse was really kind, and says not one word about how long he sat there.

So the day he's the one waiting on that bench — who does he call?
en.editorNote: For the Libra who is always waiting on someone else and always last on his own list
variations: He holds the jackets on his lap so he won't have to go looking for them when it's time to stand up.
The hardest question a Libra ever gets is someone turning around and asking, "and you?"

items.sourceNote: 2026 年 8 月星座專欄的性格側寫作為參考；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「你手伸到隔壁那格幹嘛？」
「三樓阿姨的郵局招領通知卡在外面一半，風一吹就會掉進水溝。」
「所以你們巨蟹座出門前，都要把整排信箱檢查一遍？」
「順路。」
「順路順了兩年，結果這排信箱裡面，只有你們家那格塞到關不起來。」
「……那我現在把它插回去喔？」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個把別人的事都收得好好的、自己那格永遠塞爆的巨蟹座
variations: 巨蟹座的關心都是手先動，話是後來才想到要補的。
他家信箱塞滿的，多半是他自己不想處理的東西。

en.content:
"Why is your hand in the neighbor's slot?"
"The post office pickup notice for the lady on the third floor is hanging halfway out. One gust and it's in the drain."
"So you Cancers check the entire row of mailboxes before heading out?"
"It's on the way."
"On the way for two years, and yours is still the only slot in this row that won't shut."
"...should I just push it back in, then?"
en.editorNote: For the Cancer who keeps everyone else's things tidy and lets his own box overflow
variations: A Cancer's hands move first. The words show up later, if at all.
What's jamming his mailbox is mostly the stuff he keeps deciding to deal with tomorrow.

items.sourceNote: 機車大保養項目與老車零件難尋的背景說明；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
高中畢業那年，我把打工存下的錢全押在這台車上，牽回家那天繞了整條街三圈才捨得停。

十一年後還是同一間車行，老闆抬頭看一眼就說，這款的零件現在不好找了，要不要乾脆換一台。
我摸了摸掉漆的車殼，說再撐一陣子看看。

金牛座捨不得的東西通常都藏在座墊底下——那個為了一台車可以連吃三個月陽春麵的自己，一直坐在那裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個車齡快跟你們的交情一樣久、還在說再撐一陣子的金牛座
variations: 金牛座換東西的速度，取決於那樣東西陪他撐過幾件事。
老闆說很難找，他聽成的是還找得到。

en.content:
The year I finished high school, every dollar from my part-time job went into this scooter, and on the day I rode it home I took three laps around the block before I could bring myself to park.

Eleven years later, same repair shop, the owner glances up and says parts for this model are getting scarce — might be time for a new one.
I run a hand over the chipped panel and say let's give it a while longer.

What a Taurus can't let go of usually lives under the seat: the kid who ate the cheapest noodles for three months to own one scooter is still sitting right there.
en.editorNote: For the Taurus whose scooter is nearly as old as your friendship and who keeps saying it's got a while left
variations: How fast a Taurus replaces something depends on how much it has been through with him.
The owner said the parts are scarce. He heard: the parts still exist.

items.sourceNote: 物理治療與復健需要長期累積、進步緩慢的背景說明；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
摩羯座受傷第五週，把每次抬手的角度記在手機備忘錄，一百二十度、一百二十五度，數字沒往前就當作今天沒做完。

那天他把當天該做的份量做完，還站在原地沒走，準備從頭再來一輪。
隔壁那位大哥把彈力帶掛回架上，經過他身邊隨口丟了一句：少年欸，我那台縫紉機修了兩年才會動，人比機器慢一點很正常啦。

摩羯座在原地愣了幾秒，把備忘錄裡那整行數字刪掉，改成四個字：今天有來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個把復健也做成進度表、少一次就覺得自己不合格的摩羯座
variations: 摩羯座從來不會說今天很累，他只會說今天沒有做滿。
把數字刪掉那一秒，比多練十下難多了。

en.content:
Week five after the injury, the Capricorn logs every arm raise in his phone — 120 degrees, 125 — and if the number doesn't move, the day doesn't count as finished.

That afternoon he finished his last set and stayed put, already lining up to run the whole thing again.
The older guy on the next mat hung his resistance band back on the rack and said, on his way past: kid, my sewing machine sat in the shop two years before it ran again. People are allowed to be slower than machines.

The Capricorn stood there a few seconds, deleted the entire row of numbers, and typed three words instead: showed up today.
en.editorNote: For the Capricorn who turns even recovery into a progress bar and calls himself a failure when it stalls
variations: A Capricorn will never tell you he's exhausted. He'll tell you he didn't hit the target.
Deleting those numbers was harder than ten more reps.

items.sourceNote: 12 星座性格解析（風象星座需要獨處空間）作為側寫參考；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
一個人在消波塊上坐兩個小時，到底算孤僻還是算休息？水瓶座會說，那是他一整天裡唯一不用回覆任何人的兩個小時。

海防線那幾百個水泥腳架長得一模一樣，卻沒有兩個角度是相同的，他每次都要沿著看過去，挑一個才肯坐下。
浪打上來又退回去，中間那段空白他什麼都沒想，也沒有要想。

回程買了三杯飲料回家，進門就開始講話，一路講了四十分鐘沒停。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個一定要先消失兩小時、回來才有辦法好好講話的水瓶座
variations: 水瓶座充電不需要插頭，只需要一段沒有人叫他名字的時間。
他沿著挑一個角度那件事，看起來很無聊，他一次都沒有跳過。

en.content:
Two hours alone out on the tetrapods — antisocial, or just resting? The Aquarius will tell you it's the only two hours all day when nobody needs a reply from him.

Those few hundred concrete legs along the seawall look identical, and yet no two of them sit at the same angle; he walks the line every time and picks one before he'll sit.
Wave in, wave out, and in the gap between them he isn't thinking about anything and isn't planning to.

He buys three drinks on the way home, starts talking the second he's through the door, and doesn't stop for forty minutes.
en.editorNote: For the Aquarius who has to vanish for two hours before he can be good company again
variations: An Aquarius doesn't recharge with a cable. He recharges with a stretch of time where nobody says his name.
Walking the line to pick one angle looks pointless. He has never once skipped it.

items.sourceNote: 台灣驗光流程（試片微調、找最舒服而非最清楚的度數）作為場景背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
