鏡片一片一片換過去，驗光師問我這樣清楚還是這樣清楚，我第一個念頭是想轉頭問你。

你以前陪我來，會在旁邊補一句「他剛剛那片有猶豫，再回去比一次」，那排試片的順序你比我還熟。
今天沒有人幫我踩煞車，我隨口挑了一個就結束，走出來才發現鼻墊有點歪。

處女座，你那種非得調到剛剛好才肯走的堅持，我以前笑過很多次，今天戴著這副歪的走在路上，我全部收回。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個已經不在身邊、卻幫你把每個細節都調過一遍的處女座
variations: 你幫我調過的那個位置，我後來一直沒有再動過。
我學會挑鏡框了，可是還是不會替自己多問一句。

en.content:
One lens flips over another while the optometrist asks which is sharper, and my first instinct is to turn and ask you.

You used to come along and add, from the chair by the wall, "he hesitated on that one, go back and compare it again" — you knew that machine better than I did.
Nobody was there to slow me down today, so I picked one at random and walked out, and only on the street did I notice the nose pads sitting crooked.

Virgo, that stubborn need of yours to get everything exactly right — I laughed at it plenty, and walking home in these crooked frames, I take every word back.
en.editorNote: For the Virgo who isn't around anymore and still adjusted every small thing for you
variations: The one thing you adjusted for me, I have never touched since.
I learned how to pick frames. I still haven't learned how to ask one more question for myself.

items.sourceNote: 台灣桃園 Xpark 水族館展區動線介紹（癒見水母、企鵝展區）作為場景背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
水族館把我這條長凳釘在水母展區靠牆的位置，本意是讓人歇腳，多數人放下背包又提起來，前後不到一首歌的時間。

有一種人會把整個下午壓在我身上，眼睛跟著那團半透明的傘一起浮，浮到燈光從藍換成紫又換回來。
同行的朋友已經逛完企鵝那區折返，站著喊了兩次名字，她只「嗯」一聲，身體沒有離開我半公分。

我托過各種坐姿，雙魚座是唯一把自己整個交出去的那一種，像已經被那缸水收編了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在朋友發水族館放空照時留言，或用來吐槽身邊那個一坐下就神遊的雙魚座
variations: 帶雙魚座去水族館，行程表可以直接砍成一格。
燈光從藍換到紫又換回來，水母陪她發呆的時間比同行朋友還久。

en.content:
They bolted me to the wall of the jellyfish gallery so visitors could rest their legs. Most people drop a backpack, pick it up again, and are gone before one song ends.

Then there is the other kind, who presses a whole afternoon into me, eyes drifting with those half-transparent bells until the lighting goes blue, purple, and blue again.
Her friend has already looped back from the penguins and called her name twice; she hums once and does not move half a centimetre.

I have held every sitting posture there is. A Pisces is the only one who hands the entire self over, as if the tank had quietly adopted her.
en.editorNote: For commenting on a friend's spaced-out aquarium photo, or teasing the Pisces who stops moving the moment they sit down
variations: Take a Pisces to an aquarium and your itinerary collapses into one line.
The lights went blue, purple, and blue again; the jellyfish kept her company longer than her friends did.

items.sourceNote: 屏東海生館海底隧道、大洋池餵食解說等展區介紹作為場景背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
我是這座水族館海底隧道頭頂那片壓克力，被貼過的臉比游過去的魚還多，久了也分得出來誰是誰：
牡羊座：進來三秒就整個人躺到地上，館員走過來勸才願意起身。
金牛座：先算今天票價值不值得躺，算完才決定要不要抬頭。
雙子座：一路幫每條魚配旁白，配到自己先笑場。
巨蟹座：全程忙著幫同行的人拍照，自己一張都沒留。
天蠍座：站在最暗的那段一句話都不說，卻記得魟魚游過幾趟。
摩羯座：抬頭兩分鐘，低頭查這座館一年養魚要花多少錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合水族館合照發文時當圖說，或在群組裡點名大家各自是哪一種觀眾
variations: 獅子座：先走到光線最好的那一段，才肯回頭問拍好了沒。
水瓶座：問館員魟魚會不會覺得自己在被看，館員答不出來。

en.content:
I am the acrylic panel over the ocean tunnel. More faces have pressed against me than fish have swum past, and by now I can tell them apart:
Aries: on the floor within three seconds, up again only when staff walk over.
Taurus: works out whether today's ticket price is worth lying down for, then decides whether to look up.
Gemini: narrates every fish that passes and cracks up at their own commentary.
Cancer: photographs everyone else the whole way through and ends up in none of the shots.
Scorpio: says nothing from the darkest stretch, yet remembers how many times the ray came back.
Capricorn: looks up for two minutes, then looks down to find out what feeding this place costs per year.
en.editorNote: Use as a caption for an aquarium group photo, or to tag which kind of visitor each friend is
variations: Leo: stops only once satisfied they are standing in the best light.
Aquarius: asks a staff member whether the ray knows it is being watched, and gets no answer.

items.sourceNote: 風傳媒報導台灣娃娃機爪力設定與保夾機制作為場景背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
零錢一枚一枚掉進我肚子裡，台主把我調成十次只有一次真的使力，其餘時間我的工作是讓人相信差一點就到手。

大部分人玩三輪就換去隔壁台，射手座不會，他把口袋裡的硬幣全部餵完，還跑去對面店家再換一把回來。
那隻娃娃他其實沒有特別喜歡，他要的是弄清楚我到底會在什麼時候鬆手。
最後我鬆手了，他把娃娃塞給旁觀很久的一個小孩，兩手空空吹著口哨走出去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合朋友在娃娃機前不肯走時傳給他，或用來形容那種為了一口氣不為了獎品的射手座
variations: 我十抓才真的使力一次，射手座就一路陪我耗到那一次為止。
他拿到的那一秒就送人了，因為好玩的部分已經結束。

en.content:
Coins drop into me one at a time. The owner set me to grip properly once in every ten tries; the rest of the time my job is to make people believe they were close.

Most players give it three goes and move to the next machine. A Sagittarius does not. He feeds me every coin in his pocket, then crosses the street to break another note.
He never especially wanted that plush toy. What he wanted was to find out exactly when I would let go.
When I finally did, he handed it to a kid who had been watching the whole time and walked out whistling with empty hands.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who won't leave the claw machine, or to describe the Sagittarius who plays for the principle rather than the prize
variations: I only grip properly once in ten tries, and a Sagittarius will stay for all ten.
He gave it away the second he won it, because the fun part was already over.

items.sourceNote: 台灣點歌機／伴唱機功能介紹（點歌、插播、切歌）作為場景背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
被握過的手心溫度，我這支點歌遙控器全都記得，誰急著插播、誰按到一半又退回去，我比包廂裡的人清楚。

天秤座一拿到我，會先問一輪大家想聽什麼，收到四個答案就把四首全排進去，然後順序調了又調。
輪到他自己那首，他往後挪一格讓別人先唱，說出來的理由是這首比較適合放在後面。
燈亮之前我電量剩百分之三，他排的那首始終沒有播到，而他說這樣剛剛好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聚會後在群組裡點名那個一直讓歌的天秤座，或提醒他下次先唱自己的
variations: 他排的四首歌全播完了，唯獨自己那三分鐘一直沒輪到。
下次直接幫他插播，不要問他好不好。

en.content:
I remember the warmth of every palm that has held me. Who rushed a song to the front, who half-pressed a number and backed out — I know this room better than the people in it.

When a Libra takes me, they first ask around what everyone wants, collect four answers, queue all four, then rearrange the order twice more.
When their own song comes up, they slide it back one slot to let someone else go first, and the reason they give out loud is that it suits a later spot.
By the time the lights come up I have three percent battery left, their song never played, and they say it worked out fine.
en.editorNote: For calling out the Libra who kept giving up their turn all night, or nudging them to sing first next time
variations: All four songs they queued got played. The only three minutes that never came round were their own.
Next time just queue it for them without asking if that's okay.

items.sourceNote: 中國醫藥大學附設醫院「上石膏後的注意事項」衛教單張（固定期間穿脫衣物、拆除後皮膚照護）作為場景背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「你那件外套的袖子，從裡面翻過來再穿。」隔壁桌的同事講完就低頭繼續吃她的便當，整句話花不到五秒。

右手上著石膏的那六個禮拜，我最怕聽到的一句是「需不需要我幫忙」，摩羯座寧可自己摸索二十分鐘，也不想被人看見自己連外套都對付不了。
她沒有要幫我，她只是告訴我怎麼做，說完就不管了。
石膏拆掉之後我還是習慣先把袖子翻過來，明明已經用不到，那個順序就是留在手上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個受傷了還堅持自己穿外套的摩羯座，或用來說明什麼叫做剛剛好的幫忙
variations: 短版：她沒有伸手過來，她只說了袖子要怎麼翻，那是我當時唯一收得下的好意。
延伸版：石膏拆掉半年了，我穿外套還是先翻袖子，身體記得的比我久。

en.content:
"That jacket — turn the sleeve inside out first, then put it on." The coworker at the next desk said it and went straight back to her lunch box. The whole thing took under five seconds.

For the six weeks my right arm was in a cast, the sentence I dreaded most was "do you want me to help," because a Capricorn would rather spend twenty minutes figuring it out alone than let anyone watch them lose a fight with a jacket.
She wasn't offering to help. She just told me how it was done and then left me to it.
The cast came off a while ago and I still turn the sleeve first. I don't need to anymore. The order stayed in my hands.
en.editorNote: For the Capricorn who insists on dressing themselves with one arm out of action, or to describe help that lands exactly right
variations: Short version: She never reached over. She just said which way the sleeve went, and that was the only kindness I could accept that week.
Long version: Six months since the cast came off and my hands still start with the sleeve. They remember longer than I do.

items.sourceNote: 衛生福利部臺北醫院常見Q&A「傷口多久可以拆線」（不同部位拆線天數、回診安排）作為場景背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「袋子給我，你手空著比較好。」拆線那天他在門口講了這句，講完就把我提著的東西全部接過去。

那趟回診其實一個人也走得完，線抽掉不到十分鐘，痛感大概跟被指甲掐一下差不多。
巨蟹座在意的是別的：我出門前一定會漏掉健保卡，所以他前一晚就先問過一次。
現在我自己出門，東西拿太多的時候會下意識空出一隻手，然後才想起來這個習慣是誰留給我的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合拆線或出院後傳給那個什麼都替你想好一步的巨蟹座朋友
variations: 短版：他沒有問我痛不痛，他只是先把我兩隻手空出來。
延伸版：健保卡是他前一晚提醒的，那天我確實差一點就出門了。

en.content:
"Give me the bags, you'll want your hands free." He said it at the door on the day my stitches came out, then took everything I was carrying.

I could have made that follow-up visit alone. Pulling the stitches took under ten minutes and hurt about as much as a fingernail pinch.
What a Cancer tracks is something else entirely: I always leave my health card behind, so he had checked about it the night before.
These days when I'm out with too much in my arms, I clear one hand without thinking, and only afterwards do I remember where the habit came from.
en.editorNote: For the Cancer friend who plans one step ahead of you, after stitches or a hospital discharge
variations: Short version: He never asked whether it hurt. He just emptied both of my hands first.
Long version: The health card was his reminder the night before. I had genuinely been about to walk out without it.

items.sourceNote: 貳輪嶼「機車保養里程怎麼抓」（機油、輪胎、煞車皮更換週期）作為場景背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「這台再騎五年沒問題，你不用一直想換。」機車行老闆邊擦手邊講，講的時候人還蹲在車旁邊沒起來。

金牛座聽進去的重點常常很奇怪，別人記住的是省下多少錢，我記住的是有人願意講「沒問題」三個字。
後來那台車真的騎到第九年，中間換過兩條輪胎、一組煞車皮，儀表板有顆燈壞了我也懶得處理。
賣掉那天把鑰匙交出去，我留著它那麼久的理由，其實跟省錢沒什麼關係。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個一台車騎到底、被笑不肯換新的金牛座，或用在懷念舊車的貼文
variations: 短版：老闆講的是那台車，我聽成的是我自己。
延伸版：金牛座捨不得的很少是價格，多半是已經磨合到剛好的那種手感。

en.content:
"This one's good for another five years, stop trying to replace it." The scooter shop owner said it while wiping his hands, still crouched down beside the bike.

What a Taurus takes away from a sentence is often strange. Other people would remember the money saved; I remembered that somebody was willing to say it was fine.
That scooter lasted into its ninth year. Two tires, one set of brake pads, and a dashboard light I never bothered to fix.
When I handed the key over on the day I sold it, the reason I'd kept it that long turned out to have nothing to do with money.
en.editorNote: For the Taurus mocked for riding the same old scooter forever, or as a caption for a farewell-to-the-old-bike post
variations: Short version: He was talking about the scooter. I heard it as being about me.
Long version: What a Taurus hates giving up is rarely the price. It's the thing that has finally worn in to fit.

items.sourceNote: Bella儂儂「與髮型師零失誤溝通術」（剪髮前的溝通、剪完後的確認）作為場景背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「你這樣看起來比較好認。」雙子座朋友在髮廊門口說的，那天我剪掉留了三年的長度。

她整場都在講別的事，從隔壁店的貓講到她家熱水器，我以為她根本沒在看鏡子。
結帳時設計師問我還滿意嗎，我答不出來，替我點頭的是她。
那句話沒有安慰的意思，也沒有稱讚的意思，可是我後來每次剪完頭髮，都會想確認一下自己好不好認。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剪完頭髮發文時當圖說，或傳給那個話題亂跳、卻在關鍵時刻接住你的雙子座
variations: 短版：她講了一整個下午的閒話，只有那六個字被我留下來。
延伸版：雙子座看起來什麼都沒在聽，該回答的時候卻答得比誰都快。

en.content:
"You're easier to recognize like that." My Gemini friend said it outside the salon on the day I cut off three years of length.

She had talked about everything else the whole time — the cat at the shop next door, her water heater at home — and I assumed she hadn't glanced at the mirror once.
At the counter the stylist asked if I was happy with it and I couldn't answer. She was the one who nodded for me.
There was no comfort in that line and no compliment either, and yet every time I get my hair cut now, I check whether I still look like someone you'd recognize.
en.editorNote: Use as a caption for a fresh-haircut post, or send to the Gemini who talks about everything and still catches you at the right moment
variations: Short version: She chatted for an entire afternoon and only six words of it stayed with me.
Long version: A Gemini looks like they're not listening to any of it, then answers faster than anyone when it counts.

items.sourceNote: 中央氣象署天氣概況頁（陣雨與風向描述）作為天氣背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
風把騎樓邊的雨絲吹成斜的，牡羊座室友甩兩下安全帽就衝進門。
她從口袋掏出一塊冰箱貼，用掌心抹掉水珠，啪一聲拍上冰箱門。
接著濕外套上勾、水壺沖過、飯鍋按下，全部在十分鐘裡做完。
外面雨勢轉大，她站到冰箱前，把那塊貼紙往上挪一排。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合下雨天到家後拍冰箱發限動，或傳給那個做什麼都用衝的牡羊座朋友
variations: 短版：雨越下越斜，她把新買的那塊往上挪一排，調了三次才罷手。
延伸版：牡羊座進門的順序永遠一樣，先把該做的做完，再回頭看窗外的雨。

en.content:
The wind slanted the rain in under the arcade, and my Aries roommate shook the water off her helmet twice and charged in through the door.
She dug a fridge magnet out of her pocket, wiped the drops off it with her palm, and clapped it onto the fridge door.
Then the wet jacket went on the hook, the bottle got rinsed, the rice cooker went on, all of it inside ten minutes.
The rain came down harder outside, and she stepped over to the fridge and slid that magnet up one row.
en.editorNote: Use as a caption for a rainy-day photo of your fridge, or send it to the Aries who does everything at a sprint
variations: Short version: The rain slanted harder while she nudged the new magnet up a row, three tries before she let it be.
Long version: An Aries always comes in the same order — finish what needs finishing, then turn around and look at the rain.

items.sourceNote: 股感 StockFeel 十二星座日期與性格特質整理（天秤座猶豫、講究平衡）作為性格背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
太陽連著出了五天，天秤座同事把一整門的冰箱貼拆下來，攤在桌上排了兩種順序。
中午光線最強那陣子，她照顏色深淺把它們推回門上，退後兩步看，又改成按去過的城市排。
下午雲飄過來，她停在半途，兩隻手各拿一塊。
傍晚打起雷雨，門上還空著一半，她把沒放回去的收進紙袋。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合換季整理冰箱門的貼文，或傳給那個永遠在排兩種順序的天秤座
variations: 短版：她排到一半，天就暗了，兩隻手還各拿著一塊。
延伸版：天秤座桌上永遠有兩種版本，雨落下來時還沒選完。

en.content:
The sun held for five days straight, and my Libra coworker took every magnet off the fridge door and laid them out on the table in two different orders.
In the strongest light around noon she pushed them back onto the door by shade, stepped back two paces to look, then redid the whole thing by the cities she had been to.
Clouds came over in the afternoon and she stopped halfway, one magnet in each hand.
Thunder and rain arrived at dusk, half the door was still bare, and she put the leftovers into a paper bag.
en.editorNote: Good for a post about reorganizing the fridge door, or for the Libra who always lays out two versions
variations: Short version: She was halfway through the sorting when the sky went dark, still holding one in each hand.
Long version: A Libra always has two versions on the table, and the rain arrives before either one gets picked.

items.sourceNote: 中央氣象署颱風消息頁（外圍環流、風力增強）作為天氣背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
颱風外圍環流掃過來的晚上，金牛座把窗戶用膠帶貼成米字，壓過去又壓回來。
他把泡麵、電池、礦泉水挪進同一個櫃子，排得手伸進去不用看。
風聲到半夜變大，他把手機充到滿，關燈躺下。
早上風停了，他先起來把膠帶撕乾淨，才去看有沒有放假。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合颱風天發文用，或傳給那個把颱風假過得很有秩序的金牛座
variations: 短版：風最大那幾個小時，他睡得比誰都熟。
延伸版：金牛座的颱風假從撕膠帶開始，撕完才決定要不要出門。

en.content:
The night the typhoon's outer bands swept in, my Taurus friend taped the windows into crosses, pressing every strip flat one way and then back.
He moved the instant noodles, the batteries and the bottled water into one cabinet, arranged so a hand could find them without looking.
The wind got louder past midnight; he charged the phone to full, turned off the light and lay down.
The wind quit by morning, and he peeled the tape off clean before checking whether the day was called off.
en.editorNote: Fits a typhoon-day post, or the Taurus who runs a storm day on a schedule
variations: Short version: He slept straight through the loudest hours of the wind.
Long version: A Taurus starts a typhoon day by peeling tape, and only then decides whether to go out.

items.sourceNote: 方格子 vocus「12星座性格特質分析」（雙魚座感性、慢熱）作為性格背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
整個下午雲都壓得很低，雨遲遲沒有落下來，雙魚座蹲在冰箱門前看那排冰箱貼。
她把去年在花蓮買的那塊移到最上排，又移回原來的位置，手擱在門把上沒動。
外面終於下起來，她轉身去收衣服。
衣服收完進門，門上多了一塊手繪的，邊緣有點翹起來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合午後雷陣雨當天發文，或傳給那個冰箱門上都是自己畫的雙魚座
variations: 短版：雨落下來的那分鐘，她正好轉身去收衣服。
延伸版：雙魚座的冰箱門會慢慢長出東西，新添的那塊常常是自己畫的。

en.content:
The clouds sat low all afternoon and the rain would not come down, and my Pisces friend crouched in front of the fridge looking at the row of magnets.
She moved the one she bought in Hualien last year up to the top row, then moved it back where it was, and left her hand on the handle.
Outside it finally started, and she turned to bring in the laundry.
She came back in with the laundry, and there was one more magnet on the door, hand-drawn, its edge curling a little.
en.editorNote: For an afternoon-thunderstorm post, or the Pisces whose fridge door is covered in their own drawings
variations: Short version: The minute the rain came down she was already turning to get the laundry.
Long version: A Pisces fridge door slowly grows things, and the newest one is usually drawn by hand.

items.sourceNote: StarMind 呼嚕宇宙圈「12星座全攻略」（處女座細節控、要求精準）作為性格背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
國道路肩的風把外套吹得鼓鼓的，處女座還沒打電話叫拖吊，先蹲下去把三角警示牌擺正。
他退開幾步看角度，覺得歪了，又走回去把它往左移一個手掌的寬度。
車還斜停著，引擎蓋掀開，沒有人去碰。
那塊牌子該離車尾多遠，他兩年前查過，現在他寫得出來的是幾公尺？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個連故障都要先把東西擺好的處女座朋友，或搭配路邊拋錨的照片發文
variations: 短版：處女座在路肩做的第一件事，是把三角警示牌擺正。
延伸版：處女座記得規定存在，記不得數字；但牌子的角度一定是對的。

en.content:
The wind on the freeway shoulder puffed his jacket out, and before calling for a tow, my Virgo friend crouched down to straighten the warning triangle.
He stepped back to check the angle, decided it was crooked, walked over again and shifted it left by about a palm's width.
The car still sat at an angle, hood up, nobody touching it.
He looked up the required distance from the rear bumper two years ago, so how many meters can he actually write down now?
en.editorNote: For the Virgo who has to arrange things properly even mid-breakdown, or to pair with a roadside photo
variations: Short version: The first thing a Virgo does on the shoulder is straighten the warning triangle.
Long version: A Virgo remembers that the rule exists, not the number, but the angle is always right.

items.sourceNote: 占星之門 星座關鍵字頁（射手座樂天、隨遇而安）作為性格背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
休旅車熄火在往山上的第三個彎道，射手座從後車廂翻出三角警示牌，順便翻出一包吃剩的餅乾。
他把牌子架好，回來坐上引擎蓋咬餅乾，說救援大概要一小時，剛好可以看雲。
經過的車按了兩下喇叭，他舉手回禮。
那包餅乾是他哪一趟出門買的？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合射手座朋友在路上出狀況卻還在拍照時傳給他，或當成公路旅行貼文的配字
variations: 短版：救援還要一小時，射手座已經坐在引擎蓋上看雲了。
延伸版：射手座的後車廂什麼都有，只是沒有人知道那些東西是哪一年放進去的。

en.content:
The SUV died on the third bend up the mountain, and my Sagittarius friend dug the warning triangle out of the trunk, along with a half-eaten bag of crackers.
He set the triangle up, came back to sit on the hood and eat, saying the tow would take about an hour, good weather for watching clouds.
A passing car honked twice and he raised a hand back.
Which trip did that bag of crackers come from?
en.editorNote: Send it to the Sagittarius who takes photos instead of panicking, or use it as a road-trip caption
variations: Short version: An hour until the tow arrives, and the Sagittarius is already on the hood watching clouds.
Long version: A Sagittarius trunk contains everything, and nobody knows what year any of it went in.

items.sourceNote: 12星座個性分析頁（金牛座固執、重視秩序與擁有物）作為性格背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
副駕駛座那個置物箱，被金牛座分成三格：行照一格、面紙一格、備用充電線一格。
上週借車出去的朋友把充電線塞進車門邊的凹槽，還車時線頭露在外面。
金牛座一句話也沒講，把線抽出來，捲成原本的圈數，放回中間那格。
後車廂那塊三角警示牌他也收回袋子擺回原位，那個袋子的拉鍊現在拉上了沒？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合借過金牛座的車、或被金牛座默默重新整理過東西的人發文
variations: 短版：金牛座不會抗議，他只會把線捲回原本的圈數。
延伸版：借金牛座的車不會被念，但車還回去之後，每樣東西都會回到原本那一格。

en.content:
The glove box on the passenger side is split by my Taurus friend into three slots: registration, tissues, spare charging cable.
The friend who borrowed the car last week stuffed the cable into the pocket on the door, and it was sticking out when the car came back.
The Taurus said nothing, pulled the cable out, coiled it back to the same number of loops, and put it in the middle slot.
He also slid the warning triangle back into its pouch and back into its spot in the trunk, so is that pouch zipped shut right now?
en.editorNote: For anyone who has borrowed a Taurus's car, or been quietly reorganized by one
variations: Short version: A Taurus won't complain, he'll just coil the cable back to the same number of loops.
Long version: Borrow a Taurus's car and nobody lectures you, but every single thing goes back into its own slot.

items.sourceNote: 12星座性格特質中英對照（天秤座猶豫、難以定案）作為性格背景；內容原創

zh-tw.content:
導航跳出兩條路線，只差四分鐘，坐在後座的天秤座負責選，切來切去六次都沒按下去。
開車的人把車靠到路邊，雙黃燈閃著，手放在方向盤上等。
天秤座終於指了一條，指完又說另外那條好像也可以。
最後真正走的是哪一條？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合天秤座朋友負責規劃行程時發到群組，或配一張導航畫面的截圖
variations: 短版：兩條路差四分鐘，天秤座切了六次都沒按下去。
延伸版：天秤座選完會補一句「另外那條好像也可以」，這句話才是他真正的答案。

en.content:
The map app offered two routes four minutes apart, the Libra in the back seat was in charge of choosing, and he toggled between them six times without hitting start.
The driver pulled over, hazards blinking, hands resting on the wheel.
The Libra finally pointed at one, then said the other looked fine too.
Which route did the car actually take?
en.editorNote: For the group chat when a Libra is planning the trip, or to pair with a screenshot of the map app
variations: Short version: Two routes, four minutes apart, six toggles, and still no start button.
Long version: A Libra picks one and then adds that the other looked fine too, and that sentence is the real answer.

items.sourceNote: 處女座「追求完美、注重細節」的性格描述作為背景；對白內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「這雙左腳有點緊，右腳倒是剛剛好。」
「處女座喔？我猜的。」
「鞋拔借我，我再穿一次看看。」
「同一雙你已經穿脫四回了。」
「剛才襪子在腳跟那邊摺到。」
「那我順便把另一個顏色也搬過來，你一定會想比。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合處女座朋友試穿到店員都認得的時候發，配一張鞋盒疊成一排的照片
variations: 短版：「鞋拔借我，我再穿一次。」「同一雙你已經穿脫四回了。」
延伸版：處女座說「襪子摺到」的時候，那零點五公分他其實還沒接受。

en.content:
"The left one pinches a bit, the right one is just right."
"Virgo? Just a guess."
"Lend me the shoehorn, I want to put it on one more time."
"That is the fourth time you have taken that same pair off."
"My sock was folded at the heel a second ago."
"Then I will bring the other color over too, you are going to want to compare."
en.editorNote: For when a Virgo friend has been trying shoes on long enough that the staff know them, paired with a photo of stacked shoeboxes
variations: Short version: "Lend me the shoehorn, one more time." "That pair has been on and off four times."
Long version: When a Virgo blames the sock, what they have not accepted yet is the half centimeter.

items.sourceNote: 金牛座「穩重有耐心、重視感官享受」的性格描述作為背景；對白內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「架子最上排那雙，可以拿下來嗎？」
「兩千八，這週有折。」
「我去年春天看到是兩千五。」
「金牛座記價錢的本事真的沒話說。」
「先幫我留著，我回去想一個晚上。」
「你去年也是這樣講，隔天早上九點就站在門口了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合和金牛座朋友逛街完發到限時動態，配一張標價牌的照片
variations: 短版：「先幫我留著，我回去想一個晚上。」「你去年也是這樣講。」
延伸版：金牛座要把價錢在腦裡放到自己覺得划算為止才會付錢。

en.content:
"Could you get down that pair on the top shelf?"
"Twenty-eight hundred, and there is a discount this week."
"Last spring I saw it at twenty-five hundred."
"A Taurus and prices, honestly, nobody can compete."
"Hold it for me, I want to sleep on it."
"You said that last year too, and you were at the door by nine the next morning."
en.editorNote: For a story post after a shopping trip with a Taurus friend, paired with a photo of the price tag
variations: Short version: "Hold it, I want to sleep on it." "You said that last year too."
Long version: A Taurus keeps the number in their head until it finally feels worth paying.

items.sourceNote: 雙子座「靈活多變、好奇心強」的性格特質中英對照作為背景；對白內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「白的、黑的，還有那雙藍的，三雙我都想要。」
「進來的時候你講只買一雙。」
「那是三分鐘以前的版本。」
「鞋拔還你，黑的我先脫掉。」
「雙子座逛街都是這樣嗎。」
「不一定，今天算我特別冷靜的一天。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合雙子座朋友一秒改變主意的時候轉發，配一張三雙鞋並排的照片
variations: 短版：「你講只買一雙。」「那是三分鐘以前的版本。」
延伸版：雙子座不會反悔，他只是換了一個人格繼續逛。

en.content:
"The white, the black, and that blue one, I want all three."
"On the way in you said one pair only."
"That was the version of me from three minutes ago."
"Here is the shoehorn back, let me get the black ones off."
"Is shopping with a Gemini always like this?"
"Not always, today counts as one of my calm days."
en.editorNote: For sharing when a Gemini friend changes their mind in one second, paired with a photo of three pairs lined up
variations: Short version: "You said one pair only." "That was the version of me from three minutes ago."
Long version: A Gemini never goes back on anything, they simply switch personalities and keep browsing.

items.sourceNote: 巨蟹座「情感豐富、重視情感連結」的性格特質中英對照作為背景；對白內容原創

zh-tw.content:
「舊的那雙我還是想帶回家。」
「鞋底裂成那樣，留著能做什麼。」
「塞進鞋櫃最底下就好，又不佔多少地方。」
「巨蟹座連鞋盒都捨不得丟吧。」
「鞋盒現在裝我國中的紀念冊。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合巨蟹座朋友換新鞋卻抱著舊鞋不放的時候發，配一張舊鞋與新鞋並排的照片
variations: 短版：「鞋底裂成那樣，留著能做什麼。」「塞進鞋櫃最底下就好。」
延伸版：巨蟹座留下來的是那年走過的那些路，鞋只是順便帶著。

en.content:
"I still want to take the old pair home."
"The sole is split like that, what would you keep it for?"
"Just stuff it at the bottom of the shoe cabinet, it hardly takes any room."
"A Cancer would keep the shoebox as well, right?"
"The shoebox holds my junior high yearbook now."
en.editorNote: For a Cancer friend who buys new shoes but will not let go of the old ones, paired with a photo of old and new side by side
variations: Short version: "The sole is split, what would you keep it for?" "Just stuff it at the bottom of the cabinet."
Long version: What a Cancer keeps is every road they walked that year, and the shoes just come along.

items.sourceNote: 台北鎖行「常見鑰匙複製價格與時間」說明頁作為背景；金牛座囤備份的行為描寫為原創

zh-tw.content: 上禮拜我拿舊鑰匙去複製鑰匙，一口氣配了三副。一副塞進皮夾，一副黏在鞋櫃後面，第三副當時放得很有道理，現在想不起來道理是什麼。金牛座處理這種事一向嚴謹，嚴謹到備份還要再備份一次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合金牛座朋友又囤了一批備用品的時候轉發，配一張三把新鑰匙排排站的照片
variations: 短版：一次配了三副，第三副放得很有道理，道理已經失傳。
延伸版：金牛座真正怕的是弄丟的當下，身邊剛好沒有第二個。

en.content: Last week I brought an old key in for a duplicate key and had three cut at once. One went into my wallet, one got taped behind the shoe cabinet, and the third was filed away for an excellent reason I can no longer reconstruct. A Taurus takes this kind of thing seriously, seriously enough that the backup gets a backup of its own.
en.editorNote: Share this when a Taurus friend stocks up on spares again, paired with a photo of three fresh keys lined up
variations: Short version: Three copies cut in one go, and the excellent reason for the third one is now lost to history.
Long version: What actually scares a Taurus is the moment of losing something with no second one within reach.

items.sourceNote: 台北鎖行「有樣配鎖／無樣配鎖」服務說明頁作為背景；處女座備份層層加碼的對白為原創

zh-tw.content:
「這是第七把了喔。」
「第六把在我媽那邊，不算在流通裡。」
「你上個月才來複製鑰匙。」
「上個月配的是備品，今天這把是備品的備品。」
「你們處女座都這樣嗎。」
「這樣才剛好而已，我還沒開始認真。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合處女座朋友把備份做到第七層的時候發，配一張鑰匙圈掛滿一整串的照片
variations: 短版：「上個月配的是備品。」「今天這把是備品的備品。」
延伸版：處女座的安全感是一串會叮噹響的東西，而且每一把都知道自己負責哪一扇門。

en.content:
"That makes seven."
"The sixth one lives at my mom's, so it doesn't count as being in circulation."
"You came in for a duplicate key just last month."
"Last month's was the spare, and today's is the spare for the spare."
"Are all you Virgos like this?"
"This is merely adequate. I haven't started being thorough yet."
en.editorNote: For a Virgo friend whose backups have reached layer seven, paired with a photo of a wildly overloaded key ring
variations: Short version: "Last month's was the spare." "Today's is the spare for the spare."
Long version: A Virgo's peace of mind jingles on a ring, and every key on it knows exactly which door it answers for.

items.sourceNote: udnSTYLE 十二星座性格與生活習慣專欄作為背景；射手座反覆規劃卻不出手的描寫為原創

zh-tw.content:
我手機裡裝了四個訂房 App，每一個都停在同一頁：日期填好、人數填好，然後我按上一步。
這件事我一個月做兩次，做得很熟練，熟練到有固定的順序。
射手座真正出發的那一刻是規劃的那個晚上，機票只是後面才要處理的雜事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合射手座朋友第 N 次規劃卻沒訂票的時候轉發，配一張比價頁面的截圖
variations: 短版：日期填好、人數填好，然後我按上一步。
延伸版：射手座的行李箱其實常年是開的，裡面裝的是還沒發生的那些行程。

en.content:
There are four hotel apps on my phone and all four are parked on the same screen: dates entered, headcount entered, and then I tap back.
I do this twice a month, smoothly, smoothly enough that it now runs in a fixed order.
For a Sagittarius the leaving happens on the night of the planning, and the plane ticket is just admin to deal with afterwards.
en.editorNote: Share when a Sagittarius friend plans a trip for the Nth time without ever booking, paired with a screenshot of a price comparison page
variations: Short version: Dates entered, headcount entered, and then I tap back.
Long version: A Sagittarius keeps the suitcase open all year round, and what is packed in it are the trips that never happened.

items.sourceNote: StockFeel 12 星座性格特質與四大星象整理作為背景；水瓶座社交前先排練的行為為原創

zh-tw.content:
出門前我會先想好三個離場說法，存在備忘錄裡，順序排好。
最常用的那個是明天要早起，備用的那個是家裡有東西在等我，還有一個放到現在都沒派上用場。
我每次還是照樣排練一遍，排練完才有辦法把門帶上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合水瓶座或 I 人朋友出門聚會前先演練一次的時候發，配一張備忘錄截圖
variations: 短版：三個離場說法，用過兩個，剩下那個還在待命。
延伸版：水瓶座願意出門，前提是隨時走得掉這件事已經先安排好了。

en.content:
Before I head out I prepare three exit lines, saved in my notes app, arranged in order.
The usual one is that I have an early start tomorrow, the backup one is that something at home is waiting for me, and the third has never once been needed.
I rehearse all of them anyway, every time, and only once the rehearsal is done can I get the door shut behind me.
en.editorNote: For an Aquarius or introvert friend who runs a quick rehearsal before going to a gathering, paired with a screenshot of a notes app
variations: Short version: Three exit lines, two of them used, and the leftover one still on standby.
Long version: An Aquarius will gladly come out, provided the being-able-to-leave-anytime part has already been arranged.
